heading.waitForCurrentProjection.zh-CN: 等待当前草稿预览完成，大纲会自动更新。
heading.waitForCurrentProjection.en-US: The outline updates automatically when the current draft preview is ready.

heading.openDocumentForOutline.en-US: Open a document to view its outline.

heading.outlineBasisChanged.zh-CN: 大纲已过期，等待当前预览完成后自动更新。
heading.outlineBasisChanged.en-US: The outline is out of date and updates when the current preview is ready.

heading.generatedItemSourceUnavailable.zh-CN: 此大纲项没有可定位的本篇源码或当前显示位置。
heading.generatedItemSourceUnavailable.en-US: This outline item has no locatable source or current display position.

heading.outlineEntrySummary.zh-CN: {p0}：{p1} 个直接子项／{p2} 个后代子项

workActivity.originalUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前窗口已不再持有这次原操作的详情，请从原恢复入口查看。
workActivity.originalUnavailable.en-US: This window no longer holds these original operation details. Use the original recovery entry.

workspaceDock.waitComposition.zh-CN: 请先完成当前输入，再调整布局。
workspaceDock.waitComposition.en-US: Finish the current input before changing the layout.

workspaceDock.emptySide.zh-CN: 从另一侧拖入视图，或从视图菜单打开。
workspaceDock.emptySide.en-US: Drag a view here or open one from the View menu.

workspaceDock.resizeHint.zh-CN: 上／下方向键调整分区高度，Shift 加速；Enter 均分。
workspaceDock.resizeHint.en-US: Use Up/Down to resize groups, Shift for larger steps, and Enter for equal heights.

workPanel.resizeHint.zh-CN: 使用上／下方向键调整高度，Shift 加速，Home 最小，End 最大，Enter 恢复默认。
workPanel.resizeHint.en-US: Use Up/Down to resize, Shift for larger steps, Home for minimum, End for maximum, Enter to reset.

workPanel.status.zh-CN: 工作面板：{p0} 个问题，{p1} 个待处理任务，{p2} 个结果
workPanel.status.en-US: Work panel: {p0} problems, {p1} tasks need attention, {p2} results

workPanel.problemsEmpty.zh-CN: 当前文档没有已报告的问题。
workPanel.problemsEmpty.en-US: No reported problems for the current document.

workPanel.tasksEmpty.zh-CN: 当前没有已报告的任务。

workPanel.resultsEmpty.zh-CN: 当前没有已生成的结果。

workPanel.preferenceUnavailable.zh-CN: 工作面板布局偏好暂时无法保存，本次仍可使用。
workPanel.preferenceUnavailable.en-US: Work panel layout preferences could not be saved; this session remains usable.

nodeContents.resourceUnavailable.zh-CN: 资源当前不可用，请刷新后重试。
nodeContents.resourceUnavailable.en-US: This resource is unavailable. Refresh and try again.

inventory.resourceNotListed.zh-CN: 所选文件已不在当前文件夹的可浏览清单中，请刷新节点视图。
inventory.resourceNotListed.en-US: The selected file is no longer in this folder’s browsable inventory. Refresh the Nodes view.

inventory.resourceReadChanged.zh-CN: 读取期间文件或所在目录发生变化，请刷新后重试。
inventory.resourceReadChanged.en-US: The file or its directory changed during reading. Refresh and try again.

inventory.resourceVersionChanged.zh-CN: 文件预览版本已变化，请刷新节点视图。
inventory.resourceVersionChanged.en-US: The file preview version changed. Refresh the Nodes view.

timeline.scope.zh-CN: 当前文档的已保存版本
timeline.scope.en-US: Saved versions of the current document

workspaceViews.chooseNode.en-US: Choose a node to browse its contents

workspaceViews.extensionsPending.zh-CN: 此扩展尚未实现。可在视图菜单中隐藏此选项卡。
workspaceViews.extensionsPending.en-US: This extension is not implemented yet. Hide this tab from the View menu.

workspaceViews.resourceScope.zh-CN: 资源属于当前浏览的文件夹，按只读方式打开。
workspaceViews.resourceScope.en-US: Resources belong to the browsed folder and open read-only.

locale.unsaved.zh-CN: 本次界面语言尚未可靠保存；当前稿和原操作未改变。
locale.unsaved.en-US: The interface language has not been durably saved. Your draft and original operation are unchanged.

locale.unavailable.zh-CN: 界面语言偏好暂不可读取，使用默认语言；当前稿和原操作未改变。
locale.unavailable.en-US: The interface language preference is unavailable. Using the default language; your draft and original operation are unchanged.

desktop.unsavedClose.zh-CN: 恢复稿尚未确认持久保存，窗口保持打开。
desktop.unsavedClose.en-US: The recovery draft is not confirmed durable. The window remains open.

desktop.waitingForInput.zh-CN: 正在等待输入完成和草稿保存。
desktop.waitingForInput.en-US: Waiting for input to finish and the draft to be saved.

desktop.startupDisabled.zh-CN: 系统已禁用登录启动；Weftext 不会自行恢复此设置。
desktop.startupDisabled.en-US: The system has disabled login startup. Weftext will not re-enable it automatically.

capture.pending.zh-CN: 原操作结果尚未确认；恢复稿和原编号已保留。
capture.pending.en-US: The original operation is unconfirmed. Its draft and original ID are retained.

reminder.activationEmpty.zh-CN: 此通知已没有可打开的有效任务。
reminder.activationEmpty.en-US: This notification has no currently available tasks.

reminder.activationLimited.zh-CN: 部分任务当前不可访问，请刷新后重试。
reminder.activationLimited.en-US: Some tasks are currently unavailable. Refresh and try again.

reminder.hostStatusLoading.zh-CN: 正在读取本机提醒服务状态。
reminder.hostStatusLoading.en-US: Reading the reminder service status on this device.

reminder.hostStatusUnavailable.zh-CN: 本机提醒服务状态读取失败；通知和调度是否可用尚未确认。
reminder.hostStatusUnavailable.en-US: The reminder service status could not be read. Notification and scheduling availability is unconfirmed.

reminder.desktopInactive.zh-CN: 本次连接没有活动的桌面提醒服务，不会提交系统通知。
reminder.desktopInactive.en-US: This connection has no active desktop reminder service and will not submit system notifications.

reminder.notificationUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前桌面环境不提供系统通知，提醒记录仍可在应用内查看。
reminder.notificationUnavailable.en-US: System notifications are unavailable in this desktop environment. Reminder records remain available in the app.

reminder.notificationUnknown.zh-CN: 系统通知是否可用尚未确认。

reminder.notificationEnabled.zh-CN: 系统允许此应用提交通知；勿扰、锁屏等系统设置仍决定是否显示。
reminder.notificationEnabled.en-US: The system allows this app to submit notifications. Do Not Disturb, lock-screen and other system settings still control their display.

reminder.notificationDisabledForApplicat.zh-CN: 系统设置已关闭 Weftext 通知；可在 Windows 通知设置中查看。
reminder.notificationDisabledForApplicat.en-US: System settings have disabled Weftext notifications. Check Windows notification settings.

reminder.notificationDisabledForUser.zh-CN: 当前 Windows 用户已关闭系统通知。
reminder.notificationDisabledForUser.en-US: System notifications are disabled for the current Windows user.

reminder.notificationDisabledByPolicy.zh-CN: 系统策略禁止此应用发送通知。
reminder.notificationDisabledByPolicy.en-US: System policy prevents this app from sending notifications.

reminder.notificationDisabledByManifest.zh-CN: 当前安装包没有可用的系统通知配置。
reminder.notificationDisabledByManifest.en-US: The current package does not have an available system notification configuration.

reminder.schedulingPaused.zh-CN: 提醒调度已暂停，暂不提交新的系统通知。
reminder.schedulingPaused.en-US: Reminder scheduling is paused. No new system notifications are being submitted.

reminder.schedulingRestricted.zh-CN: 提醒调度受限；请检查通知权限和下方的库或任务问题。
reminder.schedulingRestricted.en-US: Reminder scheduling is restricted. Check notification permissions and the library or task issues below.

reminder.schedulingStopping.zh-CN: 提醒服务正在退出，不再接收新的通知提交。
reminder.schedulingStopping.en-US: The reminder service is stopping and no longer accepts new notification submissions.

reminder.scanIncomplete.zh-CN: 本轮提醒检查尚未完成，不能据此判断没有待办。
reminder.scanIncomplete.en-US: This reminder scan is incomplete. It does not establish that there are no pending tasks.

reminder.scopeIssues.zh-CN: 本轮提醒检查发现 {count} 项问题；部分库、任务或原通知结果需要核对。
reminder.scopeIssues.en-US: This reminder scan found {count} issues. Some libraries, tasks or original notification results need checking.

reminder.enabledDevice.en-US: Enable this reminder on this device

reminder.submitted.zh-CN: 系统已接受提醒；不代表用户已读。
reminder.submitted.en-US: The system accepted the reminder. This does not mean it was read.

reminder.submissionReturnedSuccess.zh-CN: 系统通知调用返回成功；不代表用户已看到。
reminder.submissionReturnedSuccess.en-US: The notification call returned success. This does not mean the user saw it.

reminder.submissionReturnedFailure.zh-CN: 系统通知调用返回失败（HRESULT {hresult}）；此返回本身不能确定系统送达结果。
reminder.submissionReturnedFailure.en-US: The notification call returned failure (HRESULT {hresult}). This return alone does not establish the delivery outcome.

reminder.submissionObservationMissing.zh-CN: 没有实际系统通知调用的时间记录；账本确认时间不能替代调用时间。
reminder.submissionObservationMissing.en-US: No actual notification-call timing was recorded. Ledger confirmation time cannot substitute for call time.

reminder.ledgerConfirmedAt.zh-CN: 账本确认时间（UTC；可能来自后续系统历史核查）：{at}
reminder.ledgerConfirmedAt.en-US: Ledger confirmation time (UTC; may come from a later system-history check): {at}

reminder.unknown.zh-CN: 系统提交结果未知，未盲目重发。
reminder.unknown.en-US: The system submission result is unknown. It was not blindly resubmitted.

reminder.unavailable.zh-CN: 当前条件不允许提交系统通知。
reminder.unavailable.en-US: System notifications cannot be submitted under the current conditions.

reminder.missed.zh-CN: 有 {count} 项有效的错过提醒。

error.resourceRead.en-US: The resource could not be read.

cli.description.zh-CN: 正式命令行：读取、写作、查询、交换与同步。
cli.description.en-US: Command-line access for reading, writing, querying, interchange and synchronization.

cli.requestRetained.zh-CN: 准确原请求已保留在 {path}；原操作：{operationId}。
cli.requestRetained.en-US: The exact original request is retained at {path}; original operation: {operationId}.

cli.partial.zh-CN: 仅所述范围已完成，其余范围未计为成功。
cli.partial.en-US: Only the reported scope is complete. Other scope is not counted as successful.

cli.unknown.zh-CN: 原操作 {operationId} 的效果尚未确认；请求保留在 {path}，仅按原编号查询。
cli.unknown.en-US: The effect of original operation {operationId} is unconfirmed. Its request is retained at {path}; inspect the original ID.

cli.error.en-US: The command did not complete. Code: {code}.

cli.deliveryFailed.zh-CN: 本机交付未完成；原操作 {operationId} 与请求文件 {path} 已保留，不重复提交业务效果。
cli.deliveryFailed.en-US: Local delivery is incomplete. Original operation {operationId} and request file {path} are retained; the business effect is not resubmitted.

cli.requestFileRequired.zh-CN: 此命令可能产生持久或外部效果，须指定新的 request-file；首次发送前保存准确输入，不包含凭据。
cli.requestFileRequired.en-US: This command can have a persistent or external effect. Provide a new request-file to retain the exact input before its first submission, without credentials.

cli.invalidInput.zh-CN: 输入不完整、格式或 UTF-8 无效，或超出预算；未发送请求。
cli.invalidInput.en-US: Input is incomplete, has invalid format or UTF-8, or exceeds its budget. No request was sent.

cli.invalidEndpoint.zh-CN: 远端须明确使用不含用户信息、查询参数或片段的 HTTPS origin；不接受跨 origin 重定向。
cli.invalidEndpoint.en-US: A remote endpoint requires an explicit HTTPS origin without user information, query or fragment. Cross-origin redirects are rejected.

cli.credentialsRequired.zh-CN: 远端凭据从受保护文件或明确的环境变量读取；不接受包含密钥的命令行参数。
cli.credentialsRequired.en-US: Read remote credentials from a protected file or an explicit environment variable. Secret command-line arguments are not accepted.

cli.requestConflict.zh-CN: 原请求定位器或内容不一致，未重新发送。
cli.requestConflict.en-US: The original request locator or content differs. It was not resubmitted.

cli.unsupported.zh-CN: 当前执行端或命令未提供此能力。
cli.unsupported.en-US: This endpoint or command does not provide this capability.

cli.outputExists.zh-CN: 输出路径 {path} 已存在，拒绝覆盖原件。
cli.outputExists.en-US: Output path {path} already exists. The original is not overwritten.

cli.helpCommands.zh-CN: 使用 --help 查看命令；使用 <命令> --help 查看该命令的参数。
cli.helpCommands.en-US: Use --help to list commands, or <command> --help for that command's arguments.

reminder.at.zh-CN: 带显式偏移的精确瞬间
reminder.at.en-US: Exact instant with an explicit offset

reminder.minuteHelper.zh-CN: 按分钟填写，保留秒与小数
reminder.minuteHelper.en-US: Edit minutes; keep seconds and fractions

reminder.saveFirst.zh-CN: 先保存准确提醒再启用
reminder.saveFirst.en-US: Save the exact reminder before enabling it

reminder.libraryEnabled.en-US: Enable this library on this device

reminder.settingsPending.zh-CN: 本设备设置请求待确认
reminder.settingsPending.en-US: Device settings request outcome is unconfirmed

reminder.help.zh-CN: 按天截止的提醒须明确时区；精确时间保留已有秒数和偏移。
reminder.help.en-US: Date-only reminders require an explicit time zone. Exact times retain their seconds and offset.

reminder.invalidInput.zh-CN: 输入不完整或格式无效，请保留后修正
reminder.invalidInput.en-US: Input is incomplete or invalid; preserve it and correct it

reminder.pendingDiscardHelp.zh-CN: 放弃不会撤销可能已经生效的设置；刷新查看当前状态
reminder.pendingDiscardHelp.en-US: Discarding does not undo settings that may already have taken effect; refresh to inspect current state

reminder.noDeliveryRecords.zh-CN: 本设备尚无已记录的投递
reminder.noDeliveryRecords.en-US: No recorded deliveries on this device

heading.refreshNativeHeadings.zh-CN: 请刷新以取得同次原生编译的标题；不会按标题文字猜测源码位置。
heading.refreshNativeHeadings.en-US: Refresh to get headings from the same native compilation. Source positions are not guessed from heading text.

heading.searchPlaceholder.zh-CN: 搜索标题；清空恢复原折叠状态
heading.searchPlaceholder.en-US: Search headings; clear to restore the previous collapsed state

heading.scopeSummary.zh-CN: {p0} · 已展示 {p1} 个真实标题。文档根与同名一级标题各自存在；层级和子标题计数来自原生标题，不受搜索影响。
heading.scopeSummary.en-US: {p0} · Actual headings shown: {p1}. The document root and a top-level heading with the same name remain separate. Levels and descendant counts come from native headings and are unaffected by search.

heading.unconfirmedCoverage.zh-CN: 尚无完整同次原生编译，标题覆盖未确认。请刷新，不按原文猜造标题。
heading.unconfirmedCoverage.en-US: A complete native compilation from the same run is not available, so heading coverage is unconfirmed. Refresh; headings are not guessed from source text.

heading.truncated.zh-CN: 标题达到 5,000 项读取预算，结构已截断。
heading.truncated.en-US: The 5,000-heading read limit was reached. The structure is truncated.

heading.canvasLimit.zh-CN: 画布仅绘制 {p0} 项，下方标题列表保留本次范围全部结果。
heading.canvasLimit.en-US: The canvas draws only {p0} items. The heading list below retains all results in the current scope.

heading.levelAndDescendants.zh-CN: 真实层级 {p0} · {p1} 个直接子标题 · {p2} 个全部子标题
heading.levelAndDescendants.en-US: Actual level {p0} · Direct child headings: {p1} · All descendant headings: {p2}

heading.generatedNoAuthorAddress.zh-CN: 生成标题没有唯一作者写地址；仅按获证显示位置导航。
heading.generatedNoAuthorAddress.en-US: This generated heading has no unique authoring address. Navigation uses only its verified display position.

heading.navigateExactNativeRange.zh-CN: 按同次原生标题的准确源码范围导航。
heading.navigateExactNativeRange.en-US: Navigate using the exact source range of the heading from the same native compilation.

heading.layoutOnly.zh-CN: 只读标题结构；拖动只改变布局，不重排正文
heading.layoutOnly.en-US: Read-only heading structure; dragging changes the layout without reordering document content

heading.itemSummary.zh-CN: {p0}{p1} · {p2} 个直接子标题／{p3} 个全部子标题
heading.itemSummary.en-US: {p0}{p1} · Direct child headings: {p2} / All descendant headings: {p3}

everyday.searchKeyboardHint.zh-CN: 输入名称查找，方向键选择，Enter 执行
everyday.searchKeyboardHint.en-US: Type a name to search, use the arrow keys to select, and press Enter to run

graph.refreshAuthorizedSnapshot.zh-CN: 请刷新以取得当前获权关系快照。
graph.refreshAuthorizedSnapshot.en-US: Refresh to get the current authorized relationship snapshot.

graph.localScope.en-US: Local graph for the current note

graph.libraryScope.en-US: Library-wide graph for the current authorized scope

graph.tagTreeUnauthorizedOrIncomplete.zh-CN: 标签结构未获权或未完整读取；树筛选暂不可用。笔记权限与标签结构权限分别核对。
graph.tagTreeUnauthorizedOrIncomplete.en-US: The tag structure is unauthorized or has not been read completely. Tree filtering is unavailable. Note access and tag-structure access are checked separately.

graph.libraryDirectionHint.zh-CN: 全库显示全部方向；入向／出向和邻域深度以当前笔记为根，在局部图中启用。
graph.libraryDirectionHint.en-US: The library-wide view shows all directions. Incoming, outgoing, and neighborhood depth use the current note as the root and are available in the local graph.

graph.tagConditionUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 标签条件当前无法确认。
graph.tagConditionUnconfirmed.en-US: The tag condition cannot currently be confirmed.

graph.partialTagMembers.zh-CN: 标签条件仅显示本次独立获权且已确认的成员；未获权字段或失效标签保持未知，不作为完整空结果。
graph.partialTagMembers.en-US: The tag condition shows only independently authorized, confirmed members from this read. Unauthorized fields and invalid tags remain unknown; they are not treated as a complete empty result.

graph.scopeSummary.zh-CN: {p0} · 已展示 {p1} 个节点、{p2} 条关系。目录和标题不作为业务关系边。
graph.scopeSummary.en-US: {p0} · Nodes shown: {p1}; relationships shown: {p2}. Directories and headings are not treated as domain relationship edges.

graph.partialSourceCoverage.zh-CN: 关系来源部分覆盖：未确认的原生生成关系或字段保持未知；没有边不代表全库无关系。
graph.partialSourceCoverage.en-US: Relationship sources have partial coverage. Unconfirmed natively generated relationships or fields remain unknown. No edges does not mean the entire library has no relationships.

graph.truncatedRead.zh-CN: 读取达到节点或关系预算，结果已截断；未公开未读取或无权对象的数量。
graph.truncatedRead.en-US: The node or relationship read limit was reached, so results are truncated. Counts of unread or unauthorized objects are not disclosed.

graph.searchAria.zh-CN: 在当前图范围搜索定位
graph.searchAria.en-US: Search and locate within the current graph scope

graph.searchPlaceholder.zh-CN: 搜索当前范围；不会扩大图范围
graph.searchPlaceholder.en-US: Search the current scope without expanding the graph

graph.noMatchesInScope.zh-CN: 当前范围没有匹配；需要扩大范围时请明确修改范围或筛选。
graph.noMatchesInScope.en-US: No matches in the current scope. Change the scope or filters explicitly to search more broadly.

graph.cycleUsesGeneralLayout.zh-CN: 当前关系含循环；保留全部事实并采用一般布局。可在列表检查原关系。
graph.cycleUsesGeneralLayout.en-US: The current relationships contain a cycle. All facts are retained and the general layout is used. Inspect the original relationships in the list.

graph.canvasLimit.zh-CN: 画布仅绘制 {p0} 个节点、{p1} 条关系；下方列表保留本次范围全部结果。
graph.canvasLimit.en-US: The canvas draws only {p0} nodes and {p1} relationships. The list below retains all results in the current scope.

graph.keyboardInstructions.zh-CN: 关系图；方向键平移，节点 Enter 打开，空格选择，Esc 清选择
graph.keyboardInstructions.en-US: Relationship graph; use arrow keys to pan, Enter on a node to open, Space to select, and Esc to clear the selection

graph.derivedReverseSource.zh-CN: 派生反向；作者事实保存在原来源，不另写反边。
graph.derivedReverseSource.en-US: Derived reverse relationship. The authored fact remains at its original source; no separate reverse edge is written.

graph.readOnlyEditingHint.zh-CN: 图谱只读。新增或移除关系请在原始字段／正文入口按其独立权限编辑；拖动只调整布局。
graph.readOnlyEditingHint.en-US: The graph is read-only. Add or remove relationships through their original field or document entry points with their separate permissions. Dragging changes only the layout.

graph.selectionInstructions.zh-CN: 单击／空格选择节点或边查看详情；双击／Enter 打开笔记。选择和搜索不自动移动视口。
graph.selectionInstructions.en-US: Click or press Space to select a node or edge and view its details; double-click or press Enter to open a note. Selection and search do not automatically move the viewport.

graph.nodeKeyboardInstructions.zh-CN: 选择 {p0}；Enter 打开；Shift 加方向键调整个人布局
graph.nodeKeyboardInstructions.en-US: Select {p0}; press Enter to open; use Shift and the arrow keys to adjust your personal layout

tagPicker.fullPath.en-US: View the complete path by segments

tagPicker.unavailableSelection.zh-CN: 原选择当前不可用（保留身份）

tagPicker.pageSummary.zh-CN: 完整标签结构 · {p0} 个可选项 · 当前 {p1}–{p2}（每段最多 100）
tagPicker.pageSummary.en-US: Complete tag structure · Choices: {p0} · Showing {p1}–{p2} (up to 100 per page)

tagTree.incompleteTree.zh-CN: 标签结构未完整读取，不能将部分目录用作标签树或父级选择依据。
tagTree.incompleteTree.en-US: The tag structure has not been read completely. A partial catalog cannot be used as the basis for a tag tree or parent selection.

tagTree.budgetExceeded.zh-CN: 标签结构超过 5,000 条预算。

embeddedQuery.projectionChanged.zh-CN: 作者投影或字段配置已变化，保留的个人字段设置没有绑定到同名新列；请选择当前列或恢复个人默认。暂显示完整数据表。
embeddedQuery.projectionChanged.en-US: The author's projection or field configuration changed. Retained personal field settings have not been bound to new columns with the same names. Select current columns or restore personal defaults. Showing the complete data table for now.

embeddedQuery.builderApplyHelp.zh-CN: 应用是一个共享草稿操作，可与源码输入一起撤销；不保存笔记。未改动的原生成员和注释由后端保留。
embeddedQuery.builderApplyHelp.en-US: Applying is one shared draft operation and can be undone together with source input; it does not save the note. The backend preserves unchanged native members and comments.

embeddedQuery.removeCallHelp.en-US: Only this invocation is removed. Shared definitions and result notes are not deleted. Restore it with the same Undo history.

embeddedQuery.removeDefinitionHelp.zh-CN: 移除此处定义和呈现，不删除结果笔记。其它调用会明确显示定义不可用，不会级联删除。可用同一 Undo 恢复。
embeddedQuery.removeDefinitionHelp.en-US: This definition and display are removed; result notes are not deleted. Other invocations explicitly show the definition as unavailable; no cascading deletion occurs. Restore it with the same Undo history.

embeddedQuery.arrangementWriteUnavailabl.zh-CN: 当前没有准确的查询组织写入资格
embeddedQuery.arrangementWriteUnavailabl.en-US: There is currently no exact eligibility to write query organization

embeddedQuery.arrangementBasisChanged.en-US: The draft has changed. The organization operation was not applied

embeddedQuery.arrangementEligibilityChan.zh-CN: 确认期间输入或权限变化，保留当前草稿
embeddedQuery.arrangementEligibilityChan.en-US: Input or permissions changed during confirmation. The current draft is retained

embeddedQuery.editSourceUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前查询没有可写来源；输入提案保留。
embeddedQuery.editSourceUnavailable.en-US: The current query has no writable source. The input proposal is retained.

embeddedQuery.editBasisChanged.zh-CN: 打开编辑入口后草稿已变化；共享草稿与输入提案均保留，请重新核对。
embeddedQuery.editBasisChanged.en-US: The draft changed after the editor was opened. Both the shared draft and input proposal are retained; check them again.

embeddedQuery.editEligibilityChanged.zh-CN: 确认期间又有输入或编辑资格变化；提案保留，未覆盖共享草稿。
embeddedQuery.editEligibilityChanged.en-US: Input or edit eligibility changed again during confirmation. The proposal is retained and did not overwrite the shared draft.

embeddedQuery.sourceProposalLabel.zh-CN: {p0} 尚未应用的原生源码提案

embeddedQuery.sourceDialogHelp.zh-CN: 此窗口保留尚未应用的提案。取消不改共享草稿；确认只改打开时定位的查询范围，并进入同一撤销历史。
embeddedQuery.sourceDialogHelp.en-US: This window retains an unapplied proposal. Cancellation leaves the shared draft unchanged. Confirmation edits only the query range located when opened, within the same Undo history.

hostedQuery.environmentChanged.zh-CN: 库配置已变化，原冻结结果保留为旧依据；计划和参数未改，请明确重新运行。
hostedQuery.environmentChanged.en-US: Library configuration changed. The original frozen results are retained with their old basis; plan and parameters are unchanged. Rerun explicitly.

hostedQuery.catalogRefreshFailed.zh-CN: 当前定义目录刷新失败，原计划和冻结结果保留。
hostedQuery.catalogRefreshFailed.en-US: The current definition catalog could not be refreshed. The original plan and frozen results are retained.

hostedQuery.authorizationHelp.zh-CN: 字段、正文产品、关系与保存定义分别授权。这里编辑临时计划；运行和结果导航均不保存正文。
hostedQuery.authorizationHelp.en-US: Fields, body products, relationships and saved definitions are authorized separately. This edits a temporary plan; running it and navigating results do not save body content.

hostedQuery.catalogUnavailable.zh-CN: 查询目录暂不可用，原输入保留。
hostedQuery.catalogUnavailable.en-US: The query catalog is temporarily unavailable. Original input is retained.

hostedQuery.draftPersistenceFailed.zh-CN: 无法保留查询控件输入，请先复制计划与参数；查询不会修改正文。
hostedQuery.draftPersistenceFailed.en-US: Query control input cannot be retained. Copy the plan and parameters first; queries do not change body content.

hostedQuery.changedWhileBusy.zh-CN: 输入已更新，旧请求不会替换新计划或参数。原结果若保留，会标明对应先前输入。
hostedQuery.changedWhileBusy.en-US: Input was updated. The old request cannot replace the new plan or parameters. Retained results will be marked as corresponding to previous input.

hostedQuery.changedNotRun.zh-CN: 临时查询输入已更新，尚未运行当前计划；正文保持保留。
hostedQuery.changedNotRun.en-US: Temporary query input was updated. The current plan has not run yet; body content is retained.

hostedQuery.originalChoiceUnavailable.zh-CN: 保留的原选择 {p0} 当前不在获权目录；请重新选择后运行。
hostedQuery.originalChoiceUnavailable.en-US: Retained original selection {p0} is not in the current authorized catalog. Select again before running.

hostedQuery.seriesPolicySummary.en-US: {p0} · {p1} · {p2} · calendar {p3} · zone {p4}{p5}; related Providers must still be selected separately.

hostedQuery.originalDependencyChanged.zh-CN: 保留的原{p0}选择 {p1}（{p2}）当前不可用或已改版；请取消原选择或明确选择目录中的新版本，不会自动更新。
hostedQuery.originalDependencyChanged.en-US: Retained original {p0} selection {p1} ({p2}) is unavailable or has changed version. Remove the original selection or explicitly choose a new catalog version; it will not update automatically.

hostedQuery.noDependencies.en-US: No {p0} are available for selection this time.

hostedQuery.partialScopeCatalog.zh-CN: 获权范围目录部分可用；不可用项保留，不代表完整空范围。
hostedQuery.partialScopeCatalog.en-US: The authorized scope catalog is partially available. Unavailable items are retained; this is not a complete empty scope.

hostedQuery.allAuthorizedObjects.zh-CN: 全部明确获权对象（无目录限制）
hostedQuery.allAuthorizedObjects.en-US: All explicitly authorized objects (no directory restriction)

hostedQuery.retainedScopeChoice.zh-CN: 保留原范围 {p0}（不按同名替换）
hostedQuery.retainedScopeChoice.en-US: Retain original scope {p0} (no substitution by name)

hostedQuery.unappliedScopeHelp.en-US: Scope controls have not been applied to the temporary plan; running is paused. The original JSON and nested scopes are retained.

hostedQuery.invalidPlanScopeHelp.zh-CN: 完整计划 JSON 尚未有效；范围输入独立保留，应用不会替换或补全原 JSON。
hostedQuery.invalidPlanScopeHelp.en-US: The complete plan JSON is not valid yet. Scope input is retained separately; applying it does not replace or complete the original JSON.

hostedQuery.outerScopeHelp.zh-CN: 此计划的外层范围须保持默认；请在实际扫描分支或保存定义内设置范围，不会自动改写嵌套计划。
hostedQuery.outerScopeHelp.en-US: This plan's outer scope must remain at the default. Set scope in the actual scan branch or saved definition; nested plans are not rewritten automatically.

hostedQuery.scopeAuthorizationHelp.zh-CN: 只修改最外层 scope，不改 union、related 或保存定义调用中的嵌套范围。目录、回收站与字段/正文分别授权；结果不授恢复、删除或写入。
hostedQuery.scopeAuthorizationHelp.en-US: Only the outermost scope is changed, not nested scopes in union, related or saved-definition invocations. Directories, trash and fields/body are authorized separately. Results grant no restoration, deletion or write eligibility.

hostedQuery.unreadableRecovery.zh-CN: 查询恢复输入无法解析，原记录只读保留。

hostedQuery.completeCatalog.en-US: The authorized query catalog is complete for this read.

hostedQuery.partialCatalog.zh-CN: 获权查询目录部分可用；未取得的定义来源保持不可用，不视为不存在。
hostedQuery.partialCatalog.en-US: The authorized query catalog is partially available. Definition sources not obtained remain unavailable and are not treated as nonexistent.

hostedQuery.unknownCatalogCoverage.zh-CN: 查询目录完整性尚未取得。
hostedQuery.unknownCatalogCoverage.en-US: Query catalog completeness has not been obtained yet.

hostedQuery.partialDependencyCatalog.zh-CN: Provider 与系列政策目录部分可用；未取得的获权项保持不可用，不能按完整空目录处理。
hostedQuery.partialDependencyCatalog.en-US: The Provider and series policy catalogs are partially available. Authorized items not obtained remain unavailable; this cannot be treated as a complete empty catalog.

hostedQuery.definitionSourceUnavailable.zh-CN: 定义来源 {p0} 当前不可用；不能换用同名定义或当前版本。
hostedQuery.definitionSourceUnavailable.en-US: Definition source {p0} is currently unavailable. A definition with the same name or the current version cannot be substituted.

hostedQuery.providerUnavailable.zh-CN: 已获权 Provider {p0} 当前不可用；原选择保留。
hostedQuery.providerUnavailable.en-US: Authorized Provider {p0} is currently unavailable. The original selection is retained.

hostedQuery.seriesPolicyUnavailable.zh-CN: 已获权系列政策 {p0} 当前不可用；原选择保留。
hostedQuery.seriesPolicyUnavailable.en-US: Authorized series policy {p0} is currently unavailable. The original selection is retained.

hostedQuery.explicitDependencyHelp.zh-CN: Provider 与系列政策仅按本次准确指纹显式选择，不自动全选。这些选择也用于当前正文内嵌查询；保存定义的 current / pinned 选择仍独立，不会固定或改写本次 Provider 数据。
hostedQuery.explicitDependencyHelp.en-US: Providers and series policies are explicitly selected by their exact fingerprints from this read, without automatic selection of all items. These selections also apply to embedded queries in the current body. Saved definition current / pinned selection remains independent and does not pin or rewrite this run's Provider data.

hostedQuery.refreshCatalog.zh-CN: 刷新获权 Provider 与查询目录
hostedQuery.refreshCatalog.en-US: Refresh authorized Provider and query catalogs

hostedQuery.planControlsDisclosure.en-US: Property filtering, sorting and aggregate controls

hostedQuery.adoptControlProposal.zh-CN: 采用控件提案到临时查询
hostedQuery.adoptControlProposal.en-US: Adopt control proposal into temporary query

hostedQuery.controlProposalSuperseded.zh-CN: 完整计划已变化，控件提案保留，未覆盖新计划。
hostedQuery.controlProposalSuperseded.en-US: The complete plan has changed. The control proposal is retained and did not overwrite the new plan.

hostedQuery.nativeExampleHelp.en-US: Examples remain native Query plans. The same executor validates complete CEL, types, relationships and definition authorization at run time. Parameters, union, distinct, group, unnest and saved-definition invocations can be combined directly in the complete plan.

hostedQuery.tagsDisclosure.zh-CN: 标签范围 · 独立获权完整结构
hostedQuery.tagsDisclosure.en-US: Tag scope · complete structure with separate authorization

hostedQuery.addTagCondition.zh-CN: 将明确标签条件加入临时计划
hostedQuery.addTagCondition.en-US: Add explicit tag condition to temporary plan

hostedQuery.tagRequired.zh-CN: 请明确选择当前合格标签。
hostedQuery.tagRequired.en-US: Explicitly select a currently eligible tag.

hostedQuery.nestedTagConditionRefused.zh-CN: 保存定义调用／union 的条件须在实际扫描定义内修改，原计划保留。
hostedQuery.nestedTagConditionRefused.en-US: Conditions in saved-definition invocations / union must be changed in the actual scan definition. The original plan is retained.

hostedQuery.tagsFieldUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前获权 Schema 没有可用的 tags 字段。
hostedQuery.tagsFieldUnavailable.en-US: The current authorized Schema has no available tags field.

hostedQuery.tagScopeHelp.zh-CN: 默认包含自身及子级；模式写入原 Query 条件，保存和重开保持语义。注册表可读不授予笔记、字段或结果读取权。
hostedQuery.tagScopeHelp.en-US: Includes this tag and descendants by default. The mode is written into the original Query condition, preserving semantics on save and reopen. Registry read access grants no note, field or result read permission.

hostedQuery.currentDefinitionChoice.en-US: Current definition (reads current data each time)

hostedQuery.pinnedDefinitionChoice.zh-CN: 固定定义版本（仍读取当前数据）
hostedQuery.pinnedDefinitionChoice.en-US: Pinned definition revision (still reads current data)

hostedQuery.createCall.en-US: Create temporary invocation from this saved definition

hostedQuery.definitionRequired.en-US: Select an exact saved definition first.

hostedQuery.definitionKeyMismatch.en-US: The saved-definition receipt did not retain the exact key. A different definition with the same name was not adopted.

hostedQuery.runningInputHelp.en-US: Running with explicitly authorized input. New plans and parameters can still be edited while waiting.

hostedQuery.scopeDecisionRequired.zh-CN: 范围控件尚未应用到临时计划，请明确应用或放弃原范围输入后再运行。
hostedQuery.scopeDecisionRequired.en-US: Scope controls have not been applied to the temporary plan. Explicitly apply or discard the original scope input before running.

hostedQuery.objectAuthorizationChanged.en-US: Query object authorization changed. Original input is retained; select again.

hostedQuery.frozenResultsObtained.zh-CN: 已取得本次冻结结果；定义和个人正文草稿均未保存。
hostedQuery.frozenResultsObtained.en-US: Frozen results for this run were obtained. Neither definitions nor personal body drafts were saved.

hostedQuery.previousInputSuffix.en-US: · corresponds to previous plan or parameters

hostedQuery.aggregateKnownInputHelp.en-US: This aggregate applies only to known input and does not represent the full total.

hostedQuery.partialEmpty.zh-CN: 已知范围没有结果，不能断言完整为空。
hostedQuery.partialEmpty.en-US: No results in the known scope. This does not establish complete emptiness.

hostedQuery.outputOffice.en-US: Send original frozen query to Office

error.networkRequest.zh-CN: 网络请求未完成；原操作的结果尚待核对。
error.networkRequest.en-US: The network request did not complete; the original operation outcome still needs to be checked.

nodeContents.thumbnailBasisMissing.zh-CN: 缩略图不可用：当前扫描缺少准确笔记依据。
nodeContents.thumbnailBasisMissing.en-US: Thumbnail unavailable: the current scan has no exact note basis.

nodeContents.thumbnailAuthorityMissing.en-US: This item has no independently verifiable authorized note resource thumbnail.

nodeContents.noFilterMatch.zh-CN: 当前筛选没有匹配项目。

nodeContents.emptyNode.en-US: This node has no contents yet.

processingSettings.languageIndependenceH.zh-CN: 这是库共享的处理建议与词表，经库设置权限、历史和同步保存。文档排版语言仍由原生 Typst 决定；个人选择不会自动写入这里。地区与文字体系可未知，空语言列表不从界面或系统推断。

Native Typst still controls document layout language; personal choices are not written here automatically. Region and script may be unknown, and an empty language list is not inferred from the interface or system.

hostedFields.inputIncomplete.en-US: Field input is incomplete. The original text is retained; complete the input before saving.

hostedFields.completeInputBeforeStructur.en-US: Complete invalid input before changing the field structure.

hostedFields.readOnlyHelp.zh-CN: 当前字段只读；需确认静态值、已安装 Schema 与校验依赖授权。
hostedFields.readOnlyHelp.en-US: The current field is read-only. Check static values, the installed Schema and authorization for validation dependencies.

hostedFields.invalidInputRetained.zh-CN: 字段输入无效，原文已保留；请完成输入后再保存。
hostedFields.invalidInputRetained.en-US: Field input is invalid. The original text is retained; complete the input before saving.

hostedFields.adoptCurrentBasis.zh-CN: 已核对，采用当前字段依据

hostedFields.unsavedInputBeforeTagCreati.zh-CN: 字段还有未保存输入。请先明确保存或放弃字段修改；新建不会替你保存这些输入。
hostedFields.unsavedInputBeforeTagCreati.en-US: This field still has unsaved input. Explicitly save or discard field changes first; creating a tag does not save them for you.

hostedFields.commitOriginalCreateAssign.zh-CN: 明确提交原新建与赋值计划
hostedFields.commitOriginalCreateAssign.en-US: Explicitly submit original creation and assignment plan

hostedFields.inspectOriginalCreateAssign.zh-CN: 核对原标签新建与赋值操作
hostedFields.inspectOriginalCreateAssign.en-US: Inspect original tag creation and assignment operation

hostedFields.cancelOriginalCreateAssign.zh-CN: 取消原未提交新建与赋值
hostedFields.cancelOriginalCreateAssign.en-US: Cancel original uncommitted creation and assignment

hostedFields.finishTagRecord.zh-CN: 结束已核对记录，继续字段编辑
hostedFields.finishTagRecord.en-US: Finish checked record and continue field editing

hostedFields.directAssignmentHelp.zh-CN: 只写新标签的直接引用；父级不自动赋值。准备、提交、取消和重启均核对同一编号，正文草稿独立保留。
hostedFields.directAssignmentHelp.en-US: Only the new tag's direct reference is written; its parent is not assigned automatically. Preparation, submission, cancellation and restart check the same ID. Body drafts are retained separately.

hostedFields.createAssignCommitted.zh-CN: 原新建与首次赋值已提交。字段已回读；其他草稿与期间输入保留，继续写入前请核对新依据。
hostedFields.createAssignCommitted.en-US: Original creation and initial assignment were committed. The field was read back; other drafts and input entered in the meantime are retained. Check the new basis before writing again.

hostedFields.createAssignPrepared.zh-CN: 新标签与首次赋值同一计划已准备，请核对后明确提交。
hostedFields.createAssignPrepared.en-US: The shared plan for the new tag and initial assignment is prepared. Check it and submit explicitly.

hostedFields.tagFactsChecked.zh-CN: 原标签操作事实已核对，未将未提交状态冒作成功。
hostedFields.tagFactsChecked.en-US: The original tag operation's facts were checked. An uncommitted state was not reported as success.

hostedFields.originalSaved.zh-CN: 原字段操作已保存。继续编辑前，请重新读取并核对当前字段。
hostedFields.originalSaved.en-US: The original field operation was saved. Read and check the current field again before continuing to edit.

hostedFields.originalEndedUncommitted.zh-CN: 原操作已明确结束，未确认提交；输入保留。请重新读取并核对。
hostedFields.originalEndedUncommitted.en-US: The original operation explicitly ended without confirmed submission. Input is retained. Read and check again.

hostedFields.originalCancelled.zh-CN: 原操作已取消，输入保留。请重新读取并核对。
hostedFields.originalCancelled.en-US: The original operation was cancelled. Input is retained. Read and check again.

hostedFields.originalUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 原操作尚未确认，请保留输入并继续核对。
hostedFields.originalUnconfirmed.en-US: The original operation is not yet confirmed. Retain input and continue checking.

hostedStructure.inputsLabel.zh-CN: 明确选取的获权引用输入

hostedStructure.authorizationHelp.zh-CN: 节点动作、目标接收与正文读取分别授权。名称和父位置使用批准的固定槽位；原个人正文不自动保存、复制或替换。
hostedStructure.authorizationHelp.en-US: Node actions, destination acceptance and body reading are authorized separately. Names and parent locations use approved fixed slots; original personal body content is not saved, copied or replaced automatically.

hostedStructure.restoreReceiptRequiredSu.en-US: (currently unavailable; restore requires the original receipt)

hostedStructure.partialCatalog.zh-CN: 结构目录部分可用；不可用获权位置保留，未当作完整空目录。
hostedStructure.partialCatalog.en-US: The structure catalog is partially available. Unavailable authorized locations are retained; this is not treated as a complete empty catalog.

hostedStructure.completeCatalog.zh-CN: 结构目录完整；仅列此用户明确获权的源与固定目标。
hostedStructure.completeCatalog.en-US: The structure catalog is complete; only sources and fixed destinations explicitly authorized for this user are listed.

hostedStructure.recoveryReadOnly.zh-CN: 原结构恢复记录不可写，请先核对原记录。
hostedStructure.recoveryReadOnly.en-US: The original structure recovery record is not writable. Check the original record first.

hostedStructure.recoveryPersistenceFaile.zh-CN: 浏览器恢复缓存容量不足或不可写；结构输入仍保留，未发起新的结构写入。
hostedStructure.recoveryPersistenceFaile.en-US: The browser recovery cache is full or not writable. Structure input is retained; no new structure write was started.

hostedStructure.resultUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 结构结果尚未确认，请保留原编号。
hostedStructure.resultUnconfirmed.en-US: The structure result is not yet confirmed. Retain the original ID.

hostedStructure.captureTitle.zh-CN: 新笔记类型与原生属性
hostedStructure.captureTitle.en-US: New note types and native properties

hostedStructure.clearCapture.zh-CN: 明确清空本次类型与属性
hostedStructure.clearCapture.en-US: Explicitly clear this run's types and properties

hostedStructure.captureUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前固定槽位的属性表单不可用；类型和值输入保留，未读取本地 Schema。
hostedStructure.captureUnavailable.en-US: The property form for the current fixed slot is unavailable. Type and value input is retained; no local Schema was read.

hostedStructure.unmatchedField.zh-CN: 原属性 {p0} 未匹配当前所选类型，原值保留：{p1}
hostedStructure.unmatchedField.en-US: Original property {p0} does not match the currently selected types. The original value is retained: {p1}

hostedStructure.rawInputUnrepresentable.zh-CN: 原输入不能由当前控件表示，请明确重新输入或放弃原文。
hostedStructure.rawInputUnrepresentable.en-US: The original input cannot be represented by the current control. Explicitly re-enter it or discard the original text.

hostedStructure.inputIncomplete.zh-CN: 属性输入尚未完成，原文保留，请完成输入后调整结构。
hostedStructure.inputIncomplete.en-US: Property input is incomplete. The original text is retained; complete input before changing the structure.

hostedStructure.unmatchedRawInputHelp.zh-CN: 原无效输入没有匹配当前表单，原文保留；请重新核对或明确放弃后再准备。
hostedStructure.unmatchedRawInputHelp.en-US: Original invalid input does not match the current form. The original text is retained; check it again or explicitly discard it before preparation.

hostedStructure.discardUnmatchedRaw.zh-CN: 明确放弃未匹配的属性原文
hostedStructure.discardUnmatchedRaw.en-US: Explicitly discard unmatched original property text

hostedStructure.invalidInputBeforePrepar.zh-CN: 属性输入无效，原文已保留，未发起结构准备。
hostedStructure.invalidInputBeforePrepar.en-US: Property input is invalid. Original text is retained; structure preparation was not started.

hostedStructure.requiredFieldsOrConflict.zh-CN: 请核对类型冲突或填写必需属性，原输入保留。
hostedStructure.requiredFieldsOrConflict.en-US: Check type conflicts or fill in required properties. Original input is retained.

hostedStructure.originalCommitted.zh-CN: 原结构操作已提交；当前个人草稿与后续输入保留，新对象仍需独立获权后明确打开。
hostedStructure.originalCommitted.en-US: The original structure operation was committed. Current personal drafts and subsequent input are retained; new objects still require separate authorization before they are explicitly opened.

hostedStructure.originalPrepared.zh-CN: 原计划已准备；请核对固定名称、位置、变化和损失后明确提交。
hostedStructure.originalPrepared.en-US: The original plan is prepared. Check fixed names, locations, changes and losses before explicit submission.

hostedStructure.originalEnded.zh-CN: 原结构操作已结束，未冒作已创建或保存。
hostedStructure.originalEnded.en-US: The original structure operation ended. It was not reported as created or saved.

hostedStructure.originalPending.zh-CN: 原操作仍待核对，不会换编号重放当前输入。
hostedStructure.originalPending.en-US: The original operation still needs checking. The current input will not be replayed under a different ID.

hostedStructure.unreadableRecovery.zh-CN: 结构恢复记录无法解析，原文保留，未发起新的操作。
hostedStructure.unreadableRecovery.en-US: The structure recovery record cannot be parsed. Original text is retained; no new operation was started.

hostedStructure.discardRecovery.zh-CN: 明确放弃损坏的结构恢复记录
hostedStructure.discardRecovery.en-US: Explicitly discard damaged structure recovery record

hostedStructure.acceptLossesLabel.zh-CN: 接受原结构计划列出的损失
hostedStructure.acceptLossesLabel.en-US: Accept losses listed in the original structure plan

hostedStructure.inputIntentChanged.en-US: Later input or a change away and back altered the intent. The old plan cannot submit the new current input; inspect or end the original operation.

hostedStructure.retryOriginalPrepare.zh-CN: 按原请求重试结构准备
hostedStructure.retryOriginalPrepare.en-US: Retry structure preparation with the original request

hostedStructure.commitEligibilityChanged.zh-CN: 原输入或固定槽位资格已变化，未提交旧计划。
hostedStructure.commitEligibilityChanged.en-US: Original input or fixed-slot eligibility changed. The old plan was not submitted.

hostedStructure.acceptLossesRequired.zh-CN: 请核对并明确接受原计划列出的损失。
hostedStructure.acceptLossesRequired.en-US: Check and explicitly accept losses listed in the original plan.

hostedStructure.protectBasisChanged.zh-CN: 保护草稿期间输入或固定槽位已变化，未发送旧计划。
hostedStructure.protectBasisChanged.en-US: Input or the fixed slot changed while protecting the draft. The old plan was not sent.

hostedStructure.settleOriginal.zh-CN: 结束未安装的原结构操作
hostedStructure.settleOriginal.en-US: End original structure operation that was not installed

hostedStructure.openAuthorizedResult.zh-CN: 明确打开获权结构结果

hostedStructure.committedOpenUnavailable.zh-CN: 已提交事实保留，当前没有独立获权的正文打开入口。
hostedStructure.committedOpenUnavailable.en-US: The committed fact is retained. No separately authorized body entry point is currently available.

hostedStructure.clearEndedReceipt.zh-CN: 清除本页已结束结构回执，保留当前输入
hostedStructure.clearEndedReceipt.en-US: Clear this page's ended structure receipt and retain current input

recognition.purposeKeepOriginal.en-US: Keep the original as a resource

recognition.purposeEditableNote.zh-CN: 生成可编辑笔记（保留原件）
recognition.purposeEditableNote.en-US: Create an editable note (keep the original)

recognition.wordUnconvertedStructures.zh-CN: 此 Word 原件包含当前公文方案不能完整转换的修订、文本框、绘图或主动内容；完整信息保留在原件，必要时使用普通 Word 导入。
recognition.wordUnconvertedStructures.en-US: This Word original contains tracked changes, text boxes, drawings, or active content that the current official-document scheme cannot fully convert. Complete information remains in the original; use ordinary Word import if needed.

recognition.wordActiveContentNotRun.zh-CN: Word 主动内容未执行，保留原件核对。
recognition.wordActiveContentNotRun.en-US: Word active content was not executed. Keep the original for review.

recognition.wordStylesUncertain.zh-CN: Word 样式无法可靠解析，相关块按原文核对。
recognition.wordStylesUncertain.en-US: Word styles could not be parsed reliably. Review the affected blocks against the original.

recognition.wordNumberingUncertain.zh-CN: Word 编号关系无法可靠解析，不自动重建编号。
recognition.wordNumberingUncertain.en-US: Word numbering relationships could not be parsed reliably. Numbering is not rebuilt automatically.

recognition.issueInterruptedCheckpoints.zh-CN: 后台作业已中断，只保留中断前逐页检查点，尚未完成最终核验。
recognition.issueInterruptedCheckpoints.en-US: The background job was interrupted. Only page checkpoints saved before the interruption remain; final verification is incomplete.

recognition.issuePageUnprocessed.zh-CN: 此页在作业中断前未处理。
recognition.issuePageUnprocessed.en-US: This page was not processed before the job was interrupted.

recognition.issueLowConfidence.zh-CN: 存在低可信识别文字，请对照原件核对。
recognition.issueLowConfidence.en-US: Some recognized text has low confidence. Review it against the original.

recognition.issueNoTextInNonblankRegion.zh-CN: 此区域不是空白，但没有识别出文字。
recognition.issueNoTextInNonblankRegion.en-US: This region is not blank, but no text was recognized.

recognition.issueUnmappedPdfCharacters.zh-CN: PDF 存在无法可靠映射的字符。
recognition.issueUnmappedPdfCharacters.en-US: The PDF contains characters that cannot be mapped reliably.

recognition.issueCrossBoundaryText.zh-CN: 文字跨越所选区域边界，不能当作完整区域。
recognition.issueCrossBoundaryText.en-US: Text crosses the selected region boundary, so the region cannot be treated as complete.

recognition.issueImageBudget.zh-CN: 图片对象数量超过本次处理预算。
recognition.issueImageBudget.en-US: The number of image objects exceeds this job’s processing limit.

recognition.issueNestedImageGeometry.zh-CN: 嵌套图片几何无法自动确定，请明确选择原页区域。
recognition.issueNestedImageGeometry.en-US: Nested-image geometry cannot be determined automatically. Select an original-page region explicitly.

recognition.issueInvoiceTotalsAmbiguous.zh-CN: 发票汇总列存在歧义，请逐项核对。
recognition.issueInvoiceTotalsAmbiguous.en-US: Invoice total columns are ambiguous. Review each item.

recognition.issueMultipleInvoiceNumbers.zh-CN: 存在多个发票号码候选，未自动拼接。
recognition.issueMultipleInvoiceNumbers.en-US: Multiple invoice-number candidates were found. They were not joined automatically.

recognition.issueCurrencyMissing.zh-CN: 原件未明确写出币种，不按地区补齐。
recognition.issueCurrencyMissing.en-US: The original does not specify a currency. It is not inferred from the region.

recognition.issueInvoiceTotalMismatch.zh-CN: 金额加税额与合计不符，仅提示核对，不自动改票。
recognition.issueInvoiceTotalMismatch.en-US: Amount plus tax does not match the total. This is a review notice; the invoice is not corrected automatically.

recognition.issueFieldsAndStructureNeedR.zh-CN: 字段与按文字模式识别的结构均需逐项确认。
recognition.issueFieldsAndStructureNeedR.en-US: Both fields and text-pattern structures require confirmation item by item.

recognition.issuePartialSourceScope.zh-CN: 来源处理范围不完整，须明确接受部分结果。
recognition.issuePartialSourceScope.en-US: Source processing is incomplete. Accept the partial result explicitly.

recognition.methodAutoFull.zh-CN: 自动选文本层／缺失区域 OCR
recognition.methodAutoFull.en-US: Automatically use text layers / OCR for missing regions

recognition.chooseAuthorizedEmptySlot.en-US: Choose an authorized empty slot explicitly

recognition.inspectOriginalOnly.zh-CN: 只检查原件页数与尺寸
recognition.inspectOriginalOnly.en-US: Inspect the original page count and dimensions only

recognition.prepareReviewedImport.zh-CN: 准备已核对的导入计划

recognition.pagesLabel.zh-CN: 页码（如 1,3-5；仅处理明确所选页）
recognition.pagesLabel.en-US: Pages (for example 1,3-5; only explicitly selected pages are processed)

recognition.rectangleLabel.zh-CN: 区域（左,上,右,下；空白表示整页）
recognition.rectangleLabel.en-US: Region (left,top,right,bottom; leave blank for the whole page)

recognition.regionDetailsHelp.zh-CN: 需要同页多个不重叠区域时，逐项填写名称、原页坐标与各自识别方式。下面的区域行优先于上方统一区域；未填写区域行的所选页仍按上方设置处理。缩放仅改变识别用图，定位仍使用原页坐标。
recognition.regionDetailsHelp.en-US: For multiple nonoverlapping regions on one page, enter each name, original-page coordinates, and recognition method. Region rows take precedence over the common region above; selected pages without region rows use the settings above. Scaling changes only the recognition image; locations still use original-page coordinates.

recognition.reviewOriginalHelp.zh-CN: 先保原件，再核对所选页、文字、阅读顺序和字段。识别语言独立于新笔记的文档语言；本次选择不修改资料库默认设置。
recognition.reviewOriginalHelp.en-US: Keep the original first, then review selected pages, text, reading order, and fields. Recognition language is independent of the new note’s document language. This selection does not change library defaults.
