media.playerTickHelp.zh-CN: 播放器位置取最接近的已验证时基 tick；下方显示最终整数与准确秒数比例。播放或拖动不会自动改变已选端点。
media.playerTickHelp.en-US: The player position uses the nearest tick on the verified timebase. Final integers and the exact seconds ratio are shown below. Playback or dragging does not automatically change selected endpoints.

media.exactRegionUnavailable.zh-CN: 此媒体暂无法建立准确区域
media.exactRegionUnavailable.en-US: An exact region cannot currently be established for this media

hostedMedia.authorizationHelp.zh-CN: 查看、下载与媒体批注分别授权。资源查看不打开或保存正文；回收站资源仅供只读查看。
hostedMedia.authorizationHelp.en-US: Viewing, downloading, and media annotations require separate authorization. Resource viewing does not open or save document content; trashed resources are read-only.

hostedMedia.resourceUnavailable.zh-CN: 资源当前不可用，未采用其他版本。
hostedMedia.resourceUnavailable.en-US: The resource is unavailable. No other version was substituted.

hostedMedia.catalogScopeMissing.zh-CN: 媒体目录缺少获权范围或完整性状态。
hostedMedia.catalogScopeMissing.en-US: The media catalog lacks authorized scope or completeness status.

hostedMedia.catalogPartial.zh-CN: 资源目录部分可用；不可用获权条目保留，不能当作完整空集合。
hostedMedia.catalogPartial.en-US: The resource catalog is partially available. Unavailable authorized entries are retained; this is not treated as a complete empty collection.

hostedMedia.catalogExplicitScopeHelp.zh-CN: 只列显式获权资源；选择后读取准确版本。
hostedMedia.catalogExplicitScopeHelp.en-US: Only explicitly authorized resources are listed. Selecting one reads its exact version.

hostedMedia.catalogEmptyComplete.zh-CN: 本次获权目录完整，无可交付资源。
hostedMedia.catalogEmptyComplete.en-US: The current authorized catalog is complete, with no deliverable resources.

hostedMedia.resolvingStableReference.zh-CN: 正在独立解析获权稳定资源引用…
hostedMedia.resolvingStableReference.en-US: Resolving the authorized stable resource reference independently…

hostedMedia.stableReferenceResolved.zh-CN: 稳定资源引用已独立获权解析；准确版本的读取与解码状态见下方查看器。
hostedMedia.stableReferenceResolved.en-US: The stable resource reference was resolved with separate authorization. See the viewer below for the exact version’s read and decode status.

hostedMedia.selectionUnavailable.zh-CN: 所选资源当前不可用；未按名称或路径猜测替代项。
hostedMedia.selectionUnavailable.en-US: The selected resource is unavailable. No replacement was guessed from a name or path.

hostedMedia.originalVersionChanged.zh-CN: 原资源版本已变化；目标输入保留，未改用最新版。
hostedMedia.originalVersionChanged.en-US: The original resource version changed. Target input is retained; the latest version was not substituted.

hostedMedia.viewerRequestMismatch.zh-CN: 查看器请求不对应原准确资源。
hostedMedia.viewerRequestMismatch.en-US: The viewer request does not correspond to the original exact resource.

hostedMedia.downloadUnauthorized.zh-CN: 此资源没有独立下载资格。
hostedMedia.downloadUnauthorized.en-US: This resource has no separate download permission.

hostedMedia.viewContextChanged.zh-CN: 资源查看上下文已变化，停止原字节交付。
hostedMedia.viewContextChanged.en-US: The resource-viewing context changed. Original byte delivery was stopped.

hostedMedia.blobValidationFailed.zh-CN: 资源长度、摘要或当前资格不符，未生成查看/下载 Blob。
hostedMedia.blobValidationFailed.en-US: Resource length, digest, or current access does not match. No viewing/download Blob was created.

hostedMedia.downloadComplete.zh-CN: 已下载独立获权、校验完整的原资源版本。
hostedMedia.downloadComplete.en-US: The independently authorized, fully verified original resource version was downloaded.

hostedMedia.trashAnnotationDisabledSuffi.zh-CN: · 回收站只读，不能创建或移动批注目标
hostedMedia.trashAnnotationDisabledSuffi.en-US: · Trash is read-only; annotation targets cannot be created or moved

hostedMedia.readAnnotationDiscussion.zh-CN: 读取此资源的批注讨论

syncPanel.recoveryRecordUnreadable.zh-CN: 保存的同步操作记录无法读取；请保留浏览器记录并检查恢复记录。
syncPanel.recoveryRecordUnreadable.en-US: The saved sync operation record cannot be read. Preserve browser records and inspect recovery records.

syncPanel.pairIdentityLabel.zh-CN: 配对身份（从原副本复制）
syncPanel.pairIdentityLabel.en-US: Pairing identity (copy from the original replica)

syncPanel.transportLabel.zh-CN: 交换目录路径（新目录或已配对目录）
syncPanel.transportLabel.en-US: Exchange directory path (new or already paired directory)

syncPanel.originalOperationLabel.zh-CN: 原同步操作编号（地址变化或浏览器记录丢失时）
syncPanel.originalOperationLabel.en-US: Original sync operation ID (if the address changes or browser records are lost)

syncValidation.pairIdentityRequired.zh-CN: 请输入原副本的完整配对身份。
syncValidation.pairIdentityRequired.en-US: Enter the original replica's complete pairing identity.

syncValidation.localRootRequired.zh-CN: 请输入本机资料库路径。

syncPanel.originalRetainedSuffix.zh-CN: 原操作记录保留，可检查原结果。
syncPanel.originalRetainedSuffix.en-US: The original operation record is retained; inspect its original result.

syncValidation.originalOperationPending.en-US: Resolve the original sync operation first.

syncValidation.reviewBasisChanged.zh-CN: 读取期间同步依据已变化，请重新打开语义审阅。
syncValidation.reviewBasisChanged.en-US: The sync basis changed while reading. Reopen semantic review.

syncPanel.filePreviewUnavailable.zh-CN: 二进制文件或超过文本预览预算：{p0} 字节。
syncPanel.filePreviewUnavailable.en-US: Binary file or beyond the text preview budget: {p0} bytes.

syncPanel.previewBranchAdoption.en-US: Preview adoption of this complete branch

syncPanel.branchAdoptionHelp.zh-CN: 采用此分支会选择它的完整正文、批注、资源和位置。双方原版本仍保留在历史中。
syncPanel.branchAdoptionHelp.en-US: Adopting this branch selects its complete body, annotations, resources and location. Both original versions remain in history.

syncPanel.receivedHistoryHelp.zh-CN: 此处只读检查已收到的版本，不改变本机文档或草稿。列表按提交编号分页，不代表时间先后；因果关系见各版本的父提交与前置版本。接收新记录后可重新读取首页。
syncPanel.receivedHistoryHelp.en-US: This read-only view inspects received versions without changing local documents or drafts. Pages follow commit IDs, not chronological order; see each version's parent commits and predecessor versions for causality. After receiving new records, reload the first page.

syncPanel.receivedRecordsAdmitted.zh-CN: 当前已收到的对象记录均已接纳；这不表示本机已经安装这些版本，也不表示远端历史已经全部收到。
syncPanel.receivedRecordsAdmitted.en-US: All currently received object records have been admitted. This does not mean they are installed locally or that all remote history has been received.

syncPanel.receivedRecordsPartial.zh-CN: 当前已收到的对象记录中有尚未接纳的版本；缺件或拒绝记录不可读取正文。
syncPanel.receivedRecordsPartial.en-US: Some currently received object records are not admitted. Body content cannot be read from records with missing parts or rejection.

syncPanel.noReceivedHistory.zh-CN: 当前未收到此对象的历史记录。
syncPanel.noReceivedHistory.en-US: No history record for this object has been received yet.

syncPanel.notInstalledSuffix.en-US: · this version is not installed locally

syncPanel.replicaSummary.zh-CN: 副本 {p0} · {p1} · 已安装 {p2} 个对象 · 待发布 {p3} 笔本地提交
syncPanel.replicaSummary.en-US: Replica {p0} · {p1} · {p2} installed objects · {p3} local commits awaiting publication

syncPanel.notEnabledHelp.zh-CN: 此路径尚未启用同步。可以启用现有资料库，或接收历史后在尚不存在的路径创建独立副本。
syncPanel.notEnabledHelp.en-US: Sync is not enabled at this path. Enable it for an existing library, or receive history and create an independent replica at a path that does not yet exist.

syncPanel.previewExternalAdoption.zh-CN: 预览采纳当前外部修改
syncPanel.previewExternalAdoption.en-US: Preview adoption of current external changes

syncPanel.receivedSummary.zh-CN: 接收历史：{p0} 笔提交 · {p1} 个因果分支头

syncPanel.receiveScopeHelp.zh-CN: 接收不改变本机文件。所选对象会带上原事务及依赖闭包；准确影响范围以应用预览为准。版本编号不表示时间顺序。
syncPanel.receiveScopeHelp.en-US: Receiving does not change local files. Selected objects include their original transactions and dependency closure; the application preview determines the exact impact. Version IDs do not indicate chronological order.

syncPanel.unsettledCommitCount.zh-CN: {p0} 笔历史提交有缺件、拒绝或依赖与当前版本不同
syncPanel.unsettledCommitCount.en-US: {p0} historical commits have missing parts, rejection or dependencies differing from current versions

syncPanel.historicalDependencyHelp.zh-CN: 旧提交的依赖与当前不同并不表示所有对象被阻止；实际所选版本能否应用，以准备结果为准。
syncPanel.historicalDependencyHelp.en-US: Old commits having different dependencies does not block every object. Preparation determines whether the actual selected version can be applied.

syncPanel.externalAdoptionHelp.zh-CN: 明确采纳本机已存在的外部修改，将核对后的文件内容与资源状态登记为新的本地版本。此入口不修改正文、不同时修复内容，也不覆盖个人草稿；尚未收到或未安装的版本仍独立保留。
syncPanel.externalAdoptionHelp.en-US: Explicitly adopt external changes already present locally, registering the checked file content and resource state as a new local version. This entry point does not edit or repair body content or overwrite personal drafts. Versions not yet received or installed remain separate.

syncPanel.checkedInstalledObjects.zh-CN: 本次核对的已安装对象与版本：
syncPanel.checkedInstalledObjects.en-US: Installed objects and versions checked this time:

syncPanel.nonUtf8OriginalBytes.zh-CN: 此文件不是 UTF-8 文本；原请求保留准确字节。
syncPanel.nonUtf8OriginalBytes.en-US: This file is not UTF-8 text. The original request retains its exact bytes.

syncPanel.externalRemovalsHelp.zh-CN: 以下资源已在外部移除；确认采纳会记录这一现状：
syncPanel.externalRemovalsHelp.en-US: These resources were removed externally. Confirming adoption records this state:

syncPanel.revalidationOriginalHelp.zh-CN: 本次明确重新验证选择与准确修复内容已保留。准备、提交和恢复继续使用此原操作；个人草稿与撤销记录保留。
syncPanel.revalidationOriginalHelp.en-US: Explicit revalidation choices and exact repair content are retained. Preparation, commit and recovery continue using this original operation; personal drafts and Undo history are retained.

syncPanel.originalBinaryBytes.zh-CN: 原请求保留准确二进制字节。
syncPanel.originalBinaryBytes.en-US: The original request retains exact binary bytes.

syncPanel.discardPreviewHelp.zh-CN: 放弃预览不会应用内容，也不代表服务端原操作已结束。明确取消需要原准备结果。
syncPanel.discardPreviewHelp.en-US: Discarding a preview does not apply content and does not establish that the original server operation has ended. Explicit cancellation requires the original preparation result.

syncPanel.cancelUnstartedProposal.zh-CN: 取消尚未开始写入的原提案
syncPanel.cancelUnstartedProposal.en-US: Cancel original proposal before any writing began

syncPanel.partialRecoveryHelp.zh-CN: 如需处理已发生的部分步骤，请关闭此窗口进入“恢复记录”，按原操作编号核对；不重新提交。
syncPanel.partialRecoveryHelp.en-US: To handle partially completed steps, close this window and open Recovery records. Check by the original operation ID; do not resubmit.

syncPanel.replicaIsolationHelp.zh-CN: 每个副本有独立工作目录和私有状态。复制配对身份后，通过交换目录传递已保存版本；编辑器里的未保存草稿会保留。
syncPanel.replicaIsolationHelp.en-US: Each replica has an independent working directory and private state. Copy the pairing identity, then exchange saved versions through the exchange directory. Unsaved editor drafts are retained.

syncValidation.receivedBasisRetired.zh-CN: 收到的版本或资料库已变化，请重新读取语义审阅。
syncValidation.receivedBasisRetired.en-US: Received versions or the library changed. Read semantic review again.

syncValidation.exactReceivedBranchRequir.zh-CN: 请选择已收到的准确当前分支。
syncValidation.exactReceivedBranchRequir.en-US: Select an exact currently received branch.

syncValidation.branchSelectionRequired.zh-CN: 请先明确选择此对象的一个原分支。
syncValidation.branchSelectionRequired.en-US: Explicitly select one original branch for this object first.

syncValidation.repairSourceUnavailable.zh-CN: 准确版本文件无法作为文本修复依据；原文件保留。
syncValidation.repairSourceUnavailable.en-US: The exact version file cannot serve as a text repair basis. The original file is retained.

syncValidation.fileDigestMismatch.zh-CN: 读取内容与原文件摘要不一致。
syncValidation.fileDigestMismatch.en-US: Read content does not match the original file digest.

syncValidation.selectionChangedDuringRea.zh-CN: 文件读取期间已更换选择，请重新读取。
syncValidation.selectionChangedDuringRea.en-US: The selection changed while reading the file. Read it again.

syncValidation.repairFileNotInBranch.zh-CN: 修复必须基于所选分支中已有的准确文件。
syncValidation.repairFileNotInBranch.en-US: A repair must use an exact existing file from the selected branch.

syncValidation.repairInputChanged.zh-CN: 修复输入已变化，请重新确认当前内容。
syncValidation.repairInputChanged.en-US: Repair input changed. Confirm the current content again.

syncValidation.revalidationObjectsRequir.zh-CN: 请明确选择至少一个要重新验证的对象。
syncValidation.revalidationObjectsRequir.en-US: Explicitly select at least one object to revalidate.

syncValidation.reviewOperationMismatch.zh-CN: 审阅响应与本次原操作编号不一致；未准备操作。
syncValidation.reviewOperationMismatch.en-US: The review response does not match this original operation ID. No operation was prepared.

syncValidation.reviewSelectionMismatch.zh-CN: 审阅返回了不同的明确选择。
syncValidation.reviewSelectionMismatch.en-US: The review returned different explicit choices.

syncValidation.reviewInputMismatch.zh-CN: 审阅改变了原分支或修复输入；未准备操作。
syncValidation.reviewInputMismatch.en-US: The review changed the original branch or repair input. No operation was prepared.

syncValidation.reviewVersionsIncomplete.zh-CN: 审阅缺少完整的收到版本集合。
syncValidation.reviewVersionsIncomplete.en-US: The review lacks the complete set of received versions.

syncValidation.reviewCutInvalid.zh-CN: 审阅依据已变化或包含重复对象，请重新读取。
syncValidation.reviewCutInvalid.en-US: The review basis changed or contains duplicate objects. Read it again.

syncValidation.semanticDependenciesRequi.zh-CN: 请先读取并核对当前选择的实际语义依赖。
syncValidation.semanticDependenciesRequi.en-US: Read and check the actual semantic dependencies for the current choices first.

syncValidation.reviewOperationExpired.zh-CN: 审阅的原操作编号已失效，请重新读取实际语义依赖。
syncValidation.reviewOperationExpired.en-US: The review's original operation ID is no longer valid. Read the actual semantic dependencies again.

history.localScopeHelp.zh-CN: 按这份笔记的稳定身份查看 Core 实际保留的已保存版本。浏览和比较保持只读，草稿与撤销记录继续由编辑器保留。
history.localScopeHelp.en-US: View saved versions actually retained by Core for this note's stable identity. Browsing and comparison remain read-only; the editor retains drafts and Undo history.

history.comparisonBasisLegend.zh-CN: 比较对象（本次读取固定）

history.reading.zh-CN: 正在读取准确保存记录…

history.comparisonChoiceRequired.zh-CN: 请明确选择当前已保存版本或当前草稿快照。
history.comparisonChoiceRequired.en-US: Explicitly choose the current saved version or current draft snapshot.

history.draftSnapshotFixed.zh-CN: 草稿快照已固定；继续输入不会改变本次比较。
history.draftSnapshotFixed.en-US: The draft snapshot is fixed. Further input does not change this comparison.

history.retentionSummary.zh-CN: {p0} 条已知保存记录，{p1} 条准确源码可读。{p2}仅包含本机 Core 实际保留记录；不保证更早、已清除、逐字输入或其他设备历史。空列表不代表从未保存。
history.retentionSummary.en-US: {p0} known save records; {p1} with readable exact source. {p2}Only records actually retained by this local Core are included. Earlier, cleared, per-keystroke or other-device history is not guaranteed. An empty list does not mean the note was never saved.

history.retentionUnknownHelp.zh-CN: 只显示 Core 实际保留范围；列表为空也不代表这份笔记从未保存。
history.retentionUnknownHelp.en-US: Only records actually retained by Core are shown. An empty list does not mean this note was never saved.

history.externalChangesHelp.zh-CN: 当前文件存在未接纳的外部修改。它不会冒充已保存版本；恢复前须先处理当前基线。
history.externalChangesHelp.en-US: The current file has unadmitted external changes. They are not presented as a saved version; resolve the current baseline before restoring.

history.noRetainedRecords.zh-CN: 没有可列出的保留记录。无法据此判断过去是否保存过。
history.noRetainedRecords.en-US: No retained records can be listed. This does not establish whether the note was saved in the past.

history.selectedUnavailable.zh-CN: 所选准确旧版当前不可用。没有使用最新版本替代。
history.selectedUnavailable.en-US: The selected exact old version is currently unavailable. The latest version was not substituted.

history.selectRecordHelp.zh-CN: 选择一条已保存记录，查看准确的只读 Typst 源码。保存时间来自提交时设备时钟；列表按记录的保存时间浏览，实际提交顺序另列；设备时钟回拨不改变原提交关系。
history.selectRecordHelp.en-US: Select a saved record to view exact read-only Typst source. Save times come from the device clock at commit; the list browses recorded save times and shows actual commit order separately. Clock rollback does not change the original commit relationships.

history.selectedSavedSourceHeading.zh-CN: 所选已保存版本 · 只读准确源码
history.selectedSavedSourceHeading.en-US: Selected saved version · exact read-only source

history.sourceOnlyHelp.zh-CN: 准确源码保持可读。当前仅提供源码查看；原配置或依赖缺失时不以当前设置替代旧版语义与排版。
history.sourceOnlyHelp.en-US: Exact source remains readable. This view currently provides source only; missing original configuration or dependencies are not replaced with current settings to represent old semantics or layout.

history.fixedSavedHeading.zh-CN: 当前已保存版本 · 本次读取固定
history.fixedSavedHeading.en-US: Current saved version · fixed for this read

history.fixedDraftHeading.zh-CN: 当前草稿快照 · 草稿 {p0} · 本次点击固定
history.fixedDraftHeading.en-US: Current draft snapshot · draft {p0} · fixed at this click

history.equalSources.zh-CN: 两个固定版本的源码完全一致。
history.equalSources.en-US: The two fixed versions have identical source.

history.differentSources.zh-CN: 两个固定版本的源码不同。删除和新增分别高亮；准确文本保持只读。
history.differentSources.en-US: The two fixed versions have different source. Deletions and additions are highlighted separately; exact text remains read-only.

history.selectedHistoryHeading.zh-CN: 所选历史版本 · 只读

history.comparisonMetadata.zh-CN: 所选版本 {p0} · 比较基线 {p1}{p2}

history.unsavedSnapshotSuffix.zh-CN: 。这份快照未写入笔记；它与当前已保存版本分别显示。
history.unsavedSnapshotSuffix.en-US: . This snapshot was not written to the note; it is shown separately from the current saved version.

history.fixedComparisonSuffix.zh-CN: 。后续保存不会改变本次比较。
history.fixedComparisonSuffix.en-US: . Later saves do not change this comparison.

history.protectedDraftCount.zh-CN: Core 已保护的草稿 · {p0} 份

history.protectedDraftHelp.zh-CN: 这些准确草稿来自现有本机草稿恢复记录，可在重启后找回；不属于已保存版本。
history.protectedDraftHelp.en-US: These exact drafts come from existing local draft recovery records and can be recovered after restart. They are not saved versions.

history.viewOriginalDraftBase.zh-CN: 查看这份草稿的原保存基线
history.viewOriginalDraftBase.en-US: View this draft's original saved baseline

history.committedResultUnavailable.zh-CN: 原恢复已提交，原保存回执已保留；准确结果暂不可交付，请查询原恢复结果。
history.committedResultUnavailable.en-US: The original restore was committed and its original save receipt retained. The exact result cannot currently be delivered; query the original restore result.

history.originalNotRegistered.zh-CN: 原操作尚无已登记结果，可重试完全相同的原操作。
history.originalNotRegistered.en-US: No result is currently registered for the original operation. Retry the exact same original operation.

history.originalRecoveryPending.zh-CN: 原恢复仍需处理；请从应用的操作恢复入口处理后查询。
history.originalRecoveryPending.en-US: The original restore still needs recovery. Use the application's operation recovery entry point, then query it.

history.originalResultUnknown.zh-CN: 恢复结果待确认；请查询原操作，不会创建新的保存编号。
history.originalResultUnknown.en-US: The restore result awaits confirmation. Query the original operation; no new save ID will be created.

history.retryReceiptDelivery.zh-CN: 重试回执应用与草稿保护
history.retryReceiptDelivery.en-US: Retry receipt application and draft protection

history.savedReceiptDeliveryPending.zh-CN: Core 已保存旧版；编辑器的回执应用或草稿持久化尚未完成。请继续处理这份已保存回执。
history.savedReceiptDeliveryPending.en-US: Core saved the old version. Editor receipt application or draft persistence has not completed; continue handling this saved receipt.

history.restoreScopeHelp.zh-CN: 确认后，所选旧版将产生一次新的普通保存；后来的保存记录继续保留。当前未保存草稿将存入 Core 的现有恢复记录，并保留在编辑器中。
history.restoreScopeHelp.en-US: After confirmation, the selected old version produces a new ordinary save; later save records remain. The current unsaved draft is stored in Core's existing recovery records and retained in the editor.

history.restoreBasisSummary.zh-CN: 所选版本 {p0} · 当前保存基线 {p1}

history.restoreComparisonDisclosure.zh-CN: 核对将新保存的准确旧版与当前保存内容
history.restoreComparisonDisclosure.en-US: Check the exact old version to be saved against current saved content

history.restoreSourceHeading.en-US: Exact old version to be saved

history.protectDraftChoice.zh-CN: 保留未保存草稿及本机已有恢复草稿，再恢复这个版本
history.protectDraftChoice.en-US: Retain unsaved draft and existing local recovery drafts, then restore this version

history.dirtyDraftProtectionRequired.zh-CN: 当前有未保存草稿，必须明确保护。确认期间的新输入也将继续保留。
history.dirtyDraftProtectionRequired.en-US: There is an unsaved draft, which must be explicitly protected. New input during confirmation will also be retained.

history.cleanDraftProtectionHelp.zh-CN: 当前编辑稿与保存基线一致；本机已有的其他恢复草稿同样保留。
history.cleanDraftProtectionHelp.en-US: The current editor content matches the saved baseline. Other existing local recovery drafts are also retained.

history.restoreSaved.zh-CN: 所选旧版已作为新版本保存。受保护草稿和后来的版本继续保留。
history.restoreSaved.en-US: The selected old version was saved as a new version. Protected drafts and later versions remain.

history.savedRefreshFailedPrefix.zh-CN: 新版本已保存，但保存记录刷新失败：
history.savedRefreshFailedPrefix.en-US: The new version was saved, but refreshing save records failed:

history.savedDeliveryFailedPrefix.zh-CN: Core 已保存，草稿与回执还需要继续处理：
history.savedDeliveryFailedPrefix.en-US: Core saved the version; draft and receipt handling still need attention:

history.committedResultPending.zh-CN: 原恢复已提交，原保存回执与编号继续保留；准确结果尚未取得，请继续查询。
history.committedResultPending.en-US: The original restore was committed. Its original save receipt and ID are retained; the exact result has not been obtained yet. Continue querying.

history.originalResolved.zh-CN: 原恢复已处理，未报告新保存。请刷新并重新核对当前稿。
history.originalResolved.en-US: The original restore was resolved; no new save was reported. Refresh and check the current draft again.

history.rejectedOriginalEnded.zh-CN: Core 已确认被拒绝的原恢复没有登记保存。草稿保持原样，请处理原错误后重新准备。
history.rejectedOriginalEnded.en-US: Core confirmed that the rejected original restore registered no save. The draft is unchanged; address the original error before preparing again.

history.originalReceiptPending.zh-CN: 查询没有取得已完成回执，原操作编号继续保留。
history.originalReceiptPending.en-US: The query did not obtain a completed receipt. The original operation ID is retained.

history.admittedLocalNoteRequired.zh-CN: 请先打开一个身份已接纳的本地笔记。无法确认身份的文件须先处理，不能按同名猜测历史。
history.admittedLocalNoteRequired.en-US: Open a local note with admitted identity first. Resolve files whose identity cannot be confirmed; history cannot be guessed by matching a name.

hostedHistory.notRegisteredStatus.zh-CN: 原编号未登记，仍需原请求核对或明确结束
hostedHistory.notRegisteredStatus.en-US: Original ID not registered; check the original request or explicitly end it

hostedHistory.notCommittedStatus.zh-CN: 原恢复未提交，草稿保留
hostedHistory.notCommittedStatus.en-US: Original restore not committed; draft retained

hostedHistory.committedStatus.en-US: Original restore saved as a new version

hostedHistory.recoveryPendingStatus.zh-CN: 原恢复需继续处理，不能再创建恢复
hostedHistory.recoveryPendingStatus.en-US: Original restore needs recovery; another restore cannot be created

hostedHistory.resolvedStatus.zh-CN: 原恢复已处理，未冒充新保存
hostedHistory.resolvedStatus.en-US: Original restore resolved; not reported as a new save

hostedHistory.readPermissionRequired.zh-CN: 请先打开有历史读取资格的正文。
hostedHistory.readPermissionRequired.en-US: Open body content eligible for history reading first.

hostedHistory.identityUnavailable.zh-CN: 历史身份或对象依据不可用，未按同名笔记替代。
hostedHistory.identityUnavailable.en-US: Historical identity or object basis is unavailable. A note with the same name was not substituted.

hostedHistory.localIdAllocationRefused.zh-CN: 托管恢复只由原操作持久层发起。
hostedHistory.localIdAllocationRefused.en-US: Hosted restores are initiated only through the persistent original-operation layer.

hostedHistory.localRestoreRefused.en-US: The local restore entry point was not called.

hostedHistory.localStatusRefused.en-US: The local status entry point was not called.

hostedHistory.localSettleRefused.en-US: The local termination entry point was not called.

hostedHistory.readOnlyScopeHelp.zh-CN: 浏览、读取和比较保持只读；保留记录不等于完整历史。
hostedHistory.readOnlyScopeHelp.en-US: Browsing, reading and comparison remain read-only; retained records are not a complete history.

hostedHistory.cacheUnavailable.zh-CN: 历史恢复缓存不可用，未发起新的恢复。
hostedHistory.cacheUnavailable.en-US: The history recovery cache is unavailable. No new restore was started.

hostedHistory.persistBeforeSendFailed.zh-CN: 浏览器无法保留原恢复编号和准确请求，尚未发送恢复；请先复制草稿。
hostedHistory.persistBeforeSendFailed.en-US: The browser cannot retain the original restore ID and exact request. The restore has not been sent; copy the draft first.

hostedHistory.persistenceUnknown.zh-CN: 浏览器无法保留恢复状态，请保留本页并查询原编号；未冒充缓存已保存。
hostedHistory.persistenceUnknown.en-US: The browser cannot retain recovery state. Keep this page and query the original ID; the cache was not reported as saved.

hostedHistory.unreadableCache.zh-CN: 原恢复缓存无法解析，原记录只读保留；不会替换编号或发起恢复。
hostedHistory.unreadableCache.en-US: The original restore cache cannot be parsed. The original record is retained read-only; no ID will be replaced and no restore started.

hostedHistory.selectedSourceHeading.zh-CN: 所选准确旧版 · 只读源码
hostedHistory.selectedSourceHeading.en-US: Selected exact old version · read-only source

hostedHistory.selectedHistoryHeading.zh-CN: 所选准确旧版 · 只读

hostedHistory.fixedDraftHeading.zh-CN: 固定个人草稿快照 · serial {p0}

hostedHistory.comparisonMetadata.zh-CN: 所选 {p0} · 比较基线 {p1}；后续输入或保存不会改变这次固定比较，也未改正文。
hostedHistory.comparisonMetadata.en-US: Selected {p0} · comparison baseline {p1}. Later input or saves do not change this fixed comparison; body content is unchanged.

hostedHistory.comparisonMismatch.zh-CN: 草稿比较与本次准确快照不一致，未替换比较内容。
hostedHistory.comparisonMismatch.en-US: The draft comparison does not match this exact snapshot. Comparison content was not replaced.

hostedHistory.originalPending.en-US: Resolve the original restore operation first.

hostedHistory.protectDraftLabel.zh-CN: 保护当前草稿并恢复历史
hostedHistory.protectDraftLabel.en-US: Protect current draft and restore history

hostedHistory.protectDraftChoice.zh-CN: 保留当前及已有个人恢复草稿，再将旧版恢复为一次新保存
hostedHistory.protectDraftChoice.en-US: Retain current and existing personal recovery drafts, then restore the old version as a new save

hostedHistory.confirmRestore.zh-CN: 确认历史恢复并新保存
hostedHistory.confirmRestore.en-US: Confirm history restore and new save

hostedHistory.restoreBasisChanged.zh-CN: 确认前草稿或资格已变化，请重新准备；输入保留。
hostedHistory.restoreBasisChanged.en-US: The draft or eligibility changed before confirmation. Prepare again; input is retained.

hostedHistory.restoreScopeHelp.zh-CN: 旧版会产生新的保存记录；后来的版本及个人草稿继续保留。请求期间的新输入会继续留在同一编辑器。
hostedHistory.restoreScopeHelp.en-US: The old version produces a new save record. Later versions and personal drafts remain. New input during the request stays in the same editor.

hostedHistory.clearCheckedRecords.zh-CN: 清除本标签页已核对的恢复记录
hostedHistory.clearCheckedRecords.en-US: Clear checked recovery records from this tab

hostedHistory.terminalCacheCleared.zh-CN: 已清除本标签页的终态恢复缓存；Core 历史和受保护个人草稿继续保留，未知操作未清除。
hostedHistory.terminalCacheCleared.en-US: Terminal recovery cache entries were cleared from this tab. Core history and protected personal drafts remain; unknown operations were not cleared.

hostedHistory.supersededSaveSuffix.zh-CN: · 原保存已非当前，只能比較
hostedHistory.supersededSaveSuffix.en-US: · original save is no longer current; comparison only

hostedHistory.resultUnchecked.zh-CN: 结果待核对；原编号和准确请求保持不变。
hostedHistory.resultUnchecked.en-US: Result awaiting verification; the original ID and exact request are unchanged.

hostedHistory.retryOriginal.zh-CN: 按原编号重试历史恢复
hostedHistory.retryOriginal.en-US: Retry history restore with the original ID

hostedHistory.applyOriginalReceipt.zh-CN: 核对并应用原恢复回执
hostedHistory.applyOriginalReceipt.en-US: Check and apply original restore receipt

hostedHistory.finishUnavailableDelivery.zh-CN: 结束本页回执应用，重新核对当前稿
hostedHistory.finishUnavailableDelivery.en-US: Finish this page's receipt application and recheck current draft

hostedHistory.finishDeliveryUnavailable.zh-CN: 只有已提交但原结果不可交付的操作可结束本页应用。
hostedHistory.finishDeliveryUnavailable.en-US: Only a committed operation whose original result cannot be delivered may finish this page's application.

hostedHistory.unavailableDeliveryFinishe.zh-CN: 原保存事实及原稿已保留；本页回执应用已结束，当前稿须明确比较，未把旧恢复结果冒作当前稿。
hostedHistory.unavailableDeliveryFinishe.en-US: The original save fact and source are retained. Receipt application on this page has ended; compare the current draft explicitly. The old restore result was not presented as the current draft.

hostedHistory.committedResultUnavailable.zh-CN: 原恢复已保存，但当前资格无法交付原结果。只保留原操作事实，不用旧缓存正文或另发恢复。
hostedHistory.committedResultUnavailable.en-US: The original restore was saved, but current eligibility cannot deliver its original result. Only the original operation fact is retained; no old cached body or new restore is used.

hostedHistory.originalResultDisclosure.zh-CN: 原恢复结果与受保护草稿 · 只读
hostedHistory.originalResultDisclosure.en-US: Original restore result and protected drafts · read-only

hostedHistory.restoredApplied.zh-CN: 旧版已作为新版本保存；个人新输入与既有草稿、后续历史均保留。
hostedHistory.restoredApplied.en-US: The old version was saved as a new version. New personal input, existing drafts and later history are retained.

hostedHistory.restoredSuperseded.zh-CN: 原恢复已保存，但之后另有保存稿；当前稿与个人输入均保留，请比较核对，未用旧回执覆盖。
hostedHistory.restoredSuperseded.en-US: The original restore was saved, but another save followed it. Current content and personal input are retained; compare and check them. The old receipt did not overwrite them.

hostedReview.mediaReadUnauthorized.zh-CN: 此媒体没有独立的批注讨论读取资格；查看不会授予批注权限。
hostedReview.mediaReadUnauthorized.en-US: This media has no separate annotation discussion read eligibility. Viewing does not grant annotation permission.

hostedReview.saveScopeHelp.zh-CN: 讨论单独保存。新目标、校对和应用建议使用当前已保存正文；提交前可核对准确变动。
hostedReview.saveScopeHelp.en-US: Discussion is saved separately. New targets, proofreading and suggestion application use the current saved body; inspect exact changes before commit.

hostedReview.operationIncomplete.zh-CN: 操作未完成，输入和原操作仍保留。
hostedReview.operationIncomplete.en-US: The operation is incomplete. Input and the original operation are retained.

hostedReview.unreadableRecovery.zh-CN: 批注恢复记录无法解析，原文保留供复制与核对。
hostedReview.unreadableRecovery.en-US: The annotation recovery record cannot be parsed. Original text is retained for copying and checking.

hostedReview.originalPending.zh-CN: 原批注操作待核对，请先核对结果。
hostedReview.originalPending.en-US: The original annotation operation needs verification. Check its result first.

hostedReview.savedBodyRequired.zh-CN: 请先打开并保存该正文，核对原保存结果，再重新读取批注。
hostedReview.savedBodyRequired.en-US: Open and save this body first, verify the original save result, then read annotations again.

hostedReview.sourceBasisMismatch.zh-CN: 当前正文与批注依据不同，请保留草稿并重新读取核对。
hostedReview.sourceBasisMismatch.en-US: The current body differs from the annotation basis. Retain the draft and read again to check.

hostedReview.exactMediaRequired.zh-CN: 请先打开与讨论所属对象一致的获权媒体版本。
hostedReview.exactMediaRequired.en-US: Open the authorized media version belonging to the discussion's object first.

hostedReview.mediaBasisChanged.zh-CN: 媒体依据已变化，请保留批注输入并重新读取当前资源的批注依据。
hostedReview.mediaBasisChanged.en-US: The media basis changed. Retain annotation input and reread the current resource's annotation basis.

hostedReview.sameBodyRequired.zh-CN: 请打开同一对象的正文后选择目标。
hostedReview.sameBodyRequired.en-US: Open the same object's body before selecting a target.

hostedReview.selectionRequired.zh-CN: 请先在编辑器中选择准确位置。
hostedReview.selectionRequired.en-US: Select an exact position in the editor first.

hostedReview.mediaSuggestionUnsupported.zh-CN: 媒体目标支持讨论或标记；源文本修改建议需要准确已保存正文，原输入保留。
hostedReview.mediaSuggestionUnsupported.en-US: Media targets support discussion or marks. Source-text suggestions require the exact saved body; original input is retained.

hostedReview.originalCommitted.zh-CN: 原批注操作已提交。请重新读取批注；正文变更仍须与个人草稿核对。
hostedReview.originalCommitted.en-US: The original annotation operation was committed. Read annotations again; body changes still need to be checked against personal drafts.

hostedReview.originalEndedWithoutSave.zh-CN: 原批注操作已结束，未冒作保存成功；输入保留，请重新读取。
hostedReview.originalEndedWithoutSave.en-US: The original annotation operation ended without being reported as a successful save. Input is retained; read again.

hostedReview.prepared.zh-CN: 变动已准备，请核对后明确提交。
hostedReview.prepared.en-US: Changes prepared. Check them before explicitly committing.

hostedReview.originalUnknown.zh-CN: 原操作尚待确认；输入保留，请核对原操作。
hostedReview.originalUnknown.en-US: The original operation still awaits confirmation. Input is retained; inspect the original operation.

hostedReview.discardDamagedRecovery.zh-CN: 放弃损坏的批注恢复记录

hostedReview.emptyReplacementHelp.zh-CN: 修改建议使用下方替换文字；空替换表示删除。
hostedReview.emptyReplacementHelp.en-US: Suggestions use the replacement text below. An empty replacement means deletion.

hostedReview.originalMediaSummary.zh-CN: 原媒体选择：{p0} · {p1}。准确几何目标保留；不会按当前其他版本重定位。
hostedReview.originalMediaSummary.en-US: Original media selection: {p0} · {p1}. The exact geometric target is retained; it is not relocated using another current version.

hostedReview.frozenMediaHelp.zh-CN: 原媒体目标已冻结；移动当前选区不会更改它。确认提交的是此原计划，服务端将重新核验准确版本与权限。
hostedReview.frozenMediaHelp.en-US: The original media target is frozen; moving the current selection does not change it. Confirmation commits this original plan. The server rechecks the exact version and permissions.

hostedReview.settleOriginal.zh-CN: 结束原批注操作并保留输入
hostedReview.settleOriginal.en-US: End original annotation operation and retain input

hostedReview.inputRetained.zh-CN: 批注输入已保留，尚未提交。
hostedReview.inputRetained.en-US: Annotation input is retained and has not been committed.

hostedReview.recoveryPersistenceFailed.zh-CN: 无法保留批注恢复信息，请先复制输入。
hostedReview.recoveryPersistenceFailed.en-US: Annotation recovery information cannot be retained. Copy the input first.

shell.viewSourceDescription.zh-CN: 完整 Typst 源码与所有语法字符
shell.viewSourceDescription.en-US: Full Typst source with all syntax characters

shell.viewStyledSourceDescription.zh-CN: 标题与强调带样式，所有语法字符可见
shell.viewStyledSourceDescription.en-US: Styled headings and emphasis with all syntax characters visible

shell.viewSyntaxOnDemandDescription.zh-CN: 阅读时隐藏语法；选择段落可展开源码
shell.viewSyntaxOnDemandDescription.en-US: Hide syntax while reading; select a paragraph to expand its source

shell.viewVisualEditingDescription.zh-CN: 隐藏语法，只编辑引擎确认的文字区域
shell.viewVisualEditingDescription.en-US: Hide syntax and edit only text regions confirmed by the engine

shell.viewReadingDescription.zh-CN: 只读查看当前草稿，可选择与复制文字
shell.viewReadingDescription.en-US: Read the current draft; text can be selected and copied

shell.identityCannotOpenExactly.zh-CN: 当前身份不可用于准确打开，请先核对资料库提示。
shell.identityCannotOpenExactly.en-US: The current identity cannot open this exact item. Check the library notices first.

shell.returnTargetMismatch.zh-CN: 返回目标不是原笔记，原稿保留。
shell.returnTargetMismatch.en-US: The return target is not the original note. The original draft is retained.

shell.quickOpenShortcut.zh-CN: Ctrl+P · 按标题和路径查找
shell.quickOpenShortcut.en-US: Ctrl+P · Find by title and path

shell.openOutsideTypst.zh-CN: 打开库外 Typst 文件
shell.openOutsideTypst.en-US: Open a Typst file outside the library

shell.browseImportResources.zh-CN: 导入或浏览图片与资源
shell.browseImportResources.en-US: Import or browse images and resources

shell.openHeadingStructure.zh-CN: 打开只读标题结构／大纲
shell.openHeadingStructure.en-US: Open the read-only heading structure / outline

shell.embeddedQueryRequirements.zh-CN: 内嵌 Query 需要资料库笔记与已安装的 schema。
shell.embeddedQueryRequirements.en-US: An embedded Query requires a library note and an installed schema.

shell.embeddedQueryDescription.zh-CN: 使用当前已安装的字段配置，在本篇添加查询定义。插入只改草稿，可一次撤销；保存后查询可运行。每次保存前可新增一个定义。
shell.embeddedQueryDescription.en-US: Add a query definition to this note using the installed field configuration. Inserting changes only the draft and can be undone once; the query can run after saving. One new definition may be added before each save.

shell.queryEmptyScopePlaceholder.zh-CN: 留空表示当前库内全部获权笔记
shell.queryEmptyScopePlaceholder.en-US: Leave blank for all authorized notes in the current library

shell.queryReuseSavedDefinition.zh-CN: 复用保存定义（独立调用）

shell.queryReusedExactVersion.zh-CN: 复用定义准确固定版本
shell.queryReusedExactVersion.en-US: Exact pinned version of the reused definition

shell.queryLoadOwnerDefinitions.zh-CN: 读取所选笔记的保存定义
shell.queryLoadOwnerDefinitions.en-US: Read the selected note’s saved definitions

shell.querySelectActualOwnerFirst.zh-CN: 请先在当前资料库打开导航，再选择真实定义笔记。
shell.querySelectActualOwnerFirst.en-US: Open navigation in the current library first, then select the actual definition note.

shell.queryOwnerHasNoDefinition.zh-CN: 所选笔记没有当前可用定义；不会按同名替换。
shell.queryOwnerHasNoDefinition.en-US: The selected note has no currently available definition; no same-named definition will be substituted.

shell.queryReuseDescription.zh-CN: 此处只新增调用；共享定义归属保持不变。固定版本须准确填写，不能静默采用当前版本。
shell.queryReuseDescription.en-US: Only a new invocation is added here; ownership of the shared definition is unchanged. Enter the exact pinned version; the current version must not be adopted silently.

shell.querySourceChangedDuringConfirmati.zh-CN: 正文在确认期间已变化，原输入保留，请取消后重新选择当前笔记。
shell.querySourceChangedDuringConfirmati.en-US: The body changed during confirmation. Your input is retained; cancel and select the current note again.

shell.queryNameCharacters.zh-CN: 名称请使用文字、数字、连字符、下划线或句点。
shell.queryNameCharacters.en-US: Use letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, or periods in the name.

shell.querySelectExactDefinitionVersion.zh-CN: 请选择已读取的准确定义和需要的固定版本。
shell.querySelectExactDefinitionVersion.en-US: Select the exact loaded definition and the required pinned version.

shell.queryProposalOrInputChanged.zh-CN: 查询提案或输入已变化，原稿和新输入保留，请重新确认。
shell.queryProposalOrInputChanged.en-US: The query proposal or input changed. The original draft and new input are retained; confirm again.

shell.queryPatchMismatch.zh-CN: 查询补丁与提案不符，未修改正文。
shell.queryPatchMismatch.en-US: The query patch does not match the proposal. The body was not changed.

shell.queryInstallFieldsFirst.zh-CN: 请先在查询配置中显式安装字段配置，再插入查询；当前正文未变。
shell.queryInstallFieldsFirst.en-US: Explicitly install the field configuration in query settings before inserting a query. The current body is unchanged.

shell.importCreatedNoteUnavailable.zh-CN: 原导入的新笔记当前不可定位，请核对原操作。
shell.importCreatedNoteUnavailable.en-US: The new note from the original import cannot currently be located. Check the original operation.

shell.syncCheckingDraftRetained.zh-CN: 同步结果正在核对，原草稿保留。
shell.syncCheckingDraftRetained.en-US: Checking the sync result. The original draft is retained.

shell.syncDiskChanged.zh-CN: 同步已改变磁盘版本。当前草稿与撤销记录保留，请比较草稿与磁盘内容后继续。
shell.syncDiskChanged.en-US: Sync changed the disk version. The current draft and Undo history are retained; compare the draft with the disk content before continuing.

shell.syncNoteUnreadable.zh-CN: 同步后当前笔记暂不可读取。草稿保留，请检查资料库或回收站。
shell.syncNoteUnreadable.en-US: The current note cannot be read after sync. The draft is retained; check the library or recycle bin.

shell.querySaveFileReceiptMissing.zh-CN: Query 保存缺少实际文件回执，请检查原操作。
shell.querySaveFileReceiptMissing.en-US: The Query save has no actual file receipt. Check the original operation.

shell.querySavedReopen.zh-CN: Query 已保存，请重新打开笔记确认。
shell.querySavedReopen.en-US: The Query is saved. Reopen the note to confirm.

shell.queryCommittedDiskChanged.zh-CN: Query 已提交，但文件随后发生了其他修改。当前草稿和撤销记录保留，请比较磁盘内容后继续。
shell.queryCommittedDiskChanged.en-US: The Query was committed, but the file was then changed elsewhere. The current draft and Undo history are retained; compare the disk content before continuing.

shell.querySavedNewInputRetained.zh-CN: Query 与提交的笔记版本已保存，期间的新输入仍保留；请比较磁盘内容后继续保存。
shell.querySavedNewInputRetained.en-US: The Query and submitted note version are saved, and input made meanwhile is retained. Compare the disk content before saving again.

shell.oldEditCannotApply.zh-CN: 当前草稿不能接受这份旧修改，请切换编辑视图并重试。
shell.oldEditCannotApply.en-US: The current draft cannot accept this old change. Switch editor views and try again.

shell.inputEnteredDraft.zh-CN: 输入已进入草稿，请重新核对并操作。
shell.inputEnteredDraft.en-US: The input is now in the draft. Check it again before continuing.

shell.targetOutsideCurrentLibrary.zh-CN: 目标不属于当前打开的资料库，请先打开目标库。
shell.targetOutsideCurrentLibrary.en-US: The target is outside the open library. Open the target library first.

shell.committedContentReceiptMismatch.zh-CN: 操作已提交，但重新读取的文件不是本次计划确认的内容。草稿和撤销记录保留，请比较磁盘内容。
shell.committedContentReceiptMismatch.en-US: The operation was committed, but the file read back does not match the content confirmed in this plan. The draft and Undo history are retained; compare the disk content.

shell.noteRecycledDraftRetained.zh-CN: 笔记已移入回收站。这里保留当前草稿，可另存为，也可从上方回收站恢复。
shell.noteRecycledDraftRetained.en-US: The note was moved to the recycle bin. This draft is retained; save it as a new file or restore the note from the recycle bin above.

shell.createdFileOpenFromList.zh-CN: 已创建 {p0}，可从文件列表打开。
shell.createdFileOpenFromList.en-US: Created {p0}. Open it from the file list.

shell.fileOperationCompletedNewInputReta.zh-CN: 文件操作已完成，期间的新输入仍保留。请比较当前磁盘版本后继续保存。
shell.fileOperationCompletedNewInputReta.en-US: The file operation is complete, and input made meanwhile is retained. Compare the current disk version before saving again.

shell.parentFolderRecycled.zh-CN: 所属文件夹已移入回收站，当前草稿保留。请恢复后继续保存，或另存为。
shell.parentFolderRecycled.en-US: The parent folder was moved to the recycle bin. The current draft is retained; restore the folder before saving again, or use Save as.

shell.folderOperationCompleted.zh-CN: 文件夹操作已完成，草稿保留；{p0}
shell.folderOperationCompleted.en-US: The folder operation is complete and the draft is retained; {p0}

shell.childNoteChanged.zh-CN: 该子笔记内容发生变化，请重新打开目标并比较。
shell.childNoteChanged.en-US: This child note’s content changed. Reopen the target and compare it.

shell.libraryStyleRecompiling.zh-CN: 库样式已变化，正在重新编译。

shell.olderVersionSavedReopen.zh-CN: 旧版已保存，请重新打开原笔记确认；受保护草稿仍由 Core 保留。
shell.olderVersionSavedReopen.en-US: The older version is saved. Reopen the original note to confirm; Core still retains the protected draft.

shell.restoreReceiptNoteMismatch.zh-CN: 恢复回执与原笔记不符，当前草稿保持原样。
shell.restoreReceiptNoteMismatch.en-US: The restore receipt does not match the original note. The current draft is unchanged.

shell.openedTargetDiskChanged.zh-CN: 目标已打开，但磁盘内容发生了其他修改。已保留当前草稿和撤销记录，请比较后继续。
shell.openedTargetDiskChanged.en-US: The target opened, but its disk content changed elsewhere. The current draft and Undo history are retained; compare before continuing.

shell.openLibraryDescription.zh-CN: 输入本机文件夹的完整路径。已有资料库将直接打开，普通文件夹也可以浏览。
shell.openLibraryDescription.en-US: Enter the full path of a local folder. An existing library opens directly; ordinary folders can also be browsed.

shell.createLibraryDescription.zh-CN: 输入尚不存在的新文件夹路径。资料库将创建该文件夹并保存笔记与恢复信息。
shell.createLibraryDescription.en-US: Enter a new folder path that does not yet exist. The library will create the folder and store notes and recovery information there.

shell.openTypstFileDescription.zh-CN: 输入 .typ 文件的完整路径。库外文件可直接编辑，依赖从文件所在目录读取。
shell.openTypstFileDescription.en-US: Enter the full path of a .typ file. Files outside a library can be edited directly; dependencies are read from the file’s directory.

shell.saveAsDescription.zh-CN: 输入新的 .typ 文件完整路径。成功后编辑会话切换到新文件。
shell.saveAsDescription.en-US: Enter the full path of a new .typ file. After success, the editing session switches to the new file.

shell.ordinaryFolderEditable.zh-CN: 普通文件夹 · 文件可直接编辑
shell.ordinaryFolderEditable.en-US: Ordinary folder · Files can be edited directly

shell.ordinaryFolderCreateLibraryHint.zh-CN: 普通文件夹可浏览文件。创建新的资料库后可新建资料库笔记。
shell.ordinaryFolderCreateLibraryHint.en-US: Browse files in an ordinary folder. Create a new library to create library notes.

shell.emptyLibraryTitle.zh-CN: 你的笔记会出现在这里

shell.emptyLibraryDescription.zh-CN: 打开资料库，或直接打开 .typ 文件。
shell.emptyLibraryDescription.en-US: Open a library, or open a .typ file directly.

shell.folderHasNoNotes.zh-CN: 这个文件夹还没有笔记
shell.folderHasNoNotes.en-US: This folder has no notes yet

shell.selectedItemMainFileUnavailable.zh-CN: 所选项目没有可打开的 Typst 主文件。
shell.selectedItemMainFileUnavailable.en-US: The selected item has no Typst main file that can be opened.

shell.wholeNodeFileActions.zh-CN: 整个节点：改名、移动、复制或回收
shell.wholeNodeFileActions.en-US: Entire node: rename, move, copy, or recycle

shell.openExactNoteBeforeFileImpact.zh-CN: 打开准确笔记后预览文件影响；未保存草稿须先处理
shell.openExactNoteBeforeFileImpact.en-US: Open the exact note to preview file effects; handle unsaved drafts first

shell.oneExactNodePerOperation.zh-CN: 此入口每次处理一个准确节点；多选不会隐式批量改写。
shell.oneExactNodePerOperation.en-US: This entry handles one exact node at a time; selecting multiple items does not implicitly rewrite them in bulk.

shell.itemPreviewDescription.zh-CN: 只读显示当前目录扫描中的摘要；不保存正文。
shell.itemPreviewDescription.en-US: Read-only summary from the current directory scan; the body is not saved.

shell.itemSummaryUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前扫描没有摘要，可明确打开正文查看。
shell.itemSummaryUnavailable.en-US: This scan has no summary. Explicitly open the body to view it.

shell.localNativeTypst.zh-CN: 本地文件 · 原生 Typst

shell.filesOnYourDevice.zh-CN: 文件保存在你的设备上
shell.filesOnYourDevice.en-US: Files are saved on your device

shell.previewAnnotationsAwaitComparison.zh-CN: 预览与批注等待明确比较
shell.previewAnnotationsAwaitComparison.en-US: Preview and annotations await explicit comparison

shell.previewErrorSourceRetained.zh-CN: 预览有错误 · 源码已保留

shell.welcomeDescription.zh-CN:
从一页文字开始，在自己的文件里整理知识。
以原生 Typst 写作，自由切换源码、编辑与阅读。
shell.welcomeDescription.en-US:
Start with a page of text and organize knowledge in your own files.
Write in native Typst and switch freely between source, editing, and reading.

shell.openLibraryWelcomeHint.zh-CN: 继续写作，浏览已有笔记
shell.openLibraryWelcomeHint.en-US: Continue writing and browse existing notes

shell.createLibraryWelcomeHint.zh-CN: 为新的想法准备一个文件夹
shell.createLibraryWelcomeHint.en-US: Prepare a folder for new ideas

shell.openDotTypFileWelcomeHint.zh-CN: 直接编辑设备上的普通文件
shell.openDotTypFileWelcomeHint.en-US: Edit ordinary files directly on your device

shell.ordinaryFolderOpened.zh-CN: 普通文件夹已打开。可以从左侧浏览与编辑 .typ 文件。
shell.ordinaryFolderOpened.en-US: Ordinary folder opened. Browse and edit .typ files from the sidebar.

shell.libraryOpened.zh-CN: 资料库已打开，从左侧选择文件，或新建笔记。
shell.libraryOpened.en-US: Library opened. Select a file from the sidebar or create a new note.

shell.libraryPartialScan.zh-CN: 资料库部分扫描完成，已找到的文件可以打开。
shell.libraryPartialScan.en-US: Part of the library has been scanned. The files already found can be opened.

shell.localCapabilities.zh-CN: 本机运行 · 中文默认支持 · 草稿自动留存
shell.localCapabilities.en-US: Runs locally · Chinese supported by default · Drafts retained automatically

shell.diskChangedCompareBeforeSaving.zh-CN: 磁盘内容已改变。当前草稿与撤销记录保留，请比较后继续保存。
shell.diskChangedCompareBeforeSaving.en-US: The disk content changed. The current draft and Undo history are retained; compare before saving again.

shell.endnoteResourcesVerified.zh-CN: 本篇尾注模块资源已核对；正文与撤销记录保留，请重新打开尾注提案。
shell.endnoteResourcesVerified.en-US: The note’s endnote module resources are verified. The body and Undo history are retained; reopen the endnote proposal.

shell.noPendingEndnoteModule.zh-CN: 当前没有待核对的尾注模块安装。
shell.noPendingEndnoteModule.en-US: There is no endnote module installation awaiting verification.

shell.endnoteModuleConfirmedBodyUnsaved.zh-CN: 原尾注模块安装已确认，正文尚未保存。
shell.endnoteModuleConfirmedBodyUnsaved.en-US: The original endnote module installation is confirmed. The body is not yet saved.

shell.cancelledModuleReprepared.zh-CN: 已按明确取消的原操作核对并准备新模块资源；正文尚未保存。
shell.cancelledModuleReprepared.en-US: The original operation’s explicit cancellation was verified and new module resources are prepared. The body is not yet saved.

shell.unappliedNoteInputRetained.zh-CN: 未应用的新注释输入已保留，可在“恢复记录”中取回。
shell.unappliedNoteInputRetained.en-US: Unapplied annotation input is retained and can be retrieved from Recovery records.

shell.noteSwitchedNumberingNotOpened.zh-CN: 当前笔记已切换，未打开旧编号提案。
shell.noteSwitchedNumberingNotOpened.en-US: The current note changed. The old numbering proposal was not opened.

shell.recoveredPreviousDraftView.zh-CN: 已恢复上次草稿 · 查看

shell.retrieveUnappliedNoteInput.zh-CN: 取回未应用的注释输入

shell.recoveredDraftDiskDiffers.zh-CN: 恢复草稿与当前磁盘内容不同。请比较并明确合并后再保存。
shell.recoveredDraftDiskDiffers.en-US: The recovery draft differs from the current disk content. Compare and explicitly merge before saving again.

shell.pagedPreviewQueryHint.zh-CN: 此处原生分页预览不含查询结果。需要随文 PDF 时，在“输出与导入”选择“PDF 文档（含已显示正文查询）”，固定当前结果后生成。
shell.pagedPreviewQueryHint.en-US: This native paged preview does not include query results. For a PDF with in-text results, select “PDF document (with displayed body queries)” in Output and import, freeze the current results, then generate.

shell.continuousDraftWithQueries.zh-CN: 含正文查询的连续草稿预览
shell.continuousDraftWithQueries.en-US: Continuous draft preview with body queries

shell.sourceKeyboardHint.zh-CN: Ctrl S 保存 · Ctrl Z 撤销
shell.sourceKeyboardHint.en-US: Ctrl S Save · Ctrl Z Undo

shell.lastSuccessfulPreviewError.zh-CN: 显示上次成功预览，当前草稿预览失败；此预览只读。{p0}
shell.lastSuccessfulPreviewError.en-US: Showing the last successful preview because the current draft preview failed; this preview is read-only. {p0}

shell.lastPreviewUpdating.zh-CN: 显示上次预览，正在更新。文字编辑暂不可用。
shell.lastPreviewUpdating.en-US: Showing the previous preview while updating. Text editing is temporarily unavailable.

shell.draftPreviewUnavailable.en-US: The draft cannot be previewed right now

shell.syncCheckingCurrentDraftRetained.zh-CN: 正在核对同步结果，当前草稿保留。
shell.syncCheckingCurrentDraftRetained.en-US: Checking the sync result. The current draft is retained.

shell.noteMovedCompareDisk.zh-CN: 笔记位置已改变，请先比较磁盘内容并明确合并；当前源码和撤销记录保留。
shell.noteMovedCompareDisk.en-US: The note’s location changed. Compare the disk content and explicitly merge first; the current source and Undo history are retained.

shell.previewUnavailableInputRetained.zh-CN: 完整输入保留在当前窗口；恢复草稿和保存状态以单独提示为准。可使用源码入口继续编辑。
shell.previewUnavailableInputRetained.en-US: The complete input is retained in this window. Separate notices indicate recovery draft and save status. Use the source view to continue editing.

shell.expandSourceHint.zh-CN: 点击或按 Enter 展开源码
shell.expandSourceHint.en-US: Click or press Enter to expand source

shell.viewNoteBodyMarkers.en-US: View the {p0} body and all markers

shell.readOnlyPartViewSource.zh-CN: 此部分只读 · 查看源码
shell.readOnlyPartViewSource.en-US: This part is read-only · View source

shell.exactEquationSelected.zh-CN: 已选择准确公式范围，可在链接与批注中添加讨论。
shell.exactEquationSelected.en-US: The exact equation range is selected. Add discussion through links and annotations.

shell.noSafeEditableRegion.zh-CN: 当前内容没有可安全回写的文字区域。源码保留完整，可切换源码继续编辑。
shell.noSafeEditableRegion.en-US: This content has no text region that can safely be written back. The complete source is retained; switch to source to continue editing.

shell.visualEditingBoundaryHint.zh-CN: 可编辑文字直接输入；生成内容、复杂布局与未确认区域保持只读。
shell.visualEditingBoundaryHint.en-US: Type directly in editable text; generated content, complex layouts, and unconfirmed regions remain read-only.

shell.sourceSizeLimitExceeded.zh-CN: 源码超过 2 MiB 上限；完整输入仅保留在当前窗口，这份超限输入未写入恢复草稿或文件。请撤销或缩短内容后重试。
shell.sourceSizeLimitExceeded.en-US: The source exceeds the 2 MiB limit. The complete input is retained only in this window; this oversized input was not written to a recovery draft or file. Undo or shorten the content and try again.

shell.previousCreationUnconfirmedRetry.zh-CN: 上一次创建结果仍待确认，请先重试该创建操作。
shell.previousCreationUnconfirmedRetry.en-US: The previous creation result still needs confirmation. Retry that creation operation first.

shell.creationUnconfirmedRetrySameOperat.zh-CN: 创建结果待确认，再次点击创建会确认同一操作。
shell.creationUnconfirmedRetrySameOperat.en-US: The creation result needs confirmation. Clicking Create again will confirm the same operation.

shell.previousCreationUnconfirmedRetryOr.zh-CN: 上一次创建结果仍待确认，请先重试原创建操作。
shell.previousCreationUnconfirmedRetryOr.en-US: The previous creation result still needs confirmation. Retry the original creation operation first.

shell.libraryCreated.zh-CN: 资料库已创建，可以新建笔记了；文档排版默认可在库样式中查看。
shell.libraryCreated.en-US: Library created. You can now create notes; view default document formatting in the library style.

shell.ordinaryFolderCannotCreateNote.zh-CN: 当前打开的是普通文件夹。创建资料库后可新建资料库笔记。
shell.ordinaryFolderCannotCreateNote.en-US: The open folder is an ordinary folder. Create a library to create library notes.

shell.noteNameDescription.zh-CN: 名称用于文件夹与主文件。正文可以不设标题。
shell.noteNameDescription.en-US: The name is used for the folder and main file. The body does not need a title.

shell.noteCreatedOpenIncomplete.zh-CN: 笔记已创建；打开尚未完成：{p0}
shell.noteCreatedOpenIncomplete.en-US: The note was created, but opening it is incomplete: {p0}

shell.openOriginalNoteFromList.zh-CN: 请从文件列表打开原笔记。
shell.openOriginalNoteFromList.en-US: Open the original note from the file list.

shell.queryNoteLocationNeedsComparison.zh-CN: 笔记位置正在核对或已变化，请明确比较后恢复正文查询。源码输入保留。
shell.queryNoteLocationNeedsComparison.en-US: The note’s location is being checked or has changed. Explicitly compare before restoring body queries. Source input is retained.

shell.queryProposalBasisChanged.zh-CN: 查询提案的草稿或编辑资格已变化，未应用修改。
shell.queryProposalBasisChanged.en-US: The query proposal’s draft or editing eligibility changed. No changes were applied.

shell.queryRowExactNavigationMissing.zh-CN: 此行缺少准确的导航来源，未按当前路径或同名目标替换。
shell.queryRowExactNavigationMissing.en-US: This row has no exact navigation origin. The current path or a same-named target was not substituted.

shell.recycleResultIdentityMissing.zh-CN: 回收站结果缺少稳定身份，不能按路径打开。
shell.recycleResultIdentityMissing.en-US: The recycle result has no stable identity and cannot be opened by path.

shell.lastUnsavedDraftRecovered.zh-CN: 已恢复上次未保存的草稿。磁盘文件保持原样。
shell.lastUnsavedDraftRecovered.en-US: The previous unsaved draft was recovered. The disk file is unchanged.

shell.oldDirectoryScopeUnavailable.zh-CN: 原目录范围当前不可用，已返回当前资料库；未按同名目标恢复选择。
shell.oldDirectoryScopeUnavailable.en-US: The original directory scope is unavailable. Returned to the current library; selection was not restored by a same-named target.

shell.returnTargetDiskChanged.zh-CN: 返回目标的磁盘内容已变化。原草稿、选区和撤销记录保留，请比较后继续。
shell.returnTargetDiskChanged.en-US: The return target’s disk content changed. The original draft, selection, and Undo history are retained; compare before continuing.

shell.noteRecycledRestoreOrSaveAs.zh-CN: 笔记已移入回收站，请先恢复或将草稿另存为。
shell.noteRecycledRestoreOrSaveAs.en-US: The note was moved to the recycle bin. Restore it first or save the draft as a new file.

shell.creationTargetChanged.zh-CN: 创建目标已改变，请重新选择目标后再创建；已提交的原操作可返回原库继续交付。
shell.creationTargetChanged.en-US: The creation target changed. Select it again before creating; a committed original operation can be delivered after returning to its library.

shell.saveQueryReservationInputChanged.zh-CN: 保存前查询预约核对期间出现新输入，请重新保存；输入已保留。
shell.saveQueryReservationInputChanged.en-US: New input appeared while checking query reservations before saving. Your input is retained; save again.

shell.saveUnconfirmedDraftRetained.zh-CN: 保存尚未确认，草稿已保留。
shell.saveUnconfirmedDraftRetained.en-US: The save is not yet confirmed. The draft is retained.

shell.commitSessionChangedAwaitOriginalR.zh-CN: 原内容已提交；等待期间文件会话已改变，原操作和输入保留，请核对原结果。
shell.commitSessionChangedAwaitOriginalR.en-US: The original content was committed, but the file session changed while waiting. The original operation and input are retained; check the original result.

shell.savedRecoveryUpdateUnavailable.zh-CN: 文件已保存；恢复草稿更新暂不可用，当前输入保留。
shell.savedRecoveryUpdateUnavailable.en-US: The file is saved, but the recovery draft update is temporarily unavailable. The current input is retained.

shell.saveAsCreatedTargetChanged.zh-CN: 另存为目标已创建，但重新打开时发现内容或恢复状态已变化。当前草稿保留在原文件会话中；请明确打开目标并比较。
shell.saveAsCreatedTargetChanged.en-US: The Save as target was created, but its content or recovery status changed when reopened. The current draft remains in the original file session; explicitly open the target and compare.

shell.savedBasisChangedCheckDisk.zh-CN: 原内容已保存；当前文件或会话依据已变化，原操作、输入和撤销记录保留，请核对当前磁盘内容。
shell.savedBasisChangedCheckDisk.en-US: The original content is saved, but the current file or session basis changed. The original operation, input, and Undo history are retained; check the current disk content.

shell.savedLaterInputInDraft.zh-CN: 提交内容已保存，后续输入仍在草稿中。
shell.savedLaterInputInDraft.en-US: The submitted content is saved. Later input remains in the draft.

shell.savedQueriesNotRunnable.zh-CN: 正文已按原文保存；部分查询定义尚不可运行，请核对其配置或预约。
shell.savedQueriesNotRunnable.en-US: The body is saved exactly as written. Some query definitions cannot run yet; check their configuration or reservations.

shell.committedDeliveryIncomplete.zh-CN: 原内容已提交，结果交付尚未完成。原操作与输入保留；再次保存先核对原结果。
shell.committedDeliveryIncomplete.en-US: The original content was committed, but result delivery is incomplete. The original operation and input are retained; saving again will first check the original result.

shell.savedRecoveryInformationFailed.zh-CN: 文件已保存；后续恢复信息更新失败：{p0}
shell.savedRecoveryInformationFailed.en-US: The file is saved; a later recovery information update failed: {p0}

shell.saveUnknownConfirmSameOperation.zh-CN: 保存结果未知。草稿已保留；再次保存将确认同一操作。
shell.saveUnknownConfirmSameOperation.en-US: The save result is unknown. The draft is retained; saving again will confirm the same operation.

shell.compareDraftAndDiskDescription.zh-CN: 检查原始版本与磁盘现状，在合并框中保留需要的内容。应用合并只更新草稿，之后仍需保存。
shell.compareDraftAndDiskDescription.en-US: Check the original version and current disk content, and keep the content you need in the merge field. Applying a merge updates only the draft; you still need to save afterward.

shell.draftOriginalVersionUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 该草稿的原始版本无法确认，请自行比较；不会自动覆盖当前内容。
shell.draftOriginalVersionUnconfirmed.en-US: This draft’s original version cannot be confirmed. Compare it yourself; the current content will not be overwritten automatically.

shell.mergeConfirmationNewInput.zh-CN: 确认合并期间又有新输入。新输入和撤销记录保持原样，已确认的合并稿也保留，请再次比较。
shell.mergeConfirmationNewInput.en-US: New input appeared while confirming the merge. The new input and Undo history are unchanged, and the confirmed merged draft is also retained. Compare again.

shell.diskVersionAppliedRecoveryKept.zh-CN: 已采用磁盘版本。原恢复草稿保留在恢复历史中。
shell.diskVersionAppliedRecoveryKept.en-US: The disk version was applied. The original recovery draft is retained in recovery history.

shell.explicitMergeApplied.zh-CN: 已应用明确合并的草稿，保存后才会写入磁盘。
shell.explicitMergeApplied.en-US: The explicitly merged draft was applied. It will be written to disk only after saving.

shell.recoveryRecordsDescription.zh-CN: 未保存草稿会在下次打开同一文件时恢复。这里显示需要检查的文件操作。
shell.recoveryRecordsDescription.en-US: Unsaved drafts are restored the next time the same file is opened. File operations that need checking are shown here.

shell.noPendingFileOperations.zh-CN: 目前没有需要处理的文件操作。
shell.noPendingFileOperations.en-US: There are no file operations requiring attention.

shell.inspectFileRecoveryDescription.zh-CN: 逐个核对参与文件。只有全部状态能够确认时，才提供保留、接纳或继续原操作；其他修改不会被覆盖。原始内容仍保留在恢复历史中。
shell.inspectFileRecoveryDescription.en-US: Check each participating file. Keep, accept, or continue the original operation only when every state can be confirmed; other changes will not be overwritten. The original content remains in recovery history.

shell.recoveryCompletePlanned.en-US: Complete planned state after the operation

shell.recoveryConfirmedIntermediate.zh-CN: 已确认的中间位置，内容保留

shell.recoveryPartialAllFilesConfirmed.zh-CN: 部分文件已完成，所有参与文件仍可确认

documentNotes.proposalReadOnly.zh-CN: 草稿或来源已变化；本提案只读，未应用输入保留。关闭后重新打开当前注释。
documentNotes.proposalReadOnly.en-US: The draft or source has changed. This proposal is read-only and unapplied input is retained. Close it and reopen the current note.

documentNotes.applying.zh-CN: 正在核对并应用到共享草稿…
documentNotes.applying.en-US: Checking and applying to the shared draft…

documentNotes.undoAfterApplyHelp.en-US: {p0}; after applying, use body undo to restore it.

documentNotes.captionScope.en-US: The caption changes only the selected object

documentNotes.noteScope.zh-CN: 标记与正文属于同一个原生注释
documentNotes.noteScope.en-US: The markers and body belong to the same native note

documentNotes.applyBeforeNewProposal.zh-CN: 当前内容尚未应用，请先应用或取消提案。
documentNotes.applyBeforeNewProposal.en-US: Current content has not been applied. Apply or cancel the proposal first.

documentNotes.unlocatedNativeSource.zh-CN: 合法原生来源未取得唯一显示关系：{p0}
documentNotes.unlocatedNativeSource.en-US: Valid native source has no unique display mapping: {p0}

writing.integerRequired.en-US: Enter an integer within the allowed range.

writing.basisChanged.zh-CN: 打开控件后草稿已变化，请重新打开并检查当前内容。
writing.basisChanged.en-US: The draft has changed since these controls opened. Reopen them and check the current content.

writing.waitEditingMap.zh-CN: 等待最新编辑地图后再编辑标题。
writing.waitEditingMap.en-US: Wait for the latest editing map before editing the title.

writing.uniqueTitleRequired.zh-CN: 请先创建唯一文档标题，再添加副标题。
writing.uniqueTitleRequired.en-US: Create one unambiguous document title before adding a subtitle.

writing.titleHelp.zh-CN: 标题与章节标题分开。清空标题会一并移除与它关联的副标题。
writing.titleHelp.en-US: The document title is separate from section headings. Clearing it also removes its associated subtitle.

writing.subtitleHelp.zh-CN: 副标题与文档标题关联，采用原生 block，不参与章节编号。
writing.subtitleHelp.en-US: The subtitle is linked to the document title, uses a native block and does not participate in section numbering.

writing.titleText.zh-CN: 标题文字（留空表示无标题）
writing.titleText.en-US: Title text (leave blank for no title)

writing.subtitleText.zh-CN: 副标题文字（留空表示移除）

writing.insertHelp.zh-CN: 文字按原生 Typst 普通文字编码。公式使用原生数学表达；表格粘贴预览完整行列后一次应用。
writing.insertHelp.en-US: Text is encoded as native Typst plain text. Equations use native math expressions. Pasted tables are previewed with all rows and columns, then applied in one change.

writing.headingLevelHelp.zh-CN: 标题级别（常用 1–9，也可输入更深级别）
writing.headingLevelHelp.en-US: Heading level (usually 1–9; deeper levels are also accepted)

writing.imagePathHelp.zh-CN: 已导入本篇的图片相对路径，例如 assets/图片.png；先从资源入口导入外部图片。
writing.imagePathHelp.en-US: Relative path of an image imported into this note, such as assets/图片.png. Import external images through the resources entry first.

writing.tsvInputHelp.zh-CN: 单元格以 Tab 分隔，每行换行。
writing.tsvInputHelp.en-US: Separate cells with Tab and rows with newlines.

writing.listInputHelp.zh-CN: 每行是一项，可保留空项。
writing.listInputHelp.en-US: One item per line; empty items are preserved.

writing.tableDimensions.zh-CN: {p0} 行 × {p1} 列；全部单元格一次写入。
writing.tableDimensions.en-US: {p0} rows × {p1} columns; all cells are written in one change.

writing.headingSourceChanged.zh-CN: 标题来源在输入回写后已变化，请重新选择当前标题。
writing.headingSourceChanged.en-US: The heading source changed after input was written back. Select the current heading again.

writing.headingHelp.zh-CN: 每个标题保留自己的真实级别。接正文只改变这个标题，编号、大纲与引用仍使用原生 heading。
writing.headingHelp.en-US: Each heading keeps its actual level. Run-in changes only this heading; numbering, outline and references still use the native heading.

writing.runInHeading.zh-CN: 标题与紧随的普通正文同段
writing.runInHeading.en-US: Keep the heading in the same paragraph as the following body text

writing.equationSourceChanged.zh-CN: 公式来源在输入回写后已变化，请重新选择当前公式。
writing.equationSourceChanged.en-US: The equation source changed after input was written back. Select the current equation again.

writing.equationHelp.zh-CN: 公式保留原生数学源；可视符号作为完整公式呈现，修改后由官方编译器预览。
writing.equationHelp.en-US: Equations retain native math source. Visual symbols are rendered as one complete equation; the official compiler previews changes.

writing.nativeMathExpression.zh-CN: 原生 Typst 数学表达

writing.codeSourceChanged.zh-CN: 代码来源在输入回写后已变化，请重新选择当前代码。
writing.codeSourceChanged.en-US: The code source changed after input was written back. Select the current code again.

writing.codeRangeUnavailable.zh-CN: 这段代码没有可证明的原生内容范围，请使用源码入口。
writing.codeRangeUnavailable.en-US: No native content range can be verified for this code. Use the source editor.

writing.codeHelp.zh-CN: 代码内容保留原字节和缩进。语言只选择原生代码高亮，中文注释和字符串无需额外标记。
writing.codeHelp.en-US: Code retains its original bytes and indentation. The language controls only native syntax highlighting; Chinese comments and strings need no extra markers.

writing.tableSourceChanged.zh-CN: 表格来源在输入回写后已变化，请重新选择当前表格。
writing.tableSourceChanged.en-US: The table source changed after input was written back. Select the current table again.

writing.tableHelp.zh-CN: 所有输入进入同一草稿。Esc 从格内返回网格，关闭此窗口保留已输入文字；保存笔记仍使用原保存入口。
writing.tableHelp.en-US: All input enters the same draft. Esc returns from a cell to the grid, and closing this window retains entered text. Save the note with the existing Save action.

writing.linkHelp.zh-CN: 链接作为原生 Typst 内容写入当前草稿，保存后才提交。
writing.linkHelp.en-US: The link is written as native Typst content in the current draft and is committed only when the note is saved.

writing.clipboardTableHelp.zh-CN: 在正文插入一张原生表格。HTML 转换不执行脚本或加载外部资源；第一行不会自动成为表头。
writing.clipboardTableHelp.en-US: Insert a native table in the body. HTML conversion runs no scripts and loads no external resources. The first row does not automatically become a header.

writing.acceptTextConversionLoss.zh-CN: 接受以上明确列出的文字化损失
writing.acceptTextConversionLoss.en-US: Accept the text-conversion losses listed above

writing.clipboardTableSummary.zh-CN:
{p0} 行 × {p1} 列，{p2} 个作者单元格；全部一次插入。
{p3}
writing.clipboardTableSummary.en-US:
{p0} rows × {p1} columns, {p2} author cells; insert all in one change.
{p3}

writing.clipboardTargetChanged.zh-CN: 剪贴板读取期间输入或作者目标已变化，未交付旧内容。
writing.clipboardTargetChanged.en-US: The input or author target changed while reading the clipboard. Earlier content was not delivered.

writing.clipboardReadUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前环境不能读取剪贴板；请在输入框使用系统粘贴，原稿未变。
writing.clipboardReadUnavailable.en-US: Clipboard reading is unavailable. Use system paste in the input box; the original draft is unchanged.

writing.tableInput.zh-CN: 表格输入（也可直接系统粘贴）
writing.tableInput.en-US: Table input (system paste is also available)

writing.fixTableInput.zh-CN: 请先修正表格输入，尚未插入任何内容。
writing.fixTableInput.en-US: Correct the table input first. Nothing has been inserted.

writing.acceptFormatLossRequired.zh-CN: 请明确接受预览中的格式损失，或取消并保留输入。
writing.acceptFormatLossRequired.en-US: Explicitly accept the format losses in the preview, or cancel and keep your input.

writing.structureExpired.zh-CN: 这个结构入口已过期，请等待当前预览后重试。
writing.structureExpired.en-US: This structure action has expired. Wait for the current preview and try again.

tableGrid.sourceChanged.zh-CN: 表格来源或视图已变化，请重新选择当前表格；输入仍保留在共享草稿。
tableGrid.sourceChanged.en-US: The table source or view has changed. Select the current table again; your input remains in the shared draft.

tableGrid.cellEditingHelp.zh-CN: 格内方向键选择文字；Shift+Enter 换行，Enter 下一行，Esc 保留输入并返回网格。
tableGrid.cellEditingHelp.en-US: Use arrow keys to select text within the cell; Shift+Enter inserts a line break, Enter moves to the next row, and Esc keeps your input and returns to the grid.

tableGrid.gridNavigationHelp.zh-CN: 方向键移动，Shift 扩选，Enter/F2 编辑，Delete 只清内容。
tableGrid.gridNavigationHelp.en-US: Use arrow keys to move, Shift to extend the selection, Enter/F2 to edit, and Delete to clear content only.

tableGrid.appendRowHelp.zh-CN: 末行 Enter 可追加一行。
tableGrid.appendRowHelp.en-US: Press Enter in the last row to append a row.

tableGrid.topologyUnverified.en-US: The source or topology cannot be verified

tableGrid.compositionPending.zh-CN: 请先完成输入法组合；当前文字和位置已保留。
tableGrid.compositionPending.en-US: Finish composing text first; your current text and position are preserved.

tableGrid.mappingUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前表格映射不可用，文字已保留。
tableGrid.mappingUnavailable.en-US: The current table mapping is unavailable; your text is preserved.

tableGrid.proposalExpired.zh-CN: 表格提案已过期，未将旧选区应用到当前稿。
tableGrid.proposalExpired.en-US: The table proposal has expired. The previous selection was not applied to the current draft.

tableGrid.structureChangeUnsafe.zh-CN: 当前表格不能安全变更结构，原稿保留。
tableGrid.structureChangeUnsafe.en-US: The current table structure cannot be changed safely; the original draft is preserved.

tableGrid.changeAwaitingPreview.zh-CN: 变更已进入草稿，等待当前表格预览。
tableGrid.changeAwaitingPreview.en-US: The change is in the draft. Waiting for the current table preview.

tableGrid.nativeCellUseSource.zh-CN: 此格包含格式、公式或生成内容；保留原生内容，可使用编辑此表源码。
tableGrid.nativeCellUseSource.en-US: This cell contains formatting, formulas, or generated content. Its native content is preserved; use Edit this table's source.

tableGrid.wholeCellSelectionNotice.zh-CN: 点击字符位置尚未映射，已选择本格全部文字；可在输入框内继续放置光标。
tableGrid.wholeCellSelectionNotice.en-US: The clicked character position is not mapped, so all text in this cell is selected. You can place the cursor within the input.

tableGrid.cellTextLabel.zh-CN: 第 {p0} 行第 {p1} 列文字

tableGrid.linkProjectionExpired.zh-CN: 表格链接投影已过期，请等待当前预览。
tableGrid.linkProjectionExpired.en-US: The table link projection has expired. Wait for the current preview.

tableGrid.cellSourceUnavailable.zh-CN: 此格没有唯一的文字写入来源；可选择、复制或编辑此表源码。
tableGrid.cellSourceUnavailable.en-US: This cell has no unique source for text edits. You can select, copy, or edit this table's source.

tableGrid.useExplicitCut.zh-CN: 请使用“剪切范围”：成功写入剪贴板后才清空，失败保留原稿。
tableGrid.useExplicitCut.en-US: Use Cut range: content is cleared only after it is copied successfully. If copying fails, the original draft is preserved.

tableGrid.selectionTextExportUnavailable.zh-CN: 所选范围含公式、链接或格式内容，尚无准确的文字导出映射；原稿保留，请使用文档导出。
tableGrid.selectionTextExportUnavailable.en-US: The selected range contains formulas, links, or formatted content without an exact text export mapping. The original draft is preserved; use document export.

tableGrid.flattenCopyTitle.zh-CN: 合并格复制为平面格式
tableGrid.flattenCopyTitle.en-US: Copy merged cells to a flat format

tableGrid.flattenCopyHelp.zh-CN: 合并格文字放在左上原点，覆盖槽为空。表头和格式不会保留。
tableGrid.flattenCopyHelp.en-US: Merged-cell text goes in the top-left cell; covered cells are empty. Headers and formatting are not preserved.

tableGrid.copyConfirmationExpired.zh-CN: 确认期间表格或选区已变化，未复制旧范围。
tableGrid.copyConfirmationExpired.en-US: The table or selection changed during confirmation. The previous range was not copied.

tableGrid.htmlClipboardUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前环境不能写 HTML 剪贴板。请选择明确的 TSV/CSV 纯文本输出；尚未改稿。
tableGrid.htmlClipboardUnavailable.en-US: This environment cannot write HTML to the clipboard. Choose TSV/CSV plain-text output; the draft is unchanged.

tableGrid.clipboardWriteUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前环境没有剪贴板写权限；原稿未变。
tableGrid.clipboardWriteUnavailable.en-US: This environment cannot write to the clipboard; the original draft is unchanged.

tableGrid.cutTargetChanged.zh-CN: 已复制原选区，但草稿或选区已变化；未清空任何内容。
tableGrid.cutTargetChanged.en-US: The original selection was copied, but the draft or selection has changed. No content was cleared.

tableGrid.copyComplete.zh-CN: 已复制{p0}为 {p1}，{p2} 行 × {p3} 列。

tableGrid.pasteSelectionSizeMismatch.zh-CN: 剪贴板 {p0} 行 × {p1} 列与选区尺寸不一致；请选择单格作为粘贴起点。
tableGrid.pasteSelectionSizeMismatch.en-US: The clipboard's {p0} rows × {p1} columns do not match the selection size. Select one cell as the paste origin.

tableGrid.pasteRequiresExpansion.zh-CN: 需要扩展当前表格；确认后一次扩展并粘贴。
tableGrid.pasteRequiresExpansion.en-US: The current table must expand. Confirmation expands it and pastes in one change.

tableGrid.pasteWithinTable.zh-CN: 现有范围内一次替换，未选内容保持。
tableGrid.pasteWithinTable.en-US: Replace the existing range in one change; unselected content is preserved.

tableGrid.pastePreviewExpired.zh-CN: 粘贴预览已过期，保留剪贴板输入与原表。
tableGrid.pastePreviewExpired.en-US: The paste preview has expired. Clipboard input and the original table are preserved.

tableGrid.clipboardReadTargetChanged.zh-CN: 读取剪贴板期间目标已变化，旧内容未贴入新位置。
tableGrid.clipboardReadTargetChanged.en-US: The target changed while reading the clipboard. Previous content was not pasted into the new position.

tableGrid.clipboardFormatUnsupported.zh-CN: 剪贴板没有受支持的 HTML 或 TSV 表格，请保留原输入并选择其它格式。
tableGrid.clipboardFormatUnsupported.en-US: The clipboard has no supported HTML or TSV table. Keep the original input and choose another format.

tableGrid.clipboardReadUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前环境不能读取剪贴板。请聚焦网格后使用系统粘贴；原稿未变。
tableGrid.clipboardReadUnavailable.en-US: This environment cannot read the clipboard. Focus the grid and use system paste; the original draft is unchanged.

tableGrid.deleteRequiresOneRow.zh-CN: 请用行把手选择一行，再执行删除；未拆分为多项操作。
tableGrid.deleteRequiresOneRow.en-US: Select one row with its handle before deleting. The request was not split into multiple operations.

tableGrid.deleteRequiresOneColumn.zh-CN: 请用列把手选择一列，再执行删除；未拆分为多项操作。
tableGrid.deleteRequiresOneColumn.en-US: Select one column with its handle before deleting. The request was not split into multiple operations.

tableGrid.moveAtBoundary.zh-CN: 已在表格边界，未移动内容。
tableGrid.moveAtBoundary.en-US: Already at the table boundary; no content was moved.

tableGrid.mergeHelp.zh-CN: 所选内容按逻辑行序全部保存在左上格，以段落分隔。原生公式、链接及格内格式保留；不兼容格式会整次拒绝。
tableGrid.mergeHelp.en-US: All selected content is kept in logical row order in the top-left cell, separated by paragraphs. Native formulas, links, and cell formatting are preserved; incompatible formatting rejects the entire operation.

tableGrid.splitHelp.zh-CN: 原内容和格内格式留在左上格，新拆出的其余单元格为空。
tableGrid.splitHelp.en-US: The original content and cell formatting stay in the top-left cell. The other newly split cells are empty.

tableGrid.leadingRowsAsHeader.en-US: Use selected leading rows as header

tableGrid.headerMustStartAtFirstRow.zh-CN: 原生行表头必须从首行开始；请先选择完整的前几行。
tableGrid.headerMustStartAtFirstRow.en-US: Native header rows must start with the first row. Select complete leading rows first.

tableGrid.transposeRequiresNoHeader.zh-CN: 原生表头仅支持整行，转置前请明确取消表头；不会静默转成数据。
tableGrid.transposeRequiresNoHeader.en-US: Native headers support whole rows only. Explicitly remove the header designation before transposing; header rows are not silently converted to data.

tableGrid.transposeHelp.zh-CN: 整张表格的行与列交换，跨格方向随之交换，内容与格内格式留在原逻辑单元格。无法安全交换的行列样式会整次拒绝。
tableGrid.transposeHelp.en-US: Swap the whole table's rows and columns, including span directions. Content and cell formatting stay with their original logical cells. Row or column styles that cannot be swapped safely reject the entire operation.

tableGrid.pastePreviewLabel.zh-CN: 待粘贴的完整表格内容

proofreading.optionsShapeInvalid.zh-CN: 规则文件需要四类开关、rules 与 allowlist，每类最多 2000 项。
proofreading.optionsShapeInvalid.en-US: The rule file requires all four category switches, rules and allowlist, with at most 2,000 entries in each list.

proofreading.ruleFormatInvalid.zh-CN: 规则标识、版本、词条或替换格式无效；敏感词只能提示。
proofreading.ruleFormatInvalid.en-US: A rule ID, version, term or replacement has an invalid format. Sensitive terms can only produce notices.

proofreading.allowlistFormatInvalid.zh-CN: 白名单须为非空词条数组。
proofreading.allowlistFormatInvalid.en-US: The allowlist must be an array of nonempty terms.

proofreading.sharedDictionaryOriginMissi.zh-CN: 共享词表缺少准确来源依据。
proofreading.sharedDictionaryOriginMissi.en-US: The shared dictionary lacks an exact source basis.

proofreading.allowlistBudgetExceeded.en-US: The allowlist exceeds the size limit.

proofreading.preferencesSaveFailed.zh-CN: 规则暂存在本次会话，无法保存本机设置。
proofreading.preferencesSaveFailed.en-US: The rules are retained for this session; local settings could not be saved.

proofreading.selectionRequired.zh-CN: 请先选择正文或源码中的准确范围。
proofreading.selectionRequired.en-US: Select an exact range in the body or source first.

proofreading.scanBasisChanged.zh-CN: 正文或规则已经变化，本次旧结果未作为当前结果。请重新校对。
proofreading.scanBasisChanged.en-US: The body or rules have changed. These earlier results were not adopted as current results. Run proofreading again.

proofreading.scanSummary.zh-CN: 检查 {p0} 个字符，发现 {p1} 项{p2}。

proofreading.annotationBasisChanged.zh-CN: 正文已变化，请重新校对；已有批注保留。
proofreading.annotationBasisChanged.en-US: The body has changed. Run proofreading again; existing annotations are retained.

proofreading.saveBeforeAnnotations.zh-CN: 请先保存正文并重新校对，再保存范围批注；当前结果仍保留。
proofreading.saveBeforeAnnotations.en-US: Save the body and run proofreading again before saving range annotations. The current results are retained.

proofreading.annotationBatchRange.zh-CN: 每批请选择 1 至 200 条可定位结果。
proofreading.annotationBatchRange.en-US: Select 1 to 200 results with exact source locations per batch.

proofreading.ignoreOperation.zh-CN: 忽略所选校对结果并保存记录
proofreading.ignoreOperation.en-US: Ignore selected proofreading results and save the record

proofreading.annotateOperation.en-US: Add proofreading annotations in a batch

proofreading.ignoreSaved.zh-CN: 忽略记录已保存，可在已解决批注中查看。
proofreading.ignoreSaved.en-US: The ignore record was saved. You can view it among resolved annotations.

proofreading.annotationsSaved.zh-CN: 所选结果已加入批注，可在批注页审阅和回复。
proofreading.annotationsSaved.en-US: The selected results were added as annotations. Review and reply on the annotations page.

proofreading.help.zh-CN: 校对可见正文；不会检查代码、公式和链接内容，也不会自动修改文字。
proofreading.help.en-US: Proofreads visible body text. Code, equations and link content are excluded, and text is never changed automatically.

proofreading.languagesPlaceholder.zh-CN: 留空按原文标记；如 zh-Hans-CN, en-GB
proofreading.languagesPlaceholder.en-US: Leave blank to use source language tags; e.g. zh-Hans-CN, en-GB

proofreading.languagesUpdated.zh-CN: 本次明确语言选择已更新，旧结果已失效。
proofreading.languagesUpdated.en-US: The explicit language selection for this run was updated. Earlier results are no longer valid.

proofreading.languagesLabel.zh-CN: 本次处理语言／文字体系／地区（多语言可用逗号分隔）
proofreading.languagesLabel.en-US: Languages / scripts / regions for this run (separate multiple languages with commas)

proofreading.languageIndependenceHelp.zh-CN: 明确选择优先于原文标记；留空只用可证明的原文标记。地区和文字体系未知时保留未知。库默认仅供采用为本次选择，不由界面语言推断。方案：通用校对；不翻译、不简繁转换。
proofreading.languageIndependenceHelp.en-US: Explicit choices take precedence over source language tags. A blank selection uses only proven source tags. Unknown regions and scripts remain unknown. Library defaults can be explicitly adopted for this run and are never inferred from the interface language. Scheme: general proofreading, without translation or conversion between simplified and traditional Chinese.

proofreading.sharedSuggestionsLoaded.zh-CN: 共享建议已读取；检查来源、语言范围与词表后明确采用。
proofreading.sharedSuggestionsLoaded.en-US: Shared suggestions were loaded. Check their source, language scope and dictionary before explicitly adopting them.

proofreading.noSharedSuggestions.zh-CN: 当前库没有共享处理建议。
proofreading.noSharedSuggestions.en-US: This library has no shared processing suggestions.

proofreading.adoptSharedSuggestions.zh-CN: 采用为本次处理选择与词表
proofreading.adoptSharedSuggestions.en-US: Adopt settings and dictionary for this run

proofreading.sharedSuggestionsAdopted.zh-CN: 已明确采用共享建议；本次处理将持续核对原共享来源和词表版本。未修改文档或共享默认。
proofreading.sharedSuggestionsAdopted.en-US: Shared suggestions were explicitly adopted. This run will continue to verify their original shared source and dictionary version. The document and shared defaults were not changed.

proofreading.dictionarySummary.zh-CN: 词典与白名单（{p0} 条规则）

proofreading.localDictionaryHelp.zh-CN: 词典按准确词条匹配；未配置时会提示。设置暂存当前浏览器地址，重启或换地址前请导出规则文件，以便重新导入。
proofreading.localDictionaryHelp.en-US: Dictionary matching uses exact terms; missing configuration produces a notice. Settings are stored for the current browser address. Export the rule file before restarting or changing the address so that it can be imported again.
