export.importCommittedActualCopyDirector.en-US: The import was committed. Actual new copy directory: {p0}

export.importCommittedCannotOpenActualCo.zh-CN: 导入已提交，但当前环境缺少打开真实新副本的入口；保留实际回执。
export.importCommittedCannotOpenActualCo.en-US: The import was committed, but this environment has no entry to open the actual new copy. The actual receipt is retained.

export.importCommittedReceiptLocationMis.zh-CN: 导入已提交，但实际回执没有返回新副本位置；请检查原操作。
export.importCommittedReceiptLocationMis.en-US: The import was committed, but the actual receipt did not return the new copy location. Check the original operation.

export.xlsxTemplateDescription.zh-CN: 未选择文件时输出当前笔记的正式属性。需要结果表时，从查询中的“输出本次查询结果”进入。模板中的具名单元格或区域会列为可选择的槽位。
export.xlsxTemplateDescription.en-US: Without a selected file, output uses the current note’s formal properties. For a result table, use “Output these query results” in the query. Named cells or ranges in the template are listed as selectable slots.

export.officeTemplateDescription.zh-CN: 未选择文件时使用内置输出模板。已有标准内容控件或工作簿名称会作为可选择的槽位。
export.officeTemplateDescription.en-US: Without a selected file, output uses the built-in template. Existing standard content controls or workbook names become selectable slots.

export.nativePackageDescription.zh-CN: 原生包输出已保存的整个资料库，须先保存所有打开的库内草稿。包含纳管内容与可交付依赖；恢复历史和本机执行证据不随包转移。
export.nativePackageDescription.en-US: Native package output includes the entire saved library. Save all open in-library drafts first. It includes managed content and deliverable dependencies; recovery history and local execution evidence do not transfer with the package.

export.formatNoOfficeTemplate.zh-CN: 此格式直接消费冻结原生输入，不使用 Office 模板。
export.formatNoOfficeTemplate.en-US: This format directly consumes frozen native input and does not use an Office template.

export.openNoteBeforeOutputImport.zh-CN: 请先打开一个笔记，再选择输出或导入。
export.openNoteBeforeOutputImport.en-US: Open a note before choosing output or import.

hostedLibrary.recoveryCacheRemovalFailed.zh-CN: 浏览器拒绝删除部分库配置恢复缓存；受保护展示已清除。
hostedLibrary.recoveryCacheRemovalFailed.en-US: The browser refused to delete some library configuration recovery cache. Protected displays were cleared.

hostedLibrary.catalogRoleEligibilityMiss.zh-CN: 库配置目录缺少准确角色资格。
hostedLibrary.catalogRoleEligibilityMiss.en-US: The library configuration catalog has no exact role eligibility.

hostedLibrary.configurationSeparateFromB.zh-CN: 配置与正文草稿分别保存。原生源码保留，先准备并核对变更，再明确提交原操作；不会自动保存笔记。
hostedLibrary.configurationSeparateFromB.en-US: Configuration and body drafts are saved separately. Native source is retained; prepare and check changes before explicitly committing the original operation. The note is not saved automatically.

hostedLibrary.styleExecutionGranted.zh-CN: 具备独立库样式执行资格；执行资格不交付样式源码。
hostedLibrary.styleExecutionGranted.en-US: Independent library style execution is permitted; this permission does not deliver the style source.

hostedLibrary.styleExecutionNotGranted.zh-CN: 没有独立库样式执行资格。
hostedLibrary.styleExecutionNotGranted.en-US: Independent library style execution is not permitted.

hostedLibrary.roleUnreadable.zh-CN: 配置角色当前不可读取。
hostedLibrary.roleUnreadable.en-US: The configuration role cannot currently be read.

hostedLibrary.originalOperationNeedsChec.zh-CN: 原配置操作待核对；无需当前读取依据也可查询原编号。
hostedLibrary.originalOperationNeedsChec.en-US: The original configuration operation needs verification. Its original ID can be queried without the current read basis.

hostedLibrary.selectRoleReadExactConfigu.zh-CN: 选择角色后读取准确配置。恢复输入不会被读取覆盖。
hostedLibrary.selectRoleReadExactConfigu.en-US: Select a role to read its exact configuration. Reading will not overwrite recovery input.

hostedLibrary.operationIncompleteInputRe.zh-CN: 配置操作未完成，原输入与原操作保留。
hostedLibrary.operationIncompleteInputRe.en-US: The configuration operation is incomplete. The original input and operation are retained.

hostedLibrary.readRoleOrSourceMismatch.zh-CN: 配置读取不对应原角色或准确源码，输入保留。
hostedLibrary.readRoleOrSourceMismatch.en-US: The configuration read does not match the original role or exact source. Your input is retained.

hostedLibrary.serverBasisChangedCompare.zh-CN: 服务端配置依据已变化；原输入保留，请比较双方再确认新依据。
hostedLibrary.serverBasisChangedCompare.en-US: The server configuration basis changed. The original input is retained; compare both versions before confirming a new basis.

hostedLibrary.exactConfigurationRead.zh-CN: 已读取准确配置，改动尚未提交。
hostedLibrary.exactConfigurationRead.en-US: The exact configuration was read. Changes are not yet committed.

hostedLibrary.readButRecoveryUnavailable.zh-CN: 准确配置已读取，本页原文可复制；浏览器无法保留恢复缓存，尚未发送写操作。

hostedLibrary.inputRetainedNotPrepared.zh-CN: 配置输入已保留，尚未准备或提交。
hostedLibrary.inputRetainedNotPrepared.en-US: Configuration input is retained. It has not been prepared or committed.

hostedLibrary.inputRecoveryRequiredBefor.zh-CN: 浏览器无法保留配置输入，请先复制；原操作发送前必须成功保留恢复记录。
hostedLibrary.inputRecoveryRequiredBefor.en-US: The browser cannot retain configuration input. Copy it first; the recovery record must be retained successfully before sending the original operation.

hostedLibrary.readWritableConfigurationF.zh-CN: 请先读取当前可写配置。
hostedLibrary.readWritableConfigurationF.en-US: Read the current writable configuration first.

hostedLibrary.checkPreparedPreviewContex.en-US: Check the original prepared preview. New input or current eligibility changed; nothing has been committed.

hostedLibrary.planPreparedCheckExactSour.zh-CN: 原配置计划已准备，请核对准确原文后明确提交。
hostedLibrary.planPreparedCheckExactSour.en-US: The original configuration plan is prepared. Check the exact original text before explicitly committing.

hostedLibrary.originalOperationStatus.zh-CN: 原配置操作状态：{p0}。未冒作保存成功，请查询原编号或明确结束。
hostedLibrary.originalOperationStatus.en-US: Original configuration operation status: {p0}. This is not treated as a successful save; query the original ID or explicitly end the operation.

hostedLibrary.operationCommittedRereadBa.zh-CN: 原配置操作已提交；后续输入保留。请重新读取准确依据；正文未保存。
hostedLibrary.operationCommittedRereadBa.en-US: The original configuration operation was committed. Later input is retained; reread the exact basis. The body was not saved.

hostedLibrary.operationEndedRereadBasis.en-US: The original configuration operation ended and is not treated as saved. Your input is retained; reread the exact basis.

hostedLibrary.receiptCacheUpdateFailed.zh-CN: 原配置事实 {p0} 已收到，但浏览器无法更新恢复缓存；请保留原编号核对：{p1}
hostedLibrary.receiptCacheUpdateFailed.en-US: Original configuration facts {p0} were received, but the browser could not update recovery cache. Keep the original ID for verification: {p1}

hostedLibrary.automaticallyApplyDefaultS.en-US: Automatically apply the library default style

hostedLibrary.styleControlsSourceBoundar.zh-CN: 控件修改准确原生参数；完整源码保留未知规则。编辑完整源码时控件暂停，不能同时提交两份输入。
hostedLibrary.styleControlsSourceBoundar.en-US: Controls modify exact native parameters; the complete source retains unknown rules. Controls pause when editing the complete source, so two inputs cannot be committed at once.

hostedLibrary.unmappedOriginalControl.zh-CN: 未映射原控件 {p0}：{p1}（保留，不能静默提交）
hostedLibrary.unmappedOriginalControl.en-US: Unmapped original control {p0}: {p1} (retained; cannot be committed silently)

hostedLibrary.discardControlInputUseSour.en-US: Discard control input and use the complete source

hostedLibrary.siblingReorderGranted.en-US: Independent author sibling reordering is permitted. Changes to navigationOrders are previewed and committed as part of the complete library settings. Personal list sorting does not write here.

hostedLibrary.siblingReorderNotGranted.zh-CN: 没有独立作者同级重排资格；普通库设置写权不能修改 navigationOrders。
hostedLibrary.siblingReorderNotGranted.en-US: Independent author sibling reordering is not permitted. Ordinary library settings write permission cannot modify navigationOrders.

hostedLibrary.sharedProcessingDescriptio.zh-CN: 这里是导入／校对的共享建议，只有用户在本次处理明确采用才启用；文档语言仍由原生 Typst 决定。保存复用当前库设置的权限、历史与同步。
hostedLibrary.sharedProcessingDescriptio.en-US: These are shared suggestions for import and proofreading. They take effect only when explicitly adopted for the current processing task; document language is still determined by native Typst. Saving uses the current library settings permissions, history, and sync.

hostedLibrary.addSharedProcessingSuggest.zh-CN: 添加共享通用处理建议

hostedLibrary.defaultProcessingLanguages.zh-CN: 默认建议语言／文字体系／地区（可多选，未知地区省略）
hostedLibrary.defaultProcessingLanguages.en-US: Suggested default languages / scripts / regions (multiple selections; omit unknown regions)

hostedLibrary.processingSettingsCannotPa.zh-CN: 当前共享处理设置不能由友好控件安全解析，原 JSON 已保留；请在源码中核对，未覆盖未知规则。
hostedLibrary.processingSettingsCannotPa.en-US: The current shared processing settings cannot be safely parsed by the friendly controls. The original JSON is retained; check it in source. Unknown rules were not overwritten.

hostedLibrary.fullNativeStyleSource.zh-CN: 完整原生 Typst 样式源码

hostedLibrary.fullJsonConfigurationSourc.zh-CN: 完整 JSON 配置源码

hostedLibrary.configurationBasisChangedB.zh-CN: 配置依据已变化，保留双方原文

hostedLibrary.confirmCurrentSourceAsNewB.en-US: Configuration checked; use the current original text as the new basis

hostedLibrary.checkOriginalBeforeNewBasi.en-US: Check or end the original operation before confirming a new basis.

hostedLibrary.childrenOrSettingsBasisCha.zh-CN: 子级或库设置依据已变化，请保留输入并重新读取配置。
hostedLibrary.childrenOrSettingsBasisCha.en-US: The children or library settings basis changed. Keep your input and reread the configuration.

hostedLibrary.noAuthorizedNavigationPare.zh-CN: 没有独立获权的导航父级；作者重排权不授予全库成员读取。
hostedLibrary.noAuthorizedNavigationPare.en-US: There is no independently authorized navigation parent. Author reordering permission does not grant access to all library members.

hostedLibrary.childrenIncompleteCannotRe.zh-CN: 直接子级未完整接纳或观察，不能准备作者重排。
hostedLibrary.childrenIncompleteCannotRe.en-US: The direct children have not been fully admitted or observed. Author reordering cannot be prepared.

hostedLibrary.parentOrderNotReferenceArr.en-US: The current parent order is not a complete reference array. Check the original JSON.

hostedLibrary.jsonChangedInputNotOverwri.en-US: The JSON changed. The original input was not overwritten

hostedLibrary.navigationOrdersInvalid.zh-CN: 原navigationOrders格式无效，未覆盖原输入
hostedLibrary.navigationOrdersInvalid.en-US: The original navigationOrders format is invalid. The original input was not overwritten

hostedLibrary.configurationAfterOriginal.en-US: Configuration after the original plan’s commit

hostedLibrary.confirmOriginalConfigurati.en-US: Confirm commit of the original library configuration plan

endnoteModule.ownerOrCollectionMissing.en-US: There is no explicit owner and authorized collection. The endnote module was not installed.

endnoteModule.authorityOrDependencyChang.zh-CN: 尾注模块的当前归属、授权或执行依赖已变化；原操作保留，未继续提交。

endnoteModule.recoveryPersistenceFailed.zh-CN: 尾注模块恢复记录不可可靠保存；未发送下一项资源写入，请核对原操作。
endnoteModule.recoveryPersistenceFailed.en-US: The endnote module recovery record cannot be saved reliably. No next resource write was sent; check the original operation.

endnoteModule.retainedOperationBasisMism.zh-CN: 保留的尾注模块原操作属于另一依据，未重放到当前笔记。

endnoteModule.originalOperationChecking.zh-CN: 原尾注模块操作正在核对，请等待同一操作完成。

endnoteModule.resourceCatalogIncomplete.en-US: This note’s module resource catalog cannot be fully verified. No new resource was installed.

endnoteModule.locationOwnerAmbiguous.en-US: The endnote module location has ambiguous resource ownership. Nothing was overwritten or separately created.

endnoteModule.resourceCoveragePartial.en-US: The resource catalog has only partial coverage. It cannot prove that the endnote module is absent.

endnoteModule.existingModuleBytesUnverif.zh-CN: 已有模块的准确资源字节无法验证，未覆盖原文件。

endnoteModule.originalCheckedResourceUna.zh-CN: 原资源操作已核对，但当前模块资源不可用；不会换编号重新安装。

endnoteModule.sameNameResourceNotOrigina.zh-CN: 当前同名资源不是原安装回执的资源，未按路径冒领。
endnoteModule.sameNameResourceNotOrigina.en-US: The current same-named resource is not the resource from the original installation receipt. Ownership was not claimed by path.

endnoteModule.existingModuleReadPermissi.zh-CN: 模块资源已存在，但当前编译尚无该依赖的读取权限；正文未保存，未再次安装。

endnoteModule.originalByteDigestMismatch.en-US: The original module installation byte digest differs. The recovery record is retained; no operation was started.

endnoteModule.bundledVersionChanged.en-US: The bundled module version changed. The original operation was checked; the original request was not replaced with the new module and the old installation did not continue.

endnoteModule.noCancelledOriginalInstall.zh-CN: 没有已取消的原模块安装；请使用首次准备入口。
endnoteModule.noCancelledOriginalInstall.en-US: There is no cancelled original module installation. Use the initial preparation entry.

endnoteModule.originalNotExplicitlyCance.zh-CN: 原操作尚未明确取消，不能分配新编号；请继续核对或重试原操作。

endnoteModule.noRetryableInstall.zh-CN: 没有待重试的原模块安装，请先显式准备。
endnoteModule.noRetryableInstall.en-US: There is no original module installation to retry. Explicitly prepare it first.

endnoteModule.originalInputUnverified.zh-CN: 原安装输入无法验证，未发起重试。
endnoteModule.originalInputUnverified.en-US: The original installation input cannot be verified. No retry was started.

endnoteModule.bundledModuleChanged.zh-CN: 随附模块已变化，未用旧输入重新准备；原操作继续保留供核对。
endnoteModule.bundledModuleChanged.en-US: The bundled module changed. Old input was not used to prepare again; the original operation remains retained for checking.

endnoteModule.explicitEndUnavailable.zh-CN: 原安装没有可用的明确结束入口，未假报取消。
endnoteModule.explicitEndUnavailable.en-US: The original installation has no available explicit termination entry. Cancellation was not falsely reported.

libraryTrash.recordsReadIncomplete.zh-CN: 回收记录尚未读取完成。
libraryTrash.recordsReadIncomplete.en-US: Recycle records have not finished loading.

stylePanel.unresolvedDraftCannotReread.zh-CN: 设置草稿尚未处理，不能用重新读取覆盖。请先应用或关闭当前草稿。
stylePanel.unresolvedDraftCannotReread.en-US: The settings draft is unresolved and cannot be overwritten by rereading. Apply or close the current draft first.

stylePanel.sourceEditedControlsPaused.zh-CN: 已编辑完整原生源码；先恢复原文才可使用简化控件。
stylePanel.sourceEditedControlsPaused.en-US: The complete native source was edited. Restore the original text before using simplified controls.

stylePanel.nativeParameterNotUnique.zh-CN: 该规则没有唯一可写的原生参数，请使用源码入口。
stylePanel.nativeParameterNotUnique.en-US: This rule has no unique writable native parameter. Use the source view.

stylePanel.valueTypeMismatch.zh-CN: 设置值类型不符合原生控件。
stylePanel.valueTypeMismatch.en-US: The setting value type does not match the native control.

stylePanel.numberOutOfRange.zh-CN: 设置数值超出支持范围。
stylePanel.numberOutOfRange.en-US: The setting number is outside the supported range.

stylePanel.selectNativeOption.zh-CN: 请选择提供的原生选项，或使用源码入口。
stylePanel.selectNativeOption.en-US: Select a provided native option or use the source view.

stylePanel.cannotPrepare.zh-CN: 当前设置不能准备新操作。
stylePanel.cannotPrepare.en-US: Current settings cannot prepare a new operation.

stylePanel.noChanges.zh-CN: 没有待应用的设置改动。
stylePanel.noChanges.en-US: There are no settings changes to apply.

stylePanel.prepareBasisMismatch.zh-CN: 准备结果与当前原生源码或操作不一致；草稿已保留。
stylePanel.prepareBasisMismatch.en-US: The prepared result differs from the current native source or operation. The draft is retained.

stylePanel.viewPreparedSourceFirst.zh-CN: 请先查看准备好的原生源码变更。
stylePanel.viewPreparedSourceFirst.en-US: View the prepared native source changes first.

stylePanel.saveReceiptPlanMismatch.zh-CN: 样式保存回执与原计划不符；保留原操作供确认。
stylePanel.saveReceiptPlanMismatch.en-US: The style save receipt differs from the original plan. The original operation is retained for confirmation.

stylePanel.operationPending.zh-CN: 操作仍在处理或结果待确认；设置草稿已保留，请确认同一操作。
stylePanel.operationPending.en-US: The operation is processing or awaiting confirmation. The settings draft is retained; confirm the same operation.

stylePanel.syntaxInvalid.zh-CN: 样式语法尚未有效，请在源码中修复。
stylePanel.syntaxInvalid.en-US: The style syntax is not valid yet. Fix it in source.

stylePanel.styleEntryNotUnique.zh-CN: 没有唯一的库样式入口，请使用完整源码。
stylePanel.styleEntryNotUnique.en-US: There is no unique library style entry. Use the complete source.

stylePanel.parameterUndeclaredOrRepeated.zh-CN: 此参数未声明或存在多处规则，请使用源码。
stylePanel.parameterUndeclaredOrRepeated.en-US: This parameter is undeclared or appears in multiple rules. Use source.

stylePanel.parameterComputedOrAdvanced.zh-CN: 此参数使用计算表达式或高级原生值，请使用源码。
stylePanel.parameterComputedOrAdvanced.en-US: This parameter uses a computed expression or advanced native value. Use source.

stylePanel.nameCustomized.zh-CN: 此名称已被自定义，简化控件无法确认其原生含义。
stylePanel.nameCustomized.en-US: This name was customized. Simplified controls cannot confirm its native meaning.

stylePanel.nativeElementUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 无法确认这条规则使用原生标准元素，请使用源码。
stylePanel.nativeElementUnconfirmed.en-US: This rule cannot be confirmed to use a native standard element. Use source.

stylePanel.ruleScopeUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 此规则的作用范围无法由简化控件确认，请使用源码。
stylePanel.ruleScopeUnconfirmed.en-US: Simplified controls cannot confirm this rule’s scope. Use source.

stylePanel.nativeStyleDescription.zh-CN: 字体、间距、文档语言和地区来自同一份原生 Typst 模块。地区可留为未指定；语言与地区分别选择，不自动转换简繁或推断时区。单篇和局部原生规则遵循 Typst 作用域。此处设置不改变个人界面或本次导入／校对语言。
stylePanel.nativeStyleDescription.en-US: Fonts, spacing, document language, and region come from the same native Typst module. Region may remain unspecified; language and region are selected separately, without automatic simplified/traditional conversion or time-zone inference. Per-note and local native rules follow Typst scope. These settings do not change the personal interface or this import/proofreading language.

stylePanel.automaticallyApplyStyle.zh-CN: 自动应用这份库默认样式
stylePanel.automaticallyApplyStyle.en-US: Automatically apply this library default style

stylePanel.advancedNativeSource.zh-CN: 高级：编辑完整原生 Typst 样式源码
stylePanel.advancedNativeSource.en-US: Advanced: edit the complete native Typst style source

stylePanel.sourceEditingDescription.zh-CN: 无法识别的规则会完整保留。编辑源码后，简化控件暂停，准备操作将使用这里的精确原文。自定义 transformation 可能固定样式，其覆盖效果由原生 Typst 决定。
stylePanel.sourceEditingDescription.en-US: Unrecognized rules are retained completely. Simplified controls pause after source edits, and preparation uses the exact original text here. A custom transformation may fix styles; native Typst determines its override behavior.

stylePanel.committedRereadSuffix.zh-CN: 原操作已提交；重试将重新读取当前设置，操作记录已保留。
stylePanel.committedRereadSuffix.en-US: The original operation was committed. Retrying rereads current settings; the operation record is retained.

stylePanel.unconfirmedRetrySameSuffix.zh-CN: 操作结果待确认，重试将确认同一操作。设置草稿已保留。
stylePanel.unconfirmedRetrySameSuffix.en-US: The result awaits confirmation. Retrying confirms the same operation; the settings draft is retained.

stylePanel.draftUnapplied.en-US: The settings draft is not yet applied.

stylePanel.noLosslessSimplifiedControls.zh-CN: 这份模块没有可无损编辑的简化控件。请使用原生源码入口；全部现有规则保持原样。
stylePanel.noLosslessSimplifiedControls.en-US: This module has no simplified controls that can edit it losslessly. Use native source; all existing rules remain unchanged.

stylePanel.readStyleRestoredDiskUnchange.zh-CN: 已恢复本次读取的原生样式；磁盘没有改动。
stylePanel.readStyleRestoredDiskUnchange.en-US: The native style read for this operation was restored. The disk is unchanged.

stylePanel.styleSavedRecompiling.zh-CN: 库样式已保存，受影响预览将重新编译。
stylePanel.styleSavedRecompiling.en-US: The library style was saved. Affected previews will recompile.

stylePanel.styleSavedRefreshFailed.zh-CN: 库样式已保存；刷新预览时遇到问题：{p0}
stylePanel.styleSavedRefreshFailed.en-US: The library style was saved, but refreshing previews encountered a problem: {p0}

stylePanel.stillProcessingDraftRetained.zh-CN: 操作仍在处理，设置草稿已保留。
stylePanel.stillProcessingDraftRetained.en-US: The operation is still processing. The settings draft is retained.

workspaceTools.createdNoteOpenResultMiss.zh-CN: 新笔记缺少实际打开结果，请检查原操作。
workspaceTools.createdNoteOpenResultMiss.en-US: The new note lacks an actual opening result. Check the original operation.

workspaceTools.importReceiptLibraryLocat.zh-CN: 导入回执缺少可刷新资料库位置，实际回执已保留。
workspaceTools.importReceiptLibraryLocat.en-US: The import receipt lacks a library location to refresh. The actual receipt is retained.

workspaceTools.compileBeforeProofreading.zh-CN: 当前正文编译未成功，请先处理预览诊断再校对。
workspaceTools.compileBeforeProofreading.en-US: The current body did not compile successfully. Handle preview diagnostics before proofreading.

workspaceTools.libraryChangedRereadSugge.zh-CN: 资料库已变化，请重新读取共享建议。
workspaceTools.libraryChangedRereadSugge.en-US: The library changed. Read shared suggestions again.

workspaceTools.sharedDefaultsCommitted.zh-CN: 共享处理默认已提交；各次导入与校对仍须明确采用建议。
workspaceTools.sharedDefaultsCommitted.en-US: Shared processing defaults were committed. Each import or proofreading task still requires explicit adoption of suggestions.

workspaceTools.previousResourceImportCon.zh-CN: 已确认上一次资源导入成功。
workspaceTools.previousResourceImportCon.en-US: The previous resource import is confirmed successful.

workspaceTools.previousImportIncomplete.zh-CN: 上一次导入未完成，原文件仍保留。请再次选择后重新准备。
workspaceTools.previousImportIncomplete.en-US: The previous import is incomplete. The original file is retained; select it again and prepare again.

workspaceTools.resourceSizeLimit.zh-CN: 单个资源导入上限为 64 MiB，原文件保持不变。
workspaceTools.resourceSizeLimit.en-US: A single resource import is limited to 64 MiB. The original file is unchanged.

workspaceTools.noteChangedSelectResource.zh-CN: 当前笔记已变化，请重新选择资源。
workspaceTools.noteChangedSelectResource.en-US: The current note changed. Select the resource again.

workspaceTools.resourceCopyDescription.zh-CN: 将 {p0}（{p1} 字节）复制到当前笔记。原文件保留。
workspaceTools.resourceCopyDescription.en-US: Copy {p0} ({p1} bytes) into the current note. The original file is retained.

workspaceTools.resourceImportUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 资源导入结果待确认。再次导入会先检查原操作。
workspaceTools.resourceImportUnconfirmed.en-US: The resource import result awaits confirmation. Importing again first checks the original operation.

workspaceTools.draftChangedPrepareAgain.zh-CN: 草稿已变化，请重新准备。

workspaceTools.linkSourceChangesIncomple.zh-CN: 链接提案没有完整的准确源码变更。
workspaceTools.linkSourceChangesIncomple.en-US: The link proposal lacks complete exact source changes.

workspaceTools.linkProposalPreviewMismat.zh-CN: 链接提案与预览不一致。
workspaceTools.linkProposalPreviewMismat.en-US: The link proposal differs from the preview.

workspaceTools.linkUpdatedInDraft.zh-CN: 链接已更新到当前草稿，可撤销。
workspaceTools.linkUpdatedInDraft.en-US: The link is updated in the current draft and can be undone.

workspaceTools.committedUiUpdateIncomple.zh-CN: 原操作已提交；界面更新尚未完成，请检查原操作。
workspaceTools.committedUiUpdateIncomple.en-US: The original operation was committed, but the interface update is incomplete. Check the original operation.

workspaceTools.openLibraryBeforeStyle.zh-CN: 请先打开资料库，再设置库默认样式。
workspaceTools.openLibraryBeforeStyle.en-US: Open a library before setting its default style.

remoteSync.description.zh-CN: 使用管理员授予的同所有者完整同步凭据。传输只接收历史，应用仍需本机预览。凭据不写入浏览器存储。关闭窗口不会停止正在进行的传输。
remoteSync.description.en-US: Use full sync credentials for the same owner granted by an administrator. Transfer only receives history; applying it still requires a local preview. Credentials are not written to browser storage. Closing the window does not stop an ongoing transfer.

remoteSync.finishPreparationOrTransfer.zh-CN: 请先完成当前准备或传输。
remoteSync.finishPreparationOrTransfer.en-US: Finish the current preparation or transfer first.

remoteSync.readDirectorySelectObject.zh-CN: 请先读取远端目录并选择对象。
remoteSync.readDirectorySelectObject.en-US: Read the remote catalog and select an object first.

remoteSync.pairingChanged.zh-CN: 配对已变化，请重新读取远端目录。
remoteSync.pairingChanged.en-US: The pairing changed. Read the remote catalog again.

remoteSync.remoteObjectCount.zh-CN: 远端 {p0} 个对象；尚未接收或应用到本机。
remoteSync.remoteObjectCount.en-US: Remote has {p0} objects; nothing has been received or applied locally.

syncRevalidation.checkWithTransactionOrD.zh-CN: 随同一事务或依赖核对
syncRevalidation.checkWithTransactionOrD.en-US: Check with the same transaction or dependencies

syncRevalidation.technicalVersionsReques.zh-CN: 技术详情：完整版本与准确请求
syncRevalidation.technicalVersionsReques.en-US: Technical details: complete versions and exact request

syncRevalidation.title.zh-CN: 重新验证所选同步版本

syncRevalidation.description.zh-CN: 明确保留某个原分支，或修复它的准确文件。集中 Schema、原生绑定和查询基线不会自动改成最新值。普通暂时无法定位的链接仍可保留。编辑器草稿与撤销记录保留。
syncRevalidation.description.en-US: Explicitly retain an original branch or repair its exact files. The central Schema, native bindings, and query baseline are not automatically changed to the latest values. Ordinary links that are temporarily unlocatable may still be retained. Editor drafts and Undo history are retained.

syncRevalidation.candidateDescription.zh-CN: 下面是已收到的候选版本。只有明确选择的对象会生成重新验证决定；单分支依赖由 Core 按实际读取闭包选取。并发依赖需要明确选择一个完整分支并一并重新验证。
syncRevalidation.candidateDescription.en-US: Received candidate versions are listed below. Only explicitly selected objects produce revalidation decisions. Core selects single-branch dependencies using the actual read closure; concurrent dependencies require explicit selection of a complete branch and revalidation together.

syncRevalidation.candidateHistoryMissing.zh-CN: 候选历史中存在缺件；实际选择是否完整，以只读审阅结果为准。
syncRevalidation.candidateHistoryMissing.en-US: The candidate history has missing parts. Read-only review determines whether the actual selection is complete.

syncRevalidation.resolveUnconfirmedRepai.zh-CN: 请先采用或放弃尚未确认的文件修复内容。
syncRevalidation.resolveUnconfirmedRepai.en-US: Adopt or discard unconfirmed file-repair input first.

syncRevalidation.reviewSelectionChanged.zh-CN: 审阅期间选择或收到的版本已变化，请重新审阅。
syncRevalidation.reviewSelectionChanged.en-US: The selection or received versions changed during review. Review again.

syncRevalidation.confirmDependenciesPrev.zh-CN: 确认依赖并预览重新验证

syncRevalidation.receivedBranchCount.zh-CN: 当前收到 {p0} 个分支；本次审阅会核对完整分支集合。
syncRevalidation.receivedBranchCount.en-US: Currently received {p0} branches; this review checks the complete branch set.

syncRevalidation.dependencyCandidateOnly.zh-CN: 仅作为依赖候选，不重新验证此对象
syncRevalidation.dependencyCandidateOnly.en-US: Use only as a dependency candidate; do not revalidate this object

syncRevalidation.technicalCommitDependen.zh-CN: 技术详情：原提交依赖与未决项
syncRevalidation.technicalCommitDependen.en-US: Technical details: original commit dependencies and unresolved items

syncRevalidation.unselectedNoDecision.zh-CN: 未选择，不为此候选生成新的重新验证决定。
syncRevalidation.unselectedNoDecision.en-US: Not selected; no new revalidation decision is generated for this candidate.

syncRevalidation.keepBranchDescription.zh-CN: 保持原分支会保留准确字节、位置、资源和批注。若要修复，请读取原文件，编辑后明确采用该文件内容。
syncRevalidation.keepBranchDescription.en-US: Keeping the original branch retains exact bytes, location, resources, and annotations. To repair it, read the original file, edit it, then explicitly adopt that file’s content.

syncRevalidation.readOriginalFile.zh-CN: 读取原文件以检查或修复 {p0}
syncRevalidation.readOriginalFile.en-US: Read original file to inspect or repair {p0}

syncRevalidation.resolveFileRepairInput.zh-CN: 请先采用或放弃此文件未确认的修复输入。
syncRevalidation.resolveFileRepairInput.en-US: Adopt or discard this file’s unconfirmed repair input first.

syncRevalidation.fileReadBasisChanged.zh-CN: 文件读取依据已变化，请重新读取。
syncRevalidation.fileReadBasisChanged.en-US: The file-read basis changed. Read again.

syncRevalidation.adoptFileRepair.zh-CN: 采用此文件的修复内容

syncRevalidation.repairAdoptedRereadDepe.zh-CN: 已采用明确修复内容；请重新读取实际语义依赖。
syncRevalidation.repairAdoptedRereadDepe.en-US: Explicit repaired content was adopted. Read actual semantic dependencies again.

syncRevalidation.sameAsOriginalKeepRevis.zh-CN: 内容与原文件相同，保留原文件修订。
syncRevalidation.sameAsOriginalKeepRevis.en-US: Content matches the original file. The original file revision is retained.

syncRevalidation.repairUnadopted.zh-CN: 修复尚未采用；原文件和编辑器草稿保留。
syncRevalidation.repairUnadopted.en-US: Repair has not been adopted. The original file and editor draft are retained.

syncRevalidation.discardUnadoptedInput.zh-CN: 放弃此文件未采用的输入

syncRevalidation.checkReviewBeforePrevie.zh-CN: 请核对对象、保留或修复决定及实际依赖，再预览同步计划。当前文件与编辑器草稿尚未改变。
syncRevalidation.checkReviewBeforePrevie.en-US: Check objects, retain/repair decisions, and actual dependencies before previewing the sync plan. Current files and editor drafts are unchanged.

syncRevalidation.discussionRetainedTarge.zh-CN: 保留原讨论，目标不可用／待重接
syncRevalidation.discussionRetainedTarge.en-US: Original discussion retained; target unavailable or awaiting reconnection

error.core.committedDraftUpdateUnavailab.zh-CN: 源码已提交，但无法更新对应草稿；请保留原草稿并核对已提交版本。
error.core.committedDraftUpdateUnavailab.en-US: The source committed, but its draft could not be updated; retain the original draft and compare the committed version.

error.core.windowsFileProtectionFailed.zh-CN: 无法建立 Windows 文件保护。
error.core.windowsFileProtectionFailed.en-US: Windows file protection could not be established.

error.core.retainForeignDeviceState.zh-CN: 当前设备身份与保留的原设备状态不一致；请保留原状态。
error.core.retainForeignDeviceState.en-US: The current device identity differs from the retained device state; retain the original state.

error.core.desktopPreferenceRevisionChan.zh-CN: 桌面偏好版本已变化；请重新读取后再修改。
error.core.desktopPreferenceRevisionChan.en-US: The desktop preference revision changed; read it again before updating.

error.core.actorFeatureUnavailable.en-US: The original feature operation is unavailable.

error.core.actorLibraryUnbound.zh-CN: 原功能操作未绑定资料库。
error.core.actorLibraryUnbound.en-US: The original feature operation has no library binding.

error.core.actorFeatureNotPrepared.zh-CN: 原功能操作已不处于待执行状态。
error.core.actorFeatureNotPrepared.en-US: The original feature operation is no longer prepared for execution.

error.core.actorFeaturePlanUnavailable.zh-CN: 原功能操作的事务计划不可用。
error.core.actorFeaturePlanUnavailable.en-US: The transaction plan for the original feature operation is unavailable.

error.core.actorFeatureWorkspaceMismatch.zh-CN: 原功能计划与绑定资料库的工作区不一致。
error.core.actorFeatureWorkspaceMismatch.en-US: The original feature plan and its bound library have different workspaces.

error.core.actorLibraryWorkspaceChanged.zh-CN: 绑定资料库的工作区身份已变化。
error.core.actorLibraryWorkspaceChanged.en-US: The workspace identity of the bound library changed.

error.core.competingSettingsInputs.zh-CN: 原计划包含互相竞争的设置输入。
error.core.competingSettingsInputs.en-US: The original plan contains competing settings inputs.

error.core.missingSettingsDependency.zh-CN: 原计划缺少准确的设置依赖。
error.core.missingSettingsDependency.en-US: The original plan lacks its exact settings dependency.

error.core.originalSettingsChanged.zh-CN: 原设置依赖已变化；请重新准备操作。
error.core.originalSettingsChanged.en-US: The original settings dependency changed; prepare the operation again.

error.core.snapshotFileCount.zh-CN: 快照文件数量超过 {limit} 个。

error.core.snapshotLimitUnsupported.zh-CN: 快照文件数量限制超出可表达范围。
error.core.snapshotLimitUnsupported.en-US: The snapshot file-count limit is outside the supported range.

error.core.recoveryInstallationUnresolve.zh-CN: 操作 {operationId} 的安装尚未落定；请核对原恢复记录。
error.core.recoveryInstallationUnresolve.en-US: Installation for operation {operationId} is unresolved; inspect the original recovery record.

error.core.pendingOriginalOperation.zh-CN: 原操作 {operationId} 尚未落定；请先处理原操作。
error.core.pendingOriginalOperation.en-US: Original operation {operationId} is still pending; resolve that operation first.

error.core.testInterrupted.zh-CN: 测试在 {point} 处按计划中断。
error.core.testInterrupted.en-US: The test was deliberately interrupted at {point}.

error.core.concurrentSemanticDependency.zh-CN: 语义依赖 {object} 存在并发版本。

error.core.originalWriterEvidenceRequire.zh-CN: 仍需准确的原写入者证据；请核对列出的未满足条件。
error.core.originalWriterEvidenceRequire.en-US: Exact original-writer evidence is still required; inspect the listed unfulfilled obligations.

error.api.workerIoFailure.en-US: Compiler worker input or output failed.

error.api.workerExecutableUnavailable.zh-CN: 无法定位当前工作进程程序。
error.api.workerExecutableUnavailable.en-US: The current worker executable could not be located.

error.api.workerStartFailed.zh-CN: 无法启动编译工作进程。
error.api.workerStartFailed.en-US: The compiler worker could not be started.

error.api.workerInputEncodingFailed.zh-CN: 无法编码编译工作进程输入。
error.api.workerInputEncodingFailed.en-US: Compiler worker input could not be encoded.

error.api.workerPipeFailure.zh-CN: 工作进程管道读写失败。
error.api.workerPipeFailure.en-US: Worker pipe input or output failed.

error.api.workerOutputEncodingFailed.zh-CN: 无法编码工作进程输出。
error.api.workerOutputEncodingFailed.en-US: Worker output could not be encoded.

error.api.workerRequestInvalid.zh-CN: 工作进程请求格式无效。
error.api.workerRequestInvalid.en-US: The worker request format is invalid.

error.api.workerFrozenEncodingInvalid.zh-CN: 冻结文件的 Base64 编码无效。
error.api.workerFrozenEncodingInvalid.en-US: The frozen file has invalid Base64 encoding.

error.api.workerNotesInputBudget.en-US: Notes worker input exceeds the 96 MiB limit.

error.api.workerNotesFrozenFilesRequired.zh-CN: 批注操作需要完整的冻结文件输入。
error.api.workerNotesFrozenFilesRequired.en-US: The notes operation requires its complete frozen file input.

error.api.workerNotesSizeOverflow.zh-CN: 批注冻结文件总长度溢出。
error.api.workerNotesSizeOverflow.en-US: The total notes frozen-file length overflowed.

error.api.workerNotesFrozenFilesBudget.zh-CN: 批注冻结文件超过 64 MiB 限制。
error.api.workerNotesFrozenFilesBudget.en-US: Notes frozen files exceed the 64 MiB limit.

error.api.workerNotesSourceBudget.zh-CN: 批注源码超过允许的大小限制。
error.api.workerNotesSourceBudget.en-US: The notes source exceeds its size limit.

error.api.workerNotesResultBudget.zh-CN: 批注工作进程结果超过 24 MiB 限制。

hostedMediaImport.storageUnavailable.zh-CN: 浏览器恢复缓存容量不足或不可写；原件 File 和输入仍在本页，未发送新的资源写入。
hostedMediaImport.storageUnavailable.en-US: The browser recovery cache is full or not writable. The original File and input remain on this page; no new resource write was sent.

hostedMediaImport.originalSizeLimit.zh-CN: 资源导入超过 16 MiB 上限，原件仍在本页，未发起写入。
hostedMediaImport.originalSizeLimit.en-US: Resource import exceeds the 16 MiB limit. The original remains on this page; no write was started.

hostedMediaImport.inputChangedDuringRead.zh-CN: 读取期间的新名称或集合输入保留，原件已取得；尚未准备写入。
hostedMediaImport.inputChangedDuringRead.en-US: New name or collection input made during reading is retained, and the original was obtained. No write has been prepared.

hostedMediaImport.originalReadRequestPer.zh-CN: 原件已完整读取；准备和提交均须先可靠保留原请求。
hostedMediaImport.originalReadRequestPer.en-US: The original was read completely. Preparation and commit both require reliable retention of the original request first.

hostedMediaImport.resultUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 资源导入结果未确认，原请求保留，请查询原编号。
hostedMediaImport.resultUnconfirmed.en-US: The resource import result is unconfirmed. The original request is retained; query the original ID.

hostedMediaImport.readingKeepInput.zh-CN: 原件仍在读取，请保留当前输入。
hostedMediaImport.readingKeepInput.en-US: The original is still being read. Keep the current input.

hostedMediaImport.committedLocatorNotAut.zh-CN: 原资源导入已提交；新定位符不授予读取权限，正文草稿与撤销历史保留。
hostedMediaImport.committedLocatorNotAut.en-US: The original resource import was committed. The new locator does not grant read permission; the body draft and Undo history are retained.

hostedMediaImport.planPrepared.zh-CN: 原上传计划已准备，请核对名称、字节和原编号后明确提交。
hostedMediaImport.planPrepared.en-US: The original upload plan is prepared. Check its name, bytes, and original ID, then explicitly commit.

hostedMediaImport.originalEndedNotSaved.zh-CN: 原导入已结束，未冒作保存成功；原件和新输入保留。
hostedMediaImport.originalEndedNotSaved.en-US: The original import ended and was not treated as a successful save. The original and new input are retained.

hostedMediaImport.originalNeedsVerificat.zh-CN: 原操作仍待核对；不会换编号或采用当前其他文件重放。
hostedMediaImport.originalNeedsVerificat.en-US: The original operation still needs checking. It will not be replayed with a new ID or another currently selected file.

hostedMediaImport.originalSummary.zh-CN: 原件：{p0} · {p1} 字节{p2}；文件字节和名称与正文分开保留。
hostedMediaImport.originalSummary.en-US: Original: {p0} · {p1} bytes{p2}; file bytes and name are retained separately from the body.

hostedMediaImport.selectOriginalHint.zh-CN: 请选择要上传的原件，最多 16 MiB。
hostedMediaImport.selectOriginalHint.en-US: Select an original to upload, at most 16 MiB.

hostedMediaImport.recoveryUnparseable.zh-CN: 恢复记录无法解析，原文未清除，未发送新的操作。
hostedMediaImport.recoveryUnparseable.en-US: The recovery record cannot be parsed. Original text was not cleared; no new operation was sent.

hostedMediaImport.discardCorruptRecovery.zh-CN: 明确放弃损坏的资源导入恢复记录
hostedMediaImport.discardCorruptRecovery.en-US: Explicitly discard the corrupt resource import recovery record

hostedMediaImport.uploadPreviewUnavailab.zh-CN: 本次上传预览当前不可用
hostedMediaImport.uploadPreviewUnavailab.en-US: This upload preview is currently unavailable

hostedMediaImport.laterInputChangedBasis.zh-CN: 后来输入或同值往返已改变依据；原计划不会提交当前新输入。请核对或明确结束原操作后再准备新上传。
hostedMediaImport.laterInputChangedBasis.en-US: Later input or changes back to the same value changed the basis. The original plan will not commit current new input. Check or explicitly end the original operation before preparing a new upload.

hostedMediaImport.retryOriginalPreparati.zh-CN: 按原上传请求重试准备
hostedMediaImport.retryOriginalPreparati.en-US: Retry preparation using the original upload request

hostedMediaImport.commitOriginalPlan.zh-CN: 确认提交原资源导入计划
hostedMediaImport.commitOriginalPlan.en-US: Confirm commit of the original resource import plan

hostedMediaImport.inputOrAuthorityChange.zh-CN: 当前输入或集合资格已变化，未提交旧计划。
hostedMediaImport.inputOrAuthorityChange.en-US: Current input or collection eligibility changed. The old plan was not committed.

hostedMediaImport.endUninstalledOriginal.zh-CN: 结束未安装的原资源导入
hostedMediaImport.endUninstalledOriginal.en-US: End the original uninstalled resource import

hostedMediaImport.locatorRequiresIndepen.zh-CN: 已提交定位符仅用于后续独立鉴权查看，不代表自动获权。
hostedMediaImport.locatorRequiresIndepen.en-US: The committed locator is only for later independently authorized viewing; it does not grant authority automatically.

hostedMediaImport.clearCompletedReceiptK.zh-CN: 清除本页已结束导入回执，保留文件输入
hostedMediaImport.clearCompletedReceiptK.en-US: Clear this page’s ended import receipt and keep file input

hostedRegistry.recoveryUnparseable.zh-CN: 导航输入恢复记录无法解析，请保留原记录；新操作与提交暂停。
hostedRegistry.recoveryUnparseable.en-US: The navigation input recovery record cannot be parsed. Keep the original record; new operations and commits are paused.

hostedRegistry.authorizationChanged.zh-CN: 授权策略已变化，旧目录与标签展示已清除，请重新连接。
hostedRegistry.authorizationChanged.en-US: The authorization policy changed. Old directory and tag displays were cleared; reconnect.

hostedRegistry.recoveryNotWritable.zh-CN: 导航恢复记录不可写，未发送新操作。
hostedRegistry.recoveryNotWritable.en-US: The navigation recovery record is not writable. No new operation was sent.

hostedRegistry.requestNotDurable.zh-CN: 浏览器不能可靠保留原导航请求，未发送；输入和原编号仍在本页。
hostedRegistry.requestNotDurable.en-US: The browser cannot reliably retain the original navigation request. It was not sent; input and the original ID remain on this page.

hostedRegistry.catalogFormatUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 目录与标签范围格式无法确认，未采用结果。
hostedRegistry.catalogFormatUnconfirmed.en-US: The directory and tag scope format cannot be confirmed. The result was not adopted.

hostedRegistry.committedNavigationOnly.zh-CN: 原导航操作已提交；目录和标签是独立导航资格，不授予正文读取或 Query 范围。
hostedRegistry.committedNavigationOnly.en-US: The original navigation operation was committed. Directories and tags have independent navigation eligibility; they do not grant body reading or Query scope.

hostedRegistry.checkProposalThenCommit.zh-CN: 请核对原提案，再明确提交。
hostedRegistry.checkProposalThenCommit.en-US: Check the original proposal, then explicitly commit.

hostedRegistry.factsCheckedNotFalseSucce.zh-CN: 原操作事实已核对；未把结束或未登记冒作提交成功。
hostedRegistry.factsCheckedNotFalseSucce.en-US: The original operation facts were checked. Ended or unregistered states were not treated as a successful commit.

hostedRegistry.readAuthorizedCatalogFirs.zh-CN: 请先读取获权目录与标签目录。
hostedRegistry.readAuthorizedCatalogFirs.en-US: Read the authorized directory and tag catalogs first.

hostedRegistry.addressEligibilityUnconfi.zh-CN: 导航地址资格无法确认，未采用另一目标。
hostedRegistry.addressEligibilityUnconfi.en-US: Navigation address eligibility cannot be confirmed. No other target was adopted.

hostedRegistry.copyVerifiedAddress.zh-CN: 复制已核对的导航地址

hostedRegistry.checkingSelectedTagIdenti.zh-CN: 正在核对明确选择的标签身份…
hostedRegistry.checkingSelectedTagIdenti.en-US: Checking the explicitly selected tag identity…

hostedRegistry.navigationScopeDescriptio.zh-CN: 目录地址与标签不会自动扫描子笔记或改变 Query 范围；正文草稿与 Undo 独立保留。
hostedRegistry.navigationScopeDescriptio.en-US: Directory addresses and tags do not automatically scan child notes or change Query scope. The body draft and Undo history are retained independently.

hostedRegistry.directoryCatalogPartial.zh-CN: 目录导航部分可用；不可用项保留，不猜测路径。
hostedRegistry.directoryCatalogPartial.en-US: Directory navigation is partially available. Unavailable items are retained; paths are not guessed.

hostedRegistry.tagCatalogPartial.en-US: The tag catalog is partially available.

hostedRegistry.authorizedTagCatalog.zh-CN: 获权标签目录 · 选择后核对地址
hostedRegistry.authorizedTagCatalog.en-US: Authorized tag catalog · Select to verify the address

hostedRegistry.moveTag.en-US: Change tag parent / Move to root

hostedRegistry.completeStructureNotReada.zh-CN: 完整标签结构未获权读取；暂停父级选择及结构操作，原输入保留。
hostedRegistry.completeStructureNotReada.en-US: The complete tag structure is not authorized for reading. Parent selection and structure operations are paused; original input is retained.

hostedRegistry.sameNameTagCount.zh-CN: 已有 {p0} 个同名标签；仍创建会产生新的独立身份，不合并。
hostedRegistry.sameNameTagCount.en-US: There are already {p0} tags with this name. Creating another produces a new independent identity; tags are not merged.

hostedRegistry.idAwaitingAuthorization.zh-CN: 原编号保留，尚待当前授权核对
hostedRegistry.idAwaitingAuthorization.en-US: Original ID retained; awaiting current authorization verification

hostedRegistry.commitOriginalProposal.en-US: Explicitly commit the original navigation proposal

hostedRegistry.endUninstalledOriginal.zh-CN: 结束原未安装导航操作
hostedRegistry.endUninstalledOriginal.en-US: End the original uninstalled navigation operation

hostedRegistry.checkCurrentOriginalAddre.zh-CN: 核对原操作的当前导航地址
hostedRegistry.checkCurrentOriginalAddre.en-US: Check the original operation’s current navigation address

hostedRegistry.prepareAnotherOperation.zh-CN: 明确准备另一导航操作

hostedBackup.recoveryUnparseable.zh-CN: 完整备份恢复记录无法解析；原记录保留，生成与下载暂停。
hostedBackup.recoveryUnparseable.en-US: The complete backup recovery record cannot be parsed. The original record is retained; generation and download are paused.

hostedBackup.authorizationChanged.zh-CN: 授权策略已变化，旧完整备份展示已清除，请重新连接。
hostedBackup.authorizationChanged.en-US: The authorization policy changed. Old complete backup displays were cleared; reconnect.

hostedBackup.recoveryNotWritable.zh-CN: 备份恢复记录不可写，未发送操作。
hostedBackup.recoveryNotWritable.en-US: The backup recovery record is not writable. No operation was sent.

hostedBackup.requestNotDurable.zh-CN: 浏览器不能可靠保留原备份请求；原编号保留，未发送新的生成或确认操作。
hostedBackup.requestNotDurable.en-US: The browser cannot reliably retain the original backup request. The original ID is retained; no new generation or confirmation operation was sent.

hostedBackup.eligibilityUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 完整恢复备份资格无法确认，未借原生导出权限生成备份。
hostedBackup.eligibilityUnconfirmed.en-US: Complete recovery backup eligibility cannot be confirmed. Native export permission was not used to generate a backup.

hostedBackup.generatedOriginalArtifact.zh-CN: 原完整备份已生成；可按独立下载权限交付同一工件。
hostedBackup.generatedOriginalArtifact.en-US: The original complete backup was generated. The same artifact can be delivered under independent download permission.

hostedBackup.committedArtifactUnavailabl.zh-CN: 原完整备份确已提交，但本次交付工件已过期、关闭或重启丢失；不能重执行原编号，请保留原操作事实。
hostedBackup.committedArtifactUnavailabl.en-US: The original complete backup was committed, but this delivery artifact expired, closed, or was lost after restart. The original ID cannot be executed again; keep the original operation facts.

hostedBackup.planPrepared.zh-CN: 原完整备份计划已准备，请核对范围后明确生成。
hostedBackup.planPrepared.en-US: The original complete backup plan is prepared. Check its scope, then explicitly generate it.

hostedBackup.factsCheckedNotFalseSuccess.zh-CN: 原请求事实已核对；结束或未登记不代表已生成备份。
hostedBackup.factsCheckedNotFalseSuccess.en-US: The original request facts were checked. Ended or unregistered states do not mean a backup was generated.

hostedBackup.generationNotPermitted.zh-CN: 当前没有独立完整备份生成权限，或原请求仍待核对。
hostedBackup.generationNotPermitted.en-US: There is no independent complete-backup generation permission, or the original request still needs checking.

hostedBackup.checkOriginalPlan.zh-CN: 请核对原完整备份计划，未生成旧缓存计划。
hostedBackup.checkOriginalPlan.en-US: Check the original complete backup plan. An old cached plan was not generated.

hostedBackup.closeReceiptUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 关闭回执无法确认，原备份事实保留。
hostedBackup.closeReceiptUnconfirmed.en-US: The close receipt cannot be confirmed. Original backup facts are retained.

hostedBackup.artifactNotAuthorizedForDow.zh-CN: 原工件尚未按当前授权核对，或没有独立下载权限。
hostedBackup.artifactNotAuthorizedForDow.en-US: The original artifact has not been checked under current authorization, or independent download permission is missing.

hostedBackup.downloadLengthIncomplete.zh-CN: 备份下载长度不完整，未交付文件。
hostedBackup.downloadLengthIncomplete.en-US: The backup download length is incomplete. No file was delivered.

hostedBackup.downloadDigestMismatch.zh-CN: 备份完整摘要不匹配，未交付文件。
hostedBackup.downloadDigestMismatch.en-US: The complete backup digest differs. No file was delivered.

hostedBackup.verifiedDelivery.zh-CN: 同一完整备份已按 {p0} 字节与 SHA-256 校验交付；不提供自动恢复。
hostedBackup.verifiedDelivery.en-US: The same complete backup was delivered after verifying {p0} bytes and SHA-256. Automatic restore is not provided.

hostedBackup.description.zh-CN: 包括所选库的原始文件、忽略项、回收内容、所有人的私有草稿和原操作记录。它需要管理员独立授权，区别于原生资料包；不提供自动跨设备恢复。生成与下载均不保存、替换当前正文。
hostedBackup.description.en-US: Includes original files, ignored items, recycled content, everyone’s private drafts, and original operation records from the selected library. It requires independent administrator authorization and differs from a native content package; automatic cross-device restore is not provided. Generation and download neither save nor replace the current body.

hostedBackup.discardCorruptRecovery.zh-CN: 明确放弃损坏的完整备份恢复记录
hostedBackup.discardCorruptRecovery.en-US: Explicitly discard the corrupt complete-backup recovery record

hostedBackup.prepareBackup.zh-CN: 准备完整恢复资料备份

hostedBackup.idAwaitingAuthorization.zh-CN: 原编号保留，尚待当前授权核对
hostedBackup.idAwaitingAuthorization.en-US: Original ID retained; awaiting current authorization verification

hostedBackup.committedArtifactUnavailabl.zh-CN: 原提交已完成，本次交付工件不可用（过期、关闭或重启）；不能自动生成替代备份。
hostedBackup.committedArtifactUnavailabl.en-US: The original commit is complete, but this delivery artifact is unavailable (expired, closed, or after restart). A replacement backup cannot be generated automatically.

hostedBackup.consentAria.zh-CN: 确认完整备份包含所有人的私稿与原操作
hostedBackup.consentAria.en-US: Confirm the complete backup includes everyone’s private drafts and original operations

hostedBackup.consentLabel.zh-CN: 已核对原计划；确认完整备份包括所有人的私稿与原操作，不是原生资料包
hostedBackup.consentLabel.en-US: I checked the original plan and confirm this complete backup includes everyone’s private drafts and original operations, rather than a native content package

hostedBackup.generateOriginalPlan.zh-CN: 明确生成原完整备份计划
hostedBackup.generateOriginalPlan.en-US: Explicitly generate the original complete backup plan

hostedBackup.retryOriginalPreparation.zh-CN: 重试原完整备份准备请求
hostedBackup.retryOriginalPreparation.en-US: Retry original complete backup preparation request

hostedBackup.endUninstalledPlan.zh-CN: 结束原未安装备份计划

hostedBackup.closeArtifact.zh-CN: 关闭本次备份交付工件

hostedBackup.endCompletedReceipt.zh-CN: 明确结束本页已完成备份回执
hostedBackup.endCompletedReceipt.en-US: Explicitly end this page’s completed backup receipt

diagramRender.widthOutOfRange.zh-CN: 图片宽度须在 320–2048 像素之间。
diagramRender.widthOutOfRange.en-US: Image width must be within 320–2048 pixels.

diagramRender.pngContentUnsupported.zh-CN: 此图包含当前 PNG 路线不支持的内容；图源已保留。
diagramRender.pngContentUnsupported.en-US: This diagram contains content unsupported by the current PNG route. Diagram source is retained.

diagramRender.externalResourcesDisallowe.zh-CN: 离线图表不能使用外部资源或动作。
diagramRender.externalResourcesDisallowe.en-US: Offline diagrams cannot use external resources or actions.

diagramRender.styleNeedsExternalResource.zh-CN: 图表样式要求外部资源，无法离线生成准确图片。
diagramRender.styleNeedsExternalResource.en-US: The diagram style requires external resources, so an exact image cannot be generated offline.

diagramRender.dimensionsMissing.zh-CN: 没有取得图表的准确尺寸。
diagramRender.dimensionsMissing.en-US: Exact diagram dimensions were not obtained.

diagramRender.imageTooTall.zh-CN: 图片过高，请缩小宽度或拆分图表；图源已保留。
diagramRender.imageTooTall.en-US: The image is too tall. Reduce its width or split the diagram; source is retained.

diagramRender.pngUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前浏览器不能生成 PNG。
diagramRender.pngUnavailable.en-US: The current browser cannot generate PNG.

diagramRender.pngFailed.zh-CN: PNG 生成失败；图源已保留。
diagramRender.pngFailed.en-US: PNG generation failed. Diagram source is retained.

diagramState.sourceLengthInvalid.zh-CN: 图源须为 1–32768 个字符；输入已保留。
diagramState.sourceLengthInvalid.en-US: Diagram source must contain 1–32768 characters. Input is retained.

diagramState.sourceControlCharacters.zh-CN: 图源包含不支持的控制字符。
diagramState.sourceControlCharacters.en-US: Diagram source contains unsupported control characters.

diagramState.offlineSourceUnsupported.zh-CN: 离线图表暂不接受外部资源、HTML、点击动作或图内配置；请保留普通 Mermaid 图源。
diagramState.offlineSourceUnsupported.en-US: Offline diagrams do not currently accept external resources, HTML, click actions, or in-diagram configuration. Keep ordinary Mermaid source.

diagramState.exactPngSizeUnsupported.zh-CN: 没有取得受支持大小的准确 PNG；请缩小图表后重试。
diagramState.exactPngSizeUnsupported.en-US: An exact PNG of supported size was not obtained. Reduce the diagram size and retry.

diagramState.pngSizeMismatch.zh-CN: PNG 尺寸与本次预览不一致或超出限制。
diagramState.pngSizeMismatch.en-US: PNG dimensions differ from this preview or exceed the limit.

diagramState.sourceBasisChanged.zh-CN: 图表来源已改变；输入保留，请重新打开当前图表。
diagramState.sourceBasisChanged.en-US: The diagram source basis changed. Input is retained; reopen the current diagram.

diagramState.draftSizeLimit.zh-CN: 插入后将超过 2 MiB 草稿上限；请缩小图表。输入及原稿保留。
diagramState.draftSizeLimit.en-US: Insertion would exceed the 2 MiB draft limit. Reduce the diagram size; input and the original draft are retained.

diagramState.imageSourceMismatch.zh-CN: 图片与本次图源不一致；请重新生成。
diagramState.imageSourceMismatch.en-US: The image differs from the current diagram source. Generate it again.

diagramPanel.noteNotEditable.zh-CN: 当前笔记不可编辑，不能修改图源。
diagramPanel.noteNotEditable.en-US: The current note is not editable. Diagram source cannot be changed.

diagramPanel.newDiagramAtEnd.zh-CN: 新建图表（追加到正文末尾）
diagramPanel.newDiagramAtEnd.en-US: New diagram (append to the body end)

diagramPanel.generatingOffline.zh-CN: 正在本机浏览器离线生成；没有写入笔记。
diagramPanel.generatingOffline.en-US: Generating offline in this local browser. The note has not been written.

diagramPanel.pngGeneratedSummary.zh-CN: 已生成当前图源的 {p0} × {p1} PNG。请核对中文与尺寸后确认。
diagramPanel.pngGeneratedSummary.en-US: Generated a {p0} × {p1} PNG for the current source. Check Chinese text and dimensions before confirming.

diagramPanel.confirmImageWriteDraft.zh-CN: 确认当前图片并写入草稿
diagramPanel.confirmImageWriteDraft.en-US: Confirm the current image and write to draft

diagramPanel.noteOrPermissionChanged.zh-CN: 笔记已改变或权限已更新；图源输入仍保留，请重新打开当前笔记的图表入口。
diagramPanel.noteOrPermissionChanged.en-US: The note changed or permission was updated. Diagram source input is retained; reopen the current note’s diagram entry.

diagramPanel.diagramWrittenToDraft.zh-CN: 图源与准确 PNG 已作为一次草稿变更写入，可撤销；保存沿用当前笔记。
diagramPanel.diagramWrittenToDraft.en-US: Source and exact PNG were written as one undoable draft change. Save through the current note.

diagramPanel.pngPreviewAlt.zh-CN: 当前 Mermaid 图源的 PNG 预览
diagramPanel.pngPreviewAlt.en-US: PNG preview of the current Mermaid source

diagramPanel.sourceOrSizeChanged.zh-CN: 图源或尺寸已改变，旧图已失效；请重新生成。
diagramPanel.sourceOrSizeChanged.en-US: Source or dimensions changed, invalidating the old image. Generate it again.

diagramPanel.sourceAndPngDescription.zh-CN: 图源只有一份可编辑原文。PNG 在当前浏览器离线生成，确认后与原生源一同保存、同步和输出。直接修改源码中的 source 后须重新生成，旧图片不能输出。DOCX 再导入为普通图片。
diagramPanel.sourceAndPngDescription.en-US: There is only one editable source original. PNG is generated offline in the current browser and, after confirmation, is saved, synced, and output with the native source. Editing source directly in the code requires regeneration; the old image cannot be output. DOCX reimport treats it as an ordinary image.

diagramPanel.pngWidthRange.zh-CN: PNG 图片宽度（320–2048 像素）

latexInsertion.openEditableNoteFirst.zh-CN: 请先打开可编辑笔记，再插入公式。
latexInsertion.openEditableNoteFirst.en-US: Open an editable note before inserting a formula.

latexInsertion.selectionCharacterBoundar.zh-CN: 插入选区不属于当前完整字符，原稿保留。
latexInsertion.selectionCharacterBoundar.en-US: The insertion selection is not within complete current characters. The original draft is retained.

capture.newDraftHelp.zh-CN: 新稿不携带当前内容，打开后请另选资料库。失败后再次操作会恢复同一新稿，不另建替代稿。可从列表回到原稿。
capture.newDraftHelp.en-US: A new draft does not carry the current content. Choose its library after opening. After a failure, repeat this action to recover the same new draft without creating a replacement. Use the list to return to an original draft.

personalInput.editCopy.zh-CN: 编辑独立本人输入副本
personalInput.editCopy.en-US: Edit a separate personal input copy

personalInput.copyEditorLabel.zh-CN: 可编辑的独立本人输入副本

personalInput.copyActiveFinishFirst.zh-CN: 请先完成当前本人副本的编辑。
personalInput.copyActiveFinishFirst.en-US: Finish editing the current personal copy first.

personalInput.copyChanged.zh-CN: 本人副本或其输入已变化；当前输入仍保留，请检查后重试。
personalInput.copyChanged.en-US: The personal copy or its input changed. Current input is retained; check it before retrying.

personalInput.copyOnlyCannotRestore.zh-CN: 独立本人副本只能继续编辑或复制，不能作为正文恢复或取得资料写入权限。
personalInput.copyOnlyCannotRestore.en-US: A separate personal copy can be edited or copied; it cannot restore an author draft or grant document write access.

personalInput.copyFinished.zh-CN: 本人副本已可靠保留；原输入、原操作和资料正文未改变。
personalInput.copyFinished.en-US: The personal copy is durably retained. The original input, operation and document source are unchanged.
